title: Basket Random
description:
Basket Random is a chaotic arcade basketball game where every match turns into a funny test of timing, luck, and unpredictable physics. Instead of giving players a serious sports simulation, it focuses on quick rounds, simple controls, and hilarious ragdoll movement. You control your team with one key, jump toward the ball, block your opponent, and try to score before the other side reaches the winning point. The idea is easy to understand, but the random physics make every attempt feel different.

What makes Basket Random stand out is the way it changes after almost every score. One round may take place on a normal court, while the next may throw you into a completely different setup with unusual players, strange body proportions, or a ball that behaves in an unexpected way. Sometimes the characters have long arms, sometimes their movement feels heavier, and sometimes the ball bounces in a way that makes even a simple shot difficult to predict. This constant variety keeps the game fresh without making it complicated.

The controls are intentionally simple, which makes the game accessible for almost anyone. In single-player mode, you can play against the CPU and practice your timing. In 2-player mode, the game becomes even more entertaining because both players share the same device and compete in fast, messy basketball duels. Since both sides are dealing with the same strange physics, every point feels like a mix of skill, reaction, and comedy.

Basket Random is especially enjoyable for players who like short sports games with instant action. You do not need to learn complex moves, manage a team, or follow advanced basketball rules. The goal is clear: jump, reach the ball, defend your basket, and score. However, the challenge comes from reading the movement of your characters and adapting quickly when the game changes the court, the players, or the ball behavior.

The pixel-style visuals give the game a clean and playful look, while the ragdoll animation creates many unexpected moments. A missed jump can turn into a lucky block. A bad shot can bounce into the basket. A perfect attack can fail because your player lands in the wrong position. These small surprises are the reason Basket Random feels fun even after many rounds.

For fans of funny basketball games, local 2-player games, and physics-based sports challenges, Basket Random offers a simple but highly replayable experience. It is easy to start, fast to understand, and unpredictable enough to keep every match exciting. Whether you are playing alone or challenging a friend, each round brings a new chance to score a ridiculous basket, make a surprising comeback, or laugh at a completely unexpected play.

title: Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online
description:
Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online is a fast-paced reward adventure that mixes movement, progression, and collection mechanics. Instead of standing still and opening boxes in one place, players travel across multiple zones, search for better lucky boxes, collect Brainrots, and return safely to base with their rewards. The deeper you go, the better the chances, but the risks also increase.

The game creates a satisfying loop of exploring, upgrading, and improving each run. Some sessions are about safe farming and steady progress, while others are about pushing into harder areas for rare rewards. That balance helps the gameplay stay fresh over time.

What Makes the Game Different?
Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online adds movement and route planning to the lucky box formula. Reaching stronger zones takes speed, timing, and smart decisions. You are not only depending on luck. Better movement and better upgrades often lead to better rewards.

There are more than 75 collectible Brainrot characters spread across 14 rarity classes. Common rewards appear early, while higher tiers such as Celestial, Divine, Eternal, and Supreme take more effort to obtain. Some rare finds only appear during events or special spawn windows.

Gameplay Progression
Collected Brainrots can be sold for currency, which is then used to improve future runs. Players can upgrade movement speed, buy stronger lucky boxes, rebirth for better income rates, and expand their base with new floors and extra slots. Even small upgrades help create faster and more profitable runs later.

The game rewards steady improvement. Players who learn the map, optimize routes, and invest wisely usually progress faster than those who rely only on random rewards.

Online and Multiplayer Modes
The online mode is designed for solo players who still want an active social experience. You can chat with others, invite friends, and join rooms while continuing your own progress. Local 2-player mode lets two players use the same device, making it a fun option for shared sessions.

Customization and Events
Players can personalize their character with clothes, wings, and different bag styles. Special events also keep the game active, including Diamond Rain, Rainbow, Toxic, Volcano, and Candy themed events. These limited-time moments often create better chances for rare rewards.

Key Features
- Fast progression gameplay built around movement and rewards
- 14 areas with stronger rewards in later zones
- More than 75 collectible Brainrot characters
- 14 rarity classes from Common to Supreme
- Rare Celestial and timed Divine rewards
- Speed upgrades, rebirth system, and base expansion
- Online solo mode with chat, invites, and room joining
- Local 2-player mode on one device
- Character customization with clothes, wings, and bags
- Seasonal and rotating live events


Lucky Brainrot Blocks Online turns a simple lucky box concept into a more active and rewarding experience. With collection goals, movement-based progression, rare rewards, and social features, it offers a gameplay loop that feels easy to start and satisfying to improve over time.

title: The Tall Man
description:
The Tall Man is a horror game where you explore darkness, searching for clues with only a weak light to guide you. But something is watching, always, just out of sight.

In this first-person horror survival game, the player navigates a dark, desolate forest at night with the primary objective of collecting nine mysterious pages scattered across the environment before a supernatural entity arrives. Movement is cautious and tense, utilizing a flashlight with a depleting battery to illuminate looming pine trees, abandoned structures, and rusted vehicles. The core gameplay loop focuses on exploration and stealth, where success depends on finding all collectibles while managing limited light sources to avoid the looming threat. The visual style is rooted in a gritty, realistic 3D aesthetic featuring a high-contrast palette of deep blacks, navy blues, and cold grays, creating a chilling atmosphere punctured only by the harsh yellow glow of the flashlight. A persistent HUD displays a countdown timer for the Slender-inspired Tallman, a page counter, a flashlight battery indicator, and a mini-map for navigation. The setting is a classic horror woodland characterized by tall, spindly trees and foggy patches, evoking a sense of isolation and vulnerability. The protagonist appears as a generic human figure in a pinkish sleeve, seen only via their hand clutching the light. The emotional tone is high-tension and creepy, targeting teens and adult fans of the urban legend horror genre who enjoy skill-heavy survival mechanics and jumpscares. Progression is measured by the increasing number of pages found, which heightens the difficulty and atmospheric soundscapes as the player nears the final objective.

title: Obby: Mini-Games VS 1000
description:
Become the best out of 1,000 players and win the grand prize in the thrilling new Squid Game!
Extreme challenges await you, where only the strongest survive. Here are some of them:

🔨 Savage Hammers – Dodge them before they smash you!

➕ Math Spikes – Solve equations quickly and correctly, or lose!

🟥 Falling Tiles – Don’t stand too long — the tile might collapse beneath you!

🧱 Building Madness – Dodge brick blocks building up in front of you! Climb fast or get trapped!

🎵 Dancing Tiles – The music stopped? Stand on the right color — or it’s game over!

⛰️ Deadly Climb – Reach the top of the mountain while dodging massive rolling balls!

Can you survive and prove you're number one out of a thousand?

title: Special Ops: GO
description:
Play instantly in your browser. Jump into fast 5v5 PvP firefights, climb the ranks, and dominate with modern weapons in Special Ops: FPS PvP War.
Full description
Special Ops: FPS PvP War is a modern online FPS built for quick, competitive matches — now playable directly in your browser with no download. Lock in your loadout, enter the arena, and prove yourself in intense real-time PvP battles.
Fight across multiple maps designed for close-quarters chaos and long-range sniper duels. Prefer to play solo? Jump into single-player missions and survive relentless enemies. Whether you’re here for ranked glory or casual fun with friends, every match is about sharp aim, movement, and smart decisions.
Key features

Instant browser play (WebGL): no install, jump straight into action
Online PvP: up to 5v5 real-time battles
Multiple game modes: Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Ranked, and Custom Rooms
Single-player mode: missions and survival-style challenges
Big arsenal: 20+ modern weapons including pistols, SMGs, rifles, and sniper rifles

Progression: daily rewards, quests, ranks, and credits
Sniper-friendly maps: long sightlines + high-stakes duels
Optimized performance: smooth controls and responsive gunplay in the browser

title: Get Tall And Fall
description:
An exciting adventure in which you have to boost your growth with a variety of food, pets, potions and other methods.

Conquer the peaks of each location, discover new worlds and take the lead among the players!

title: Zombie Space Episode II
description:
NEW ISSUE OF GALACTIC NEWS

ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE ON THE RED PLANET...
- Zombie virus has spread among civilians.
- Rescuers found survivors among the zombies.
- The galactic government has urgently gone on vacation.

A zombie virus outbreak has occurred on the space station. The first group of mercenaries disappeared. Your task is to find survivors among the zombies and find out the cause of the zombie apocalypse. You have to fight a horde of zombies using various types of weapons. Look for hidden weapons in chests. Upgrade characters and weapons! Use the abilities of the characters in hot battles against zombies. Play with a friend on the same device or solo!
★★★

title: Road Chase: Shooter Realistic Guns
description:
Your goal is to break away from the chase. But bad luck, you have a rather weak car.
No problem! But you have plenty of weapons =)!

Use a huge arsenal of weapons to stop the chase.
AK47, Minigun, Crossbow, Stationary gun, Machine gun, Flamethrower...

Shoot car parts, wheels, body parts. Hand out headshots, do combos! Shoot weapons, machine guns, stationary guns. Do everything to stop the chase.

The game has a huge selection of weapons, and there will be even more!

Do not rush to relax, the enemy is not asleep. And their attacking arsenal is varied.
Motorcycles, ATVs, racing cars, drones, jeeps, helicopters...

Realistic weapons and cars!

title: Your Obby Parkour
description:
Enter a thrilling world of non-stop challenges! Run, jump, dodge, and conquer in the ultimate parkour platformer! 
Survive crazy levels — from burning lava and icy slides to water traps and mysterious portals. Watch out for trampolines, spinning traps, and tons of hidden paths!

Play with friends and travel through fun regions — from simple to brutally hard! Discover the hidden little dragon, collect trophies, and unlock secret shortcuts and bonus zones!

Be careful of:
Deadly skeletons
Lava-filled volcanoes
Slippery ice paths
Horror mazes where it's easy to get lost!

Ready to be a true parkour master? Find the fastest paths, conquer extreme stages, and show the world your skills!

Perfect for fans of obby-style maps, parkour games, secrets, adventures, and multiplayer fun!

title: Gym Boss
description:
💪 "Gym Boss" – a casual game where you start with basic equipment and gradually become a true champion!

🔥 Game Features:

title: Cube Trap
description:
The room looks simple. Five steps to the door you want, level floor, no enemies. You start walking — and the floor drops out from under you.

A 3D platformer that lies to your face. The platform slides away at the exact instant you jump. The ceiling comes down the moment you stand still. The controls flip to mirror mode halfway down a corridor. Gravity turns over, and the sky becomes the floor. And the door you were heading for sidesteps two paces and slams shut.

Nothing here is random: every dirty trick fires the same way every single time. The first time it kills you; the second time it doesn't. Death is instant and costs you nothing — the little cube guy bursts into parts and half a second later he's standing at the start again. Losing is impossible. The only thing you can do is fail to catch on.

title: Smash and Break
description:
Smash and Break — a juicy voxel destruction sandbox where you can blow anything to pieces!

100 objects are waiting their turn: a mouth-watering burger, a birthday cake, a gaming PC, a helicopter, a piano, a fish tank, and even a capybara. Every object is built from thousands of voxel cubes and breaks apart for real: chunks chip off and tumble down, liquid pours out through the holes, fire spreads across anything flammable, and glass bursts into a spray of shards.

No timers, no penalties, no game overs. Just you, a pile of objects, and total freedom to destroy. The perfect stress reliever!

title: Cavern of Gears
description: Cavern of Gears is a 2D action-adventure set in a steampunk underworld. Fight through gear-driven caverns with a growing arsenal of weapons, uncover the fate of the workers who vanished below, and face down the powers that took their place.

title: Nitro Ball
description:
Nitro Ball is a fast-paced car soccer game played entirely in your browser. Drive a boost-powered car, launch off the walls, and smash a giant ball into your opponent's goal. Jump, flip, and fly through the air to pull off saves and score from anywhere on the pitch.

Pick your mode: play a quick match against AI opponents in 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3, fight through a knockout tournament, or switch to Hockey mode where the ball is swapped for a heavy puck that slides across the ice. For a different kind of challenge, take on the Challenge Maps — timed obstacle courses that test your aerial control and precision driving, with your best times saved for every course.

Customise your ride with a garage full of cars, wheels, decals, boost trails, toppers and over 250 antenna flags. Free Play mode lets you practice in an arena solo with no opponents.

description:

Team up with up to 3 players, defend your territory from other players and hostile creatures, trade, and grow stronger. Day turns to night, and danger rises with the dark - stay alert.

Rustlings online delivers the thrill of surviving and building without spending dozens of hours mastering complex systems - just open your browser and play, no install needed.

description:
Transform into a powerful Wolf Robot and battle enemy machines in an open-world futuristic city. Switch between a robot, car, bike, helicopter, jet, and tank to complete action-packed missions, defeat enemies, and save the city from destruction.

Game Modes:

Complete challenging objectives, battle enemy robots, destroy targets, and protect the city from dangerous attacks. Test your combat skills, use powerful transformations, and overcome increasingly difficult missions to become the ultimate robot hero.

Free Mode
Explore the open world at your own pace and enjoy complete freedom across the futuristic city. Transform into different vehicles and robots, collect rewards, fly through the skies, and discover everything the city has to offer.

title: Escape Tsunami for Brainrots
description:
Run fast and collect Brainrots! 🏃
Run from the tsunamis when they appear! 🌊
Survive and collect as many Brainrots as possible! ⚡
Upgrade your Brainrots! 💸
Upgrade your base! 🏗️

Controls:
Desktop — WASD: move, left and right mouse buttons — control the camera, E — interact, Space — jump.  
Mobile — virtual stick — move, jump button — jump, tap for action on buttons.

Key Features:
• Steal brainrots!: For diamonds, you can steal brainrots from other players!  
• Buy VIP shelters: Purchase VIP shelters to hide from the incoming wave faster!

Upgrades / Progression / Economy:
• Coins.: Upgrade your character's speed and your base with coins!  
• Diamonds.: A valuable currency that you can use to buy character skins, special brainrots, or even steal brainrots from other players! You can watch an ad right now to get your first diamonds.

Enemies / Bosses:
• Blue waves.: They move slower. You have more time to run further!  
• Green waves.: You better hurry, they are faster and won't wait long for you to grab your brainrot.  
• Red waves.: Run as fast as you can!!! It rushes faster than all, and you have little time!

Core Gameplay & Story  
Q: What is the goal of the game?  
A: Try to steal the most valuable brainrots before the wave catches you. You need to hurry!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?  
A: If you manage to grab a more expensive brainrot and go further — consider it a victory! Become richer than other players and you can make it onto the leaderboard of the wealthiest players!

Q: What grabs you in the first minutes?  
A: Different waves and the chance to run further! Each wave moves at a different speed, so you need to choose the best time to start. The further you go, the more expensive the brainrots, but the cost of mistakes increases. Those who are willing to take risks can gain much more!

Mechanics & Progression  
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?  
A: There is one large level in the game. You need to go further while dodging waves. The further you go, the more frequent the waves and the harder it is to return.

Q: Does the difficulty change?  
A: The further you go, the more frequent the waves and the harder it is to return. The cost of mistakes increases, but the rewards will not leave you indifferent.

Q: How can I level up faster?  
A: Steal the most expensive brainrots! They will bring you more coins, and you can upgrade your speed and run further!

Q: What unlocks as you play?  
A: Earn more money — you can upgrade your base and place more brainrots. More brainrots mean more money!

Economy & Customization  
Q: What can you buy/upgrade?  
A: Upgrade your speed and run further for more valuable brainrots! Buy VIP. You will need VIP shelters to avoid waves. Upgrade your base and place more brainrots. And if you don't want to run for a brainrot, steal it from other players for diamonds!

Q: Are there skins / customization?  
A: You can buy skins for your character. Running further and getting richer is better with style!

Retention & Engagement  
Q: Are there leaderboards and how do they work?  
A: Yes! Earn more gold and make it onto the list of the wealthiest players! You can also make it onto the list of the highest income.

Q: Is sound necessary?  
A: You can play without sound. The game is clear from the first minutes, you can play in a way that is comfortable for you.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What is it like?  
A: From the first minutes, you will immediately understand what you need to do. Convenient markers will help you not get lost.

A: Idle RPG with character leveling. You need to level up your character with random skills and defeat various enemies.

description:
A tropical island awaits where every piece of land is a battlefield. This is a third-person tactical action game with an open world. Your goal is to capture enemy bases and hold them under enemy pressure.

Master a diverse arsenal: assault rifles, sniper rifles, machine guns, grenades, and special equipment. Each weapon affects your combat style. In the store, you can purchase and upgrade equipment using resources earned in battles.

The island impresses with its variety: tropical beaches, palm groves, and fortified bases with unique architecture. Each base requires an individual approach. Act strategically – combine attacks and use the terrain.

A dynamic capture and defense system, thoughtful weapon balance, and large-scale battles await you. For fans of the Far Cry series and tactical shooters, this is the perfect project combining strategy and action.

title: Rooftop Run
description:
Rooftop Run – Race Across the City! 🏃‍♂️💨

Run, jump, and slide over rooftops in this fast-paced parkour game! Dodge obstacles, smash through barriers, and escape from enemies as you race through exciting levels.

Controls:
Desktop: Hold the right mouse button and direct your movement.
Mobile: Use your finger to direct your movement.

Key Features:
• Only Forward: Run forward and only forward! Don't stop. You control only the direction of movement; everything else happens automatically. But don't think this will make it easy — you'll need to make decisions on the fly!
• Don't Get Caught by Enemies: They will try to grab you. Be faster and smarter!

Core Gameplay & Story
Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: A true dynamic parkour experience! Run, jump from rooftop to rooftop, dive through skyscraper windows, roll, slide under obstacles, and run along walls! And of course, try not to get caught by enemies!

Q: How do you win / what counts as losing?
A: Try not to fall and avoid getting caught by enemies who will try to stop you!

Q: What grabs you in the first few minutes?
A: Insane dynamics! You run at high speed across rooftops, leap over obstacles, smash windows, roll, and at certain moments, you'll catch a stunning shot!

Mechanics & Progression
Q: How many levels are there / is the structure clear?
A: Levels follow one after another, each presenting different obstacles in a variety of variations!

Q: Does the difficulty change?
A: Each subsequent level is harder than the previous one. You'll need to test your reflexes!

Economy & Customization
Q: Are there skins / customization options?
A: Collect coins scattered throughout the levels to unlock various customization elements.

Retention & Engagement
Q: Is sound necessary?
A: Sound is not mandatory; play however you feel comfortable. However, turning it on will help you immerse yourself better in the dynamics.

Q: Is there onboarding in the game? What does it include?
A: At the start, you'll be shown everything essential. You'll immediately understand what to do.

Roll the ball towards the goal with a crazy kick soccer frenzy! Dodge the soccer stars to hit the super goal. Dribble your way towards your soccer strike & win the trophy. Are you ready for a crazy kick soccer game? 🤪

title: +1 SPEED: Escape School
description:
+1 SPEED: Escape School is an exciting parkour game with unique +1 to speed mechanics, where you have to escape from a school full of traps, challenges, and an evil teacher. 

With each step, your character becomes faster, and the levels become more difficult and dynamic. Test your reaction, agility, and speed of thinking in this exciting school adventure!

The game features a variety of levels with obstacles:
- moving platforms
- traps
- school corridors
- lava ball

Your task is to find a way out of the school while avoiding the evil teacher and dangers along the way. The further you go, the faster you get and the more interesting the gameplay becomes.

Game features:

🔹 Unique +1 to Speed mechanic - accelerate with every step

🔹 Exciting school-themed parkour

🔹 Traps, obstacles, and secret paths

🔹 Escape from the evil teacher and parkour challenges

🔹 Simple controls and dynamic gameplay

Can you complete all the levels and get out of school faster than anyone else?

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: It is a game where you have to escape from school by navigating multiple obstacle-filled levels. You'll need to jump across platforms, dodge teachers, and avoid various traps.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?

A: There are two currencies: diamonds and money. Both can be used to purchase new skins and upgrade your running speed.

A: Yes, the game includes in-app purchases. You can buy diamonds to unlock skins and upgrade your speed. Purchasing items does accelerate your progress.

title: Break a Tower: Obby
description:
"Break a Tower: Obby" - a demolition simulator in the spirit of the best obby modes!  
This unique obby mode combines dynamic gameplay with blocky sandbox elements.  

🏗️ Key Features:  
✅ Epic Demolition - destroy a tower floor by floor until complete annihilation! 
✅ Deep Progression - increase punch strength, endurance, and demolition speed! 
✅ Pet Collection - helpers boost destructive power and give unique bonuses! 
✅ Rebirth System - rebirth to earn more trophies! 
✅ Variety of Towers - from glass towers to reinforced concrete giants!

💥 What Awaits You:  
🎮 Recognizable obby gameplay - intuitive controls and mechanics!

🐉 Legendary Pets - mythical creatures to aid in destruction!  
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's essentially a clicker game where you tap to break through the floors of a tower, climbing higher to improve your stats and progress.

Q: What is the game's unique hook? What keeps players engaged?
A: The game features extensive meta-gameplay elements, including character upgrades, daily rewards, skins, and pets that provide various bonuses. It also includes an upgrade system, a fortune wheel, and multiple towers to provide a sense of progression. Additionally, there's a mini-idle mechanic where you can train to increase your strength; as your strength grows, you deal more damage to the tower floors, which also increase in HP as you go.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? How can you level up faster?
A: You need to train—specifically by doing push-ups—in a mini-idle style mechanic to increase your strength. Increasing your strength directly boosts the damage you deal to the tower floors.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: You earn coins that can be spent on pets. If you get duplicate pets, you can combine them. These pets act as collectibles and provide bonuses based on their rarity, specifically boosting the coins earned from breaking tower floors. You can save these coins to purchase higher-tier, higher-quality pets.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you change the hero's appearance?
A: Yes, there are various skins available for the character.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: Yes, the game features daily rewards.

Q: Is it better to play with sound for immersion, or is it playable without it?
A: Playing with sound is not required, but the audio is pleasant and not repetitive.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and how do you earn them?
A: There is a ""Trophy"" system. The stronger your character becomes, the more trophies you earn, which acts as a form of leaderboard. These trophies can eventually be exchanged to unlock access to other towers.

title: Fortress Clash
description:
Fixed the reported issue: progress was not restored after a reload.

Root cause: bridge.storage.get() returns the saved value already parsed as an object, while the game expected a JSON string and parsed it again, which threw and silently discarded the save.

Changes:
- storage.get() now accepts both shapes (object and string).
- The save is loaded BEFORE gameplay is shown: a loading screen is displayed and input is ignored until storage.get() resolves, so a fresh default save can no longer overwrite real progress during startup.
- Saves carry a revision counter, so after "finish a level, then buy an upgrade" the newest copy always wins instead of an older one at the same level.
- Any pending write is flushed on page hide / unload, so the last action before a reload is never lost.

Verified in the QA tool: state written before Reload game is fully restored after it.

Q: What is the game's hook? What will keep players engaged?

This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn. title: Geometry Vibes X-Arrow
description:
Geometry Vibes X Arrow is the newest evolution of the Geometry Vibes series, offering the most refined, competitive and customizable arrow experience so far. The goal is simple but demanding: guide your arrow through dangerous geometric paths, survive increasingly difficult patterns and reach the portal at the end of each route without touching anything. Every tap changes your altitude, every obstacle tests your timing and every mode challenges your mastery in different ways.

With five full game modes, multiplayer support, deep customization and endless replayability, Geometry Vibes X Arrow is designed for players who enjoy precise control, fast reactions and competitive challenges. Whether you are playing solo or competing against three friends on the same device, the game always feels fresh and pushes players toward improvement run after run.

What is the goal in Geometry Vibes X Arrow?
The main objective is to reach the portal without hitting any obstacle. Every game mode builds on this core idea with different variations and challenges.

How does Classic Mode differ from Spam Mode?
Classic Mode features handcrafted levels with fixed structures and increasing difficulty. Spam Mode is a survival challenge where the walls slowly close in. Players compare their longest survival times and try to extend their record on every attempt.

Is there local multiplayer?
Yes. You can play with 2 3 or 4 players on the same device. Each player uses separate keys. The race based competitive gameplay makes these modes fast and chaotic.

What can I do in Endless Mode?
Endless Mode is all about distance. The arrow accelerates and the level stretches infinitely. Your goal is to travel as far as possible before crashing. It is ideal for players who enjoy reaction based gameplay.

How difficult is Challenge Mode?
Challenge Mode contains five stages designed specifically for advanced players. These levels require strong timing, compact movements and consistent precision. Even small mistakes can end the run quickly.

What customization options are available?
You can unlock and equip arrow skins, trails and color combinations. With twenty four skins, sixteen trails and twenty four total color options, players can create many unique visual styles.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: Geometry Dash is a game where you need to progress through levels while avoiding obstacles.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game offers a variety of modes and challenges, being difficult and engaging.

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

Q: What are the engaging elements of content (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game itself is extremely popular and hooks players with its difficulty and challenges.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can change the player's shape and colors, with many skins available.


Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to incentivize players to return?
A: Yes, there are challenges.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse oneself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?
A: You can play without sound, but the music is designed and set up to make the player vibe to the max during the gaming session.


Multiplayer

Q: Can you play with friends?
A: Yes, but only offline on the same computer.

"Core: A high-stakes social deduction and resource management game set during a global zombie epidemic, where players must identify and neutralize infected individuals to secure the survival of the human race in an underground bunker.
Loop: Progression is driven by successful identification and correct processing of incoming individuals. Flawless daily performance (correctly determining the infected from the healthy) is rewarded with in-game currency, fostering a cycle of precision and reward.
Start: A comprehensive tutorial module ensures immediate accessibility and full comprehension of the core mechanics. The high-stakes premise—total responsibility for humanity's future—provides a powerful, immediate retention hook.
Playgama Fact: The game is fully integrated with Playgama SDK: instant login and cross-device saves between PC and mobile. HTML5. Stable performance regardless of internet quality.
Visual: Features a stylized, cartoon art direction.
Key Feature: A genre-defining blend of deduction mechanics, demanding constant vigilance from players to prevent a single missed symptom from compromising the entire bunker and ending humanity."

description: The game "Geometry Dash: Infinity" is an exciting arcade where you have to navigate through challenging and interesting obstacles and mazes, earning points in the process. Think you have the reaction time and agility of a cat? Well, let's find out! Enter the game and try to score more than anyone else.

title: Moto X3M Spooky Land
description:
Moto X3M: Spooky Land is a spooky Halloween edition of the popular bike racing series. Put on your helmet, hop on your motorbike, and ride through haunted tracks filled with creepy traps, bone-made obstacles, and eerie surprises. Speed is key – beat the clock while avoiding deadly hazards and pulling off flips to save precious time!

The controls are simple – use the arrow keys to accelerate, brake, and tilt your bike for smooth landings. Each of the 32 levels introduces new spooky challenges, making the game both thrilling and tricky. For fans of off-road biking and Halloween fun, Moto X3M: Spooky Land is the perfect ride!

title: Game of Warrior
description:
Game of Warriors is a Strategy TD (Tower Defense) game with a unique style in its genre. Set in a magical world you will have to upgrade your defenses and mighty soldiers to survive and siege enemy territories to conquer them.

The rival alliance of the evil kingdoms has pushed what remains of the human civilization to a corner of the world, isolated and forgotten, plunged into misery and trying to survive harshly.

Ready the horses, hire your warriors and prepare the spears for battle, the war horn will sound again and our titans will destroy the enemy walls and towers.

The age of dark empires have come to an end, it's time to recover what rightfully belongs to us, it's time for revolt, war and revenge!

Features:

- Tower Defense (TD) and Strategy game style.
- 1500+ defensive waves.
- 100+ territories to conquer.
- 30+ soldiers to upgrade.
- 1000+ building upgrades.
- 4 different races to conquer (Goblins, Skeletons, Worgens and Orcs).

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: It's a strategic Tower Defense game. You need to upgrade your soldiers, fortress, and attack other territories, turning them into your colonies.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game that can hook players?

A: It's a strategic Tower Defense game with over 30 soldiers to upgrade, over 1000 building upgrades, 4 different races to defeat (goblins, skeletons, worgens, and orcs), and a unique upgrade tree.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: Are there bosses, and how are they different?

A: Yes, every 10 waves you face a well-organized army of bosses that are more challenging than regular units.

Economy & Customization

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: Yes, the game has currencies: gold and diamonds. You can use them to upgrade towers, warriors, attack lands, improve weapons, and more.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: Earn coins by defeating enemies and collecting coins from colonies we have conquered. Use these coins to level up your warriors and structures.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what is the impact? Does making a donation speed up game progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases where you can buy diamonds. These diamonds can be used to purchase numerous upgrades. Donations speed up game progress.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game well, but it is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Drifting Car Master
description:
Rush into the world of speed, adrenaline and dangerous turns! 🔥

Welcome to Drifting Car Master — an extreme racing game where every turn is a challenge and every meter is a fight for leadership!

🏎️ Compete with the best drifters around the world! Take part in exciting races on open tracks, where only skill, precise timing and a perfectly balanced skid will bring victory.

But be careful — the police are always there! On the highway, it's not just speed that rules, but also risk. Patrols are hunting for those who are too fast cutting through the streets. Can you get away from the chase? Or will the cops catch you sooner?

, Game Features:

- Arcade physics and controls for perfect drift
- A variety of cars
- Dynamic chases with the police
- Car upgrade and customization to suit your style

Are you ready to win at any cost — even if you have to evade the law?

title: Hero Merge
description: Merge brave and deadly heroes together to create even deadlier ones. Defend your base from monsters by placing your heroes on the wall

title: Animal Royal
description:
"The ultimate player versus player game allows players to engage in battles against their opponents using unique animals."
You'll be challenged to use your wits and strategy to outsmart your opponents and emerge victorious.
Animal Royal is a game that features a wide variety of animals and birds, each with its unique strengths and weaknesses.
Your goal is to protect your meat from being eaten by your opponent's animals while sending your animals to eat as much meat as possible to win the battle.
- Unique animal and bird with different abilities and strengths
- Engaging and colorful graphics with intuitive controls
- Intense player vs player battles on a battlefield
- You can merge two animals to level up and create a more powerful animal card
- Win the battle and collect more cups
- Compete for glory and rewards!
- Daily challenges and rewards for players

Animal Battle Royale is an exciting game that offers a new twist on the popular player-versus-player genre.
So if you're ready to take on the ultimate animal battle and emerge as the king of the jungle, join the Animal Royal game today!

title: Road Fury
description: Unleash your fury on the highway an shoot down everything that moves! Tip: if you can't shoot it, take it... those are power-ups! Upgrade your car to withstand a longer ride, beat bosses and get as far as you can so you can compare your highscores with others! Become the furious king of the road!

title: Plants Vs Steal Brainrots
description:
Welcome to 🌱 Plants Vs Steal Brainrots🌱 — an exciting base-defense game where you build your own army of plants and fight off waves of annoying brainrots!

🪴 Buy seeds, plant them in your garden, and watch as your plants automatically enter battle, protecting your territory. Every defeated enemy is turned into 💸 profit, which you can use to upgrade and purchase new types of plants.

🌻 Unlock epic plants, combine different tactics, and experiment with defense setups to create the perfect base-protection strategy. With every step, your garden grows stronger while brainrot waves become more challenging, making progression even more rewarding.

🧠 Collect and capture brainrots! Hunt for different species, discover rare and unique creatures, complete your full collection, and earn extra rewards for every new catch.

👍 Don’t forget to like the game.

💻 Available on PC and mobile devices!

title: Last Knight:kings throne
description:
This is a casual dodge arcade escape game. Play as a cute little character and keep escaping from chasing monsters on the random map. It perfectly combines fast-paced evasion gameplay, random buff items and fresh cartoon art style, bringing you relaxing and thrilling spare-time fun!

Game Highlights
Flexible free movement: Drag to control your character freely and change directions anytime to avoid incoming monsters.Random pickup buff system: Collect randomly spawned props including speed boost and monster freeze to get away from dangerous encirclement.Progressive difficulty curve: More monsters spawn and their moving speed rises continuously as your survival time extends.

Game Advantages
Easy risk avoidance tactics: Use terrain space to circle monsters and prolong your survival time for higher scores.No complicated rules: Pure casual design without tedious tutorials, instantly jump into matches after opening the game.Unlimited endless mode: Keep challenging your personal best score repeatedly for higher leaderboard rankings.

Game Features
Simple intuitive operation: Support drag control on mobile and mouse control on PC, all players can master in seconds.Compact random maps: Every round generates slightly different monster spawn positions to enrich replay experience.Lightweight instant play: Run smoothly in all browsers with zero download and installation required.

title: Long Drive to Horizons Sim
description:
Long Drive to Horizons Sim throws you into an epic desert survival adventure! This open-world simulator blends the freedom of a sandbox with high-octane racing and intense shooter action. Strap in as you pilot a lone vehicle across endless, unforgiving dunes.

🚗 Build & Customize
Gather parts and resources to assemble your dream ride. Mix and match bodies, engines, and wheels to craft a unique off-roader. Deep repair mechanics mean every bolt and circuit counts.

🔧 Maintenance & Upgrades
Keep your car battle-ready: refuel, swap out worn components, and unlock performance boosts. Hone your mechanic skills to tackle each rugged challenge.

🔍 Scavenge & Loot
Roam abandoned camps, crashed caravans, and derelict garages for vital supplies. Scavenge weapon parts, ammunition, and crafting materials in a richly detailed sandbox.

🏁 Dune Racing
Race across dozens of kilometers of treacherous desert tracks. Balance fuel, speed, and durability as you outpace rivals in blistering competitions.

title: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner
description: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner is a dynamic HTML5 browser game that delivers an engaging arcade challenge. As a talented sword fighter, you'll cut through numerous foes, perfect for both ninja enthusiasts and action game lovers.

title: Rainbow Friends. Survival
description: In this intense survival game you find yourself trapped in a haunted environment where you must endure five days and five nights against relentless monster encounters. Each night brings bloodthirsty creatures that stalk the shadows, turning every step into a heart?pounding horror challenge. To succeed you must complete mission objectives quickly, perform precise actions, and stay one step ahead of the terrifying foes. Master fast?paced gameplay by learning how to hide, escape, and use the environment to avoid detection while conserving your stamina. Follow proven strategies and tips for night survival to outsmart the monsters and emerge victorious.

title: King Rugni Tower Defense
description:
A classic Tower Defense game with lots of enemies and territories to conquer. Join King Rügni on his epic adventure against hordes of elementals.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's a tower defense game where you need to place and upgrade towers that shoot at enemies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The game features a cool character - King Rugni, several maps with different themes like forests and winter settings, great design, music, and effects. There are different types of enemies with various attack styles - some walk directly on the path while others fly straight to the target.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what are they used for (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Every defeated enemy rewards us with gems used for building new towers. There is also gold earned by winning levels, which is spent on upgrading existing towers and purchasing new ones.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: To level up faster, you need to win levels by defeating enemies and completing all waves. This earns you gold that can be spent on tower upgrades and new purchases.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what is the impact? Does paying accelerate game progress?
A: No.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are available (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: No.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: The game stands out with its excellent design and music.

Q: Is there any customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: No.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar to encourage players to return?
A: No.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: It is preferable to play with sound because it enhances the experience.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, "match-three" puzzles within a strategy game.
A: No.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (dash if unclear)
A: 30

title: Merge Guns
description: Merge Guns is a tower-defense and merge hybrid built on a single grid. Buy guns with gold, drag identical tiers together to merge them into stronger weapons, and defend against alien waves crawling in from the right. Eight gun tiers, persistent upgrades, boss waves, achievements, English and Russian localization, and run-to-run progression make every defense a new layout puzzle.

title: Knight Legend
description: Knight Legend invites you to dive into an epic quest where you fight monsters, upgrade your gear, and unlock new levels. As you progress, youll earn money to buy powerful armors and loyal pets to aid you in your journey.

title: Noob saves a girl: A Story
description: Join an exciting rescue adventure in "Noob Saves a Girl," a free online game. Take on the role of a passionate hero trying to save his love from a cunning villain. Enjoy thrilling battles and strategic challenges on your phone or computer in captivating settings.

title: Geometry Vibes X-Ball
description:
Geometry Vibes X-Ball is ready to give you a completely different gaming experience! After the first game of the series, interactive new levels, challenge section and completely new store are waiting for you in X-Ball mode. Start your new adventure now in Geometry Vibes X-Ball game where you will find yourself avoiding obstacles, traps and gears in each level!

What are Geometry Vibes X-Ball Game Modes?
Classic Mode: Try to reach the portals at the end of a total of 10 levels that get harder as the levels pass. The last 3 levels are quite challenging!
Endless Mode: Try to go as far as you can without hitting obstacles and traps.
Challenge Mode: Challenging stages designed for master players are located in this section. Prove how good a Geometry Vibe X-Ball player you are with 5 different challenge levels.
Race Mode: You can compete with your friends locally by playing levels with 2-3-4 player.

Is Geometry Vibes X-Ball a Difficult Game?
Geometry Vibes X-Ball is definitely not a difficult game and you can complete 10 levels in the classic section if you practice enough.


Can Geometry Vibes X-Ball be played on mobile devices?
Yes, you can play the game smoothly on your mobile devices such as tablets and phones. The game has simple touch controls and you only need to touch the screen to play.

title: War V: Path of the Survivor!
description:
War Z: Path of the Survivor! - Story-driven first-person shooter. Go through the story, buy weapons, install various modules on them.

A first-person action shooter.

As a result of the man-made disaster, most of humanity was infected with a dangerous virus... which turns people into zombies

The survivors were forced to form paramilitary groups...

Who knows, maybe it's up to you to find the antidote to the virus and save humanity...

- The world of the zombie apocalypse.
- An exciting storyline.
- Hordes of zombies from the simplest to the mutated.
- A variety of weapons from the real world.
- Various weapon modules and a leveling system.

title: War V: Path of the Survivor!
description:
War Z: Path of the Survivor! - Story-driven first-person shooter. Go through the story, buy weapons, install various modules on them.

A first-person action shooter.

As a result of the man-made disaster, most of humanity was infected with a dangerous virus... which turns people into zombies

The survivors were forced to form paramilitary groups...

Who knows, maybe it's up to you to find the antidote to the virus and save humanity...

- The world of the zombie apocalypse.
- An exciting storyline.
- Hordes of zombies from the simplest to the mutated.
- A variety of weapons from the real world.
- Various weapon modules and a leveling system.

title: Mr Shooter
description:
Mr Shooter, a Balloon popping desert plant on a mission... A mission to pop all the Balloons in the world!
The objective is simple: Pop all the Balloons to win!
Unlock and select new powerful cards as you progress through the game. With hundreds of creative and varied levels, this game will keep you entertained for hours.

title: Collect Brainrot Egg
description:
Collect Brainrot Egg takes the classic collect Brainrot loop and flips it into an egg-hatching economy race. Play in 1 Player or 2 Player mode, buy mystery eggs from the center conveyor, carry them back to your base, and wait for them to hatch into random Brainrot characters! The better your lineup, the faster you generate coins, and the sooner you can afford the rarest eggs.

Egg Rarities (Lowest → Highest)
Basic, Rare, Super Rare, Void, Prismatic, SlyFox, Angel, Bonedragon, Hypertech, Firestorm, Diamond!
High-tier eggs appear much less often, but they can hatch into much more valuable Brainrots.

Core Gameplay:
Eggs spawn randomly on the conveyor. If you have enough money, buy an egg and bring it to your base. After the egg’s hatch timer finishes, your Brainrot appears and starts producing coins. Build your income step by step, then jump into higher tiers to chase the best pulls.

Of course, it’s not just farming. Defend your base from thieves by keeping it closed, or catch the rival mid-steal and hit them to save your Eggs and Brainrots. Feeling bold? You can also raid other bases and steal their loot.

title: Mine Block Party: World of Minigames
description:
In this game you will plunge into the exciting world of mini-games!

- Competitive spirit: for every victory you receive cups and coins, which you can spend on buying new skins or improving your character. Fight for the championship and become the most skilled player!

- Variety of skins: the ability to choose any skin, which includes characters from popular games, cartoons, as well as famous YouTubers. Let your character look the way you want!

- Variety of modes: the possibility to choose one of three modes, in one of which you will have to try your luck and choose the right path, and in the other you will have to show your dexterity and wit!

- Character upgrade: upgrade your character’s skills, making him faster and more agile in battles. Each victory brings not only pleasure, but also the opportunity to improve your hero.

Can you become the best in this game? Embark on an exciting adventure with your favorite characters!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What needs to be done?

A: Mini-games with block-style gameplay similar to Minecraft.

Q: What is the game's unique feature? How can it hook players?

A: The game offers a variety of games, unique skins, character progression, and rewards like cups and coins for each victory.

Q: Are there any currencies and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game features coins and diamonds as currencies, which can be spent on skins and character upgrades.

Q: What is the leveling up process like? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, players need to earn more money for purchasing upgrades by playing more and winning!

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game makes references to the world of Minecraft.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the hero's appearance, location editor, car tuning, etc.?

A: Yes, the game offers various skins for customization.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?

A: Music complements the game, but it is not necessary for progression.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.

A: The entire game is a collection of mini-games.

title: Stack Ball 3D
description: Break through countless platforms with the ball, but avoid hitting black spots or you'll lose. Try to hit as many platforms as you can to gain speedboost and become unstoppable

title: Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!
description:
Welcome to "Poppy 4! Cut Monsters with Sword in Arena!" - an exciting action game with a sword, where you fight against an army of monsters! Get ready for an epic battle and test your agility and blade skill. Survive in the monsters' lair and become a real sword master!

🎮 A game inspired by popular projects such as "War of the Knights: Sword Arena Battle 3D", "Sword Master: Slash Enemies!" and "Swing Sword: Slash Enemies into Pieces!" Here you will find a mix of the themes of "poppy playtime", "rainbow friends", "hagi wagi", "repo" and the atmosphere of the "Dendy World"!

⚔️ Game Features:
- Simple and clear controls
- Stylish 3D graphics in retro dandy and repo style
- Exciting gameplay with chopping enemies
- Various levels and enemy characters
- A large selection of sword skins
- A leaderboard where you can compete with friends

⚡ Ready to join the fight? Then take your sword and start the battle with monsters!

title: Cannon Balls
description: Try to be the master of destruction, heat up the buildings neatly and show no mercy! In 'Cannon Balls 3D' it depends on how skillfully you place the shots so that the structures collapse as efficiently as possible. Watch your ammo, because it's limited. But don't worry. There will also come a time when you will bring the cannon to the edge of functionality. Especially when the great bombs are used. So what are you waiting for?

title: Police Car Simulator Game Criminal Case
description: Step into the world of law enforcement with the Police Game. The Ultimate Cop Simulator, the ultimate combination of police parking, racing, open-world exploration, and crime-fighting missions. Experience the life of a real officer from learning in the police training academy to chasing down dangerous criminals in the streets. This is not just a police simulator, it’s a full city experience that gives you freedom, control, and thrill in every mode.

title: Bobr turbo: craft cars
description:
Dive into a world where imagination meets destruction! In this action-packed builder game, your mission is clear: create, upgrade, and dominate. Construct powerful battle machines from a wide variety of blocks, customize them to your style, craft new parts, and prove your engineering skills in intense arena showdowns.

💡 Create Your Own War Machines

With an arsenal of blocks, boosters, and weapons at your fingertips, design machines that are as deadly as they are unique. Upgrade your parts to make your builds tougher, faster, and more destructive!

🛠️ Craft, Customize, Compete

Collect loot from chests to enhance your arsenal and push your creativity to the limit. Fine-tune your machines to outperform the competition!

🔥 Outsmart and outbuild your rivals. Wreck your enemies in spectacular auto-battles and rise to the top. Only the best engineers will claim victory!

Are you ready for the challenge? Prove your skills, show off your creativity, and become the ultimate battle machine builder!

title: Battle Hamsters
description: You play as a squad of fighting hamsters. You need to destroy the enemy squad. Take turns shooting at the enemy, unlock new levels, hamsters and locations.

title: Geometry: Black Wave
description:
“Geometry: Black Wave” is a musical platformer game in which the player controls a small arrow, overcoming various obstacles and hurdles on the way to the finish line. The game features black and white graphics and an exciting soundtrack that is synchronized with the gameplay.

The game offers many levels of varying difficulty, each with its own unique music. The player must react quickly to obstacles and move in the right direction to reach the end of the level.

“Geometry: Black Wave” is a game that requires the player to react quickly and move accurately. It is suitable for all ages and skill levels, and can be a great way to pass the time and have fun.

title: Mad Truck Challenge Special
description:
Mad Truck Challenge Special is a racing game where you try to destroy and overtake your opponents with your monster truck. 
Race and finish all the levels in different exotic places on the planet, like Egypt, Pompeii and Antarctica. 
Shoot rockets and hit opponents, or speed up using nitro to overtake them. Earn coins, buy new cars and upgrade their engines, rockets, nitro, absorbers and more! 
Unlock custom decals and rams to create your unique Mad Truck. Give the wheel of fortune a spin to unlock even more.
Race, destroy and overtake, and become the Mad Truck master

title: Truck Slam
description: Two monster trucks. Two spinning maces. One survives. Smash enemies in single-player or duel a friend in 2-player mode on the same screen. Win battles, collect cogs, upgrade your wheels, body and mace — and keep slamming.

title: Agent Sniper City
description: Agent Sniper City is a high-stakes sniper game where you step into the role of an elite sharpshooter. Perched atop towering buildings, your mission is to eliminate dangerous criminals with precision shots. Use your skills to aim, scope, and execute targets while scanning the city for new threats. Stay focused—the fate of the city rests in your hands!

title: Blade & Bedlam
description: A top-down, physics-based, medieval melee fighter! Block projectiles and melee attack with your weapons and try to hit the enemies! Survive for as long as you can by dodging attacks, quickly killing enemies and buying items form the shop between rounds!

title: Warrior Bee Apocalypse
description:
Warrior Bee Apocalypse is an action and upgrade game.
The warrior bee faces hordes of enemy insects to survive.
Collecting diamonds to improve your items and skills.

title: PLAYMUSIC
description:
PlayMusic turns your favorite songs into a living, reactive game world where every beat shapes the action. Dodge obstacles, collect gems, and stay alive as the rhythm intensifies around you. Run, jump, fly, drift, and shoot your way through dynamic environments that pulse with the music. Stay in the zone, keep the groove alive, and master the rhythm to survive.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It is a collection of runners with a lot of licensed music that is constantly updated. Each runner features one super popular track.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no specific storyline, just enjoy your favorite music while playing the runner.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The huge library of licensed music. A vast variety of runners and music games.

Q: Are there bosses in the game and how are they different?
A: There are no bosses, but the game's difficulty adapts to the music and player's skill.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: There are no currencies, everything is available from the start.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: There is no leveling up, only the player's skill grows.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making purchases speed up game progress?
A: There are no in-game purchases, everything is available from the start with soft monetization through ads.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: There are leaderboards, you need to complete runner-songs and earn points.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: A wide range of licensed and popular music.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Each song-game has its own hero.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to come back?
A: Regular updates to games and songs.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: Playing with sound is a must, it's the game's unique feature. There is a lot of good and licensed music.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.
A: A huge variety of musical and rhythm games.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (skip if unclear)
A: The number of levels constantly increases.

title: Daddy Escape
description:
Get ready for an Epic Puzzle adventure like no other! Daddy Escape - Pull the Pin is here to challenge your wits, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills. Help Daddy make his daring escape by pulling the right pins and overcoming a series of mind-bending obstacles.

Who is Daddy? Well, he's not your ordinary dad! Daddy is an adventurous and fearless explorer who always finds himself in tricky situations. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to guide Daddy through a maze of perilous traps, ingenious contraptions, and devious puzzles. Can you lead Daddy to safety?

title: StreetRacer: Realistic Destruction
description:
Experience the ultimate car destruction mayhem! 

In "StreetRacer: Realistic Destruction", you have complete freedom in a vast open world environment. Wreck cars in spectacular ways – watch parts fly off, witness realistic damage, and see wheels go flying in epic crashes.

Key Features:
- Advanced car customization options
- Full exterior customization
- Wheel and suspension tuning
- Destruction tools galore
- Interactive press and ramp areas
- Dynamic traffic simulation
- Realistic damage physics

Explore, destroy, and create your own challenges in this ultimate car destruction playground!

title: Kingdom Defense
description: Defend your kingdom in this epic online tower defense strategy game! Command warriors, cast spells, and battle fantasy monsters. Build your army and lead the conquest - action and adventure await!

title: Kingdom Defense
description: Defend your kingdom in this epic online tower defense strategy game! Command warriors, cast spells, and battle fantasy monsters. Build your army and lead the conquest - action and adventure await!

title: Jim's World: Adventure Games
description:
Jim's World gives you the chance to step back in time to your childhood with the legendary challenge in the adventure game: Princess Rescue. The World of this Game - a totally new old-school running game, contains well-designed levels, various enemies, super bosses, simple gameplay, excellent graphics, and soothing music and sounds.
Jim's World has been nothing and empty since the Princess got kidnapped into the jungle. But then, the adventure begins!
Your task is to help Jim run through the mysterious jungle, jump over the obstacles and super evil monsters, and save the beautiful Princess at the adventure's final destination

title: Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!
description:
⚔️ Welcome to "Ragdoll Battle Royale! Throw Down the Enemy!" - a fun 3D physics arena where ragdoll opponents fight in funny fights! Push, throw and knock enemies off the platform to be the only one left standing. This battle royale is a real epic action with falls, collisions and pushes!

🔥 Inspired by the popular hits "Epic Sword Fight! Fight in the Ragdoll Arena!" and "Balance Duel: Physics Action", this game combines simple mechanics, playground dynamics, and a lot of fun!

♥️ Don't forget to leave a review and share your impressions to help us improve the game!

Game features:
- Beautiful and pleasant 3D graphics
- Simple one-finger control
- Fun short levels in the style of shorts and reels
- Funny ragdoll physics
- Online leaderboard
- The game is available online for free on PC and mobile devices

🎯 Become a legend of the ragdoll arena - throw off all enemies and become a winner!

title: Block Shooter: Shoot the Blocks!
description:
Destroy blocks with an ever-growing arsenal of powerful weapons. Earn coins, unlock new guns, and upgrade them to deal even more damage.

Level up each weapon with unique upgrade cards. Once it reaches Level 10, it keeps firing automatically while you use to another weapon.

Build the ultimate arsenal and destroy blocks faster than ever.

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description:
Hyper Cars Ramp Crash is a 3D driving stunt and crash simulation game with realistic physics and graphics. Perform incredible stunts in many different modes with great-looking cars. There are seven different super-sport car models in the garage, waiting in the garage for you to try them. Open world, stunt mode, and fall mode can be played in 1-player and 2-players. You can also drive freely in Free Style mode. Have fun with these fantastic-looking cars!

Features
Realistic car crash physics (Cars get crushed and smashed)
Customize option for cars
1 Player Mode and 2 Players Mode available
Realistic car interior camera
Drive freely and perform stunts in Free Style mode
Crazy Fall Break mode!
Side Road, Forest, Ocean, Desert Stunt Modes
Race against time with Time Trial mode
Unique damage machines in modes

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You need to hit the anvil and increase your strength. The higher the character's strength, the higher the attack power, and the faster the walls break.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making purchases speed up game progress?
A: Yes, there are VIP statuses that significantly speed up progress. There is an option to disable ads. There is a doubling of strength.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can fully customize everything about your character, including weapons.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: Yes, there are leaderboards for broken walls and regenerations of all time. You can access them by breaking walls and progressing in the game to activate regeneration.

title: Deorbit - Space Survivors
description:
Deorbit is a fast-paced top-down space survivor shooter. You command a lone starship stranded in hostile sectors, and wave after wave of enemy swarms close in from every direction. Your weapons fire automatically — your job is to fly, dodge, and stay alive as the horde grows.
Vacuum up glowing XP orbs to level up mid-run, then choose from a hand of upgrade cards to shape your build on the fly — more firepower, drones, shields, and devastating new abilities. Crack open chests that drop into the battlefield for extra loot, push through 10 escalating phases per sector, and brace for massive boss encounters that can turn the tide.
Every run earns gold. Spend it back at your hangar to permanently upgrade your ship, unlock new vessels, and gear up before diving back in. Claim daily rewards, chase new records, and see how deep into the sectors you can survive. No two runs play the same.
Think you can beat your best score? Suit up, Commander.
Tips
Grab XP orbs to level up, then pick the upgrade cards that fit your build.
Open chests for bonus drones, cells, and items during a run.
Spend gold in the hangar between runs to make your ship permanently stronger.
Survive to face the sector boss — beating it pushes you deeper.

title: Air Assault: Ship Defense

Man a twin AA gun on a WW2 destroyer and shoot down waves of diving planes before they sink your ship. Air Assault puts you in the splinter tub of a wartime destroyer — twin barrels, open ocean, and enemy aircraft diving straight at your deck. Aim with the crosshair, manage gun heat, and cut down fighters before they reach the hull.

Stages ramp up fast: denser swarms, faster dives, bombers and armored blimps on high flyovers, and kamikazes that don’t turn away. Planes shoot back. Bombs fall. One bad miss and the ship goes down.

Upgrade your mount between runs, climb the stages, and hold the line as the sky fills with incoming fire. Simple controls, sharp 3D action — pure anti-aircraft mayhem in the middle of the Pacific.
