title: Towers 505
description:
Demonstrate your strategy of indestructible defense by erecting towers to stop the hordes of monsters trying to break through your line; not only strength is important here, but also intelligence, because each wave of monsters requires new tactics, improvements and the perfect location of towers.
This browser-based tower defense game features a classic 2D top-down perspective with stylized cartoon art. Players defend a winding orange path by strategically placing various defense turrets, such as wooden crossbow towers and stone fortifications, to stop waves of approaching monsters emerging from a dark purple abyss. The core gameplay loop involves spending earned gold coins to build and upgrade structures, periodically clicking to activate magical spells like fireballs and frost blasts to slow down or destroy enemies. Progression is level-based, with ten locked stages visible on the level selection screen. The visual style is bright and vibrant, dominated by a green grassy field, stone walls, and brown autumnal trees, all rendered with thick outlines and flat colors. The UI is comprehensive, displaying a gold coin counter, a kill tally with a skull icon, a health heart indicating ten lives, and an bottom bar with available building or spell buttons. Defensive gameplay is punctuated by varied enemy types including ground-based green slugs and fast-moving white flying monsters. The tone is casual and accessible for all ages, though strategic depth increases with environmental challenges like rain that buffs enemy strength. Losing all ten lives results in a failure screen, prompting the player to retry the stage or return to the main menu.

title: The Mad Cow
description: One day Dasha the cow went crazy and ran away from home. She ran into the city and started destroying everything. The cow's task is to destroy everything. Destroy buildings with horns and weapons, get points, fly a helicopter, drive a car. Remember, the police will be chasing you.

title: Robby The Lava Tsunami
description: Robby The Lava Tsunami is an exciting free-to-play online game where you race against a flowing lava wave. Enjoy a colorful setting, unique skills, and endless customization options. Perfect for fans of speed and acrobatics, it’s accessible on iOS, Android, and desktop. Test your skills and strive for victory!

title: Tiny Arena
description: Tiny Arena is a fast, one-thumb dungeon crawler. Battle through monster-filled rooms, grab a fresh upgrade at every door, and push as deep as you can. Fight across five themed worlds, spend coins on permanent upgrades in the meta-shop, and take on an Endless mode with a global leaderboard. Move to dodge, stand still to auto-fire — easy to pick up, tough to master

title: Ammo Rush Master
description:
Get ready to run, multiply, and blast your way to victory in Ammo Rush Master!
Dodge obstacles, choose the right gates, and build the biggest Ammo army of bullets. Then, grab your blaster and unleash a storm of foam darts to smash through targets, enemies, and bosses!

? Features

Addictive hyper-casual gameplay – easy to play, hard to master.

Fun math gates that boost or reduce your army.

Colorful worlds: beach, city, rainbow skies, desert, and more.

Huge variety of Ammo-style blasters to unlock and upgrade.

Exciting boss battles at the end of each world.

Smooth controls and satisfying shooting effects.

⚡ Can you become the ultimate Ammo Rush Master and blast your way to the top? Download now and find out!

title: World War Camp Company
description:
Develop your camp and fight the invaders!

In your battle camp you can upgrade your troops, buy military equipment, and improve your weapons.
Buy jeeps, tanks, hire squads of fighters!

Next, boldly lead your blue troops into battle!

Go through all locations, defeat all opponents!
Blue vs. Red in this exciting game of squad battles!

- Several locations
- A large number of upgrades
- Different types of equipment
- Interesting enemies
- Several types of bosses!


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an idle game where you need to gather troops and attack the enemy camp.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no specific storyline, but the tasks are clear.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: There are few games with such high quality, well-balanced gameplay and fast-paced action.

Q: Are there bosses in the game and how are they different?
A: Bosses appear every few levels. They are big, tough enemies that mark the end of a level cycle.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: There are two currencies: gold helmets and silver helmets. They are spent on upgrading troops.

Q: How does the upgrading system work? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You need to collect more helmets to upgrade the appearance and stats of your soldiers and vehicles.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there captivating elements of content (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are references to action movies.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, the player's skin can be customized.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: Sound in the game is not mandatory.

title: Fristailo Granny!
description:
She's not sitting on a bench, she's dancing on the highway, jumping over trucks, doing ambulance stunts, and giving out style at every turn!

🎮 Features:
Freestyle on the go: dance, improvise right on a busy highway.

Crazy combos: Be constantly on the move to score maximum points!

A variety of levels: the higher the level, the more difficult and mystical it is!

Compete with your friends to score the most freestyle points!

title: Camel Destroyer
description:
A camel has appeared in the city and is looking for adventures! In the game, you will have to help the camel find animals, chat with people, and explore the city. 
Look for hidden machines, guns, cannons, and grenades to destroy buildings and create chaos. Drive cars, operate a helicopter, and even saddle a turtle or a cow for unforgettable adventures. 
Ready for crazy antics and unpredictable situations? Then join the camel on its exciting journey around the city!

title: Red and Blue Snipers
description:
Welcome to the game, inspired by all the famous esports games, where you have to become a real sniper, honing your skills and composure. There are several types of maps in the game, each of which offers unique tactical opportunities and combat conditions.

The game was inspired by the famous sniper modes from such iconic games as CS and Standoff 2, which guarantees a deep and balanced gameplay focused on precision and tactical thinking.

Improve your shooting and tactical skills, study the maps and behavior of opponents, compete with other players from all over the world and feel the real spirit of esports in each intense duel.

For successful matches, you gain experience to increase your rank in the overall leaderboard, as well as in-game currency that can be spent on buying new deadly weapons.

title: Gun Baron
description:
Become the boss of the arms business! You're a red panda building an empire in a world ruled by raccoon bandits. Set up production: install machines, craft pistols, assault rifles, and dynamite, sell to customers, and save up for your dream.
But the road to riches is dangerous. Hostile raccoons regularly raid your base. Buy tougher weapons, upgrade your stats, and keep your paw on the trigger to protect your conveyor belts and warehouse.
Key features:
• Engaging production system
• Dynamic real-time shootouts
• Living economy: satisfy customers and defend them from raccoons
• Vibrant world with signature humor
• Clear goal: accumulate capital, build a rocket, and blast off!
• Upgrade your skills and buy better gear
Every gun sold brings you closer to that dream rocket. Every raid is a test, every dollar a step toward the sky. Run your factory, repel attacks, and become a legend. Launch Gun Baron now — your journey to the stars starts here! 🚀

title: Destructive Car Crash Simulator
description:
All cars can be broken, dented and destroyed! Realistic car damage and deformation system.
Arrange police chases - hit a police car and it will start hunting for you.
Crash test of cars - watch their destruction. All the destruction of cars has a realistic simulation.
Different maps and cars.
A lot of crashing props - cannons, catapults, hummers, presses etc.

title: Abandoned Mansion
description:
Abandoned Mansion is a first-person horror game set in an abandoned mansion, where a distress call leads you to investigate. Upon arrival, you realize it’s too late.
The game features item interaction, challenging puzzles, and terrifying monsters.

Features:

Optimized 3D graphics and realistic sound effects
Immersive and thrilling music
Multiple levels to test your skills
Variety of enemy types
Boss fights
Puzzles to solve
Exploration of the abandoned building
Hidden rooms and items
"Abandoned Mansion" will test your courage and survival skills. Can you unravel the mansion's mystery and face its monstrous inhabitants? Play now to find out.

title: Grass Defense
description: Grass Defense is a strategic tower defense where you must protect the wilderness from waves of fierce creatures. Build and upgrade powerful towers, manage resources, and adapt your tactics as enemies grow stronger. With dynamic environments, diverse foes, and challenging levels, you’ll test your strategy and skill to survive the untamed wilds and uncover hidden mysteries.

title: Italian Brainrot GT Highway Racing
description:
Start your engine and lose your mind in Italian Brainrot GT Highway Racing — the most chaotic racing experience ever! 🇮🇹💥

Drift through endless highways, dodge traffic, and feel the pure brainrot energy of Italian-style chaos. From over-the-top cars to wild memes, it’s not just racing — it’s madness on wheels!

title: Kings Defense: Roguelike
description:
Kings Defense: Roguelike — Defend the Kingdom!

The kingdom is under threat! Enemies are advancing, and only your cannon can stop their onslaught. Kings Defense is a dynamic blend of classic block-breaker and roguelike, where every shot counts.

How to Play?
Your goal is to destroy monsters by launching chains of balls. They ricochet off walls and enemies, dealing damage. But be careful: opponents move toward the castle walls and strike back. Survive all 20 waves and defeat the final boss!

Features:

Unique Builds: Break open chests and choose skills — from lightning to splitting balls. Each run offers a new set of abilities.

Combo System: Hitting enemies with balls fills the combo meter, granting bonuses to damage and healing.

Tower Upgrades: Spend coins in the main menu to increase damage, add more balls, and boost HP.

Varied Enemies: Fight ghosts, "dodging" monsters, and cunning bosses.

Level up, combine skills, and become a legendary defender. Your kingdom awaits!

title: Obby: Escape from Tsunami Brainrot
description: A dynamic parkour game where you have to overcome obstacles and escape from the oncoming tsunami. Reaction, speed and accuracy decide everything!

title: Turbo Stunt Racing
description: Experience high-speed thrills in Turbo Stunt Racing! Perform epic stunts, race fierce rivals, and upgrade unique cars in this 3D arcade racer packed with action, traps, and ramps. Master precision driving and dominate every level!

title: Laser Survivor
description:
Laser Survivor, a cyberpunk roguelike action-adventure set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse, the last hope for humanity rests in the hands of five heroes fighting hordes of demons pouring through a dimensional rift. Featuring pixel art visuals, randomized weapons, chiptune soundtracks, and relentless survival gameplay, every run is a test of adaptation and skill.

Story
The world has fallen. A dimensional rift has unleashed an unstoppable flood of demons, tearing through what remains of civilization. But from the chaos, five warriors rise. Each wielding unique powers forged for survival in this cyberpunk hellscape. Dropped at random into corrupted maps, they must adapt with whatever weapons and passive abilities they find, carving their path through waves of enemies, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering the truth behind the rift. The fate of Earth depends on them.

Heroes
Blaze: Fires homing bullets that lock onto the nearest enemy, ensuring no demon can escape.
Neon: Projects a protective energy shield that damages anything foolish enough to get close.
Hunter: Drops explosives that create deadly zones, controlling the battlefield with traps.
Slash: Slices enemies apart with razor-sharp horizontal cuts that pierce entire hordes.
Jaxx: A cyber-brute with massive, scaling area damage, crushing everything in his path.


Features
Cyberpunk Roguelike Gameplay: Every run is unique, with randomized spawn points, weapons, and abilities.
5 Maps to Conquer: Battle through the Lab, Forest, Crypt, Factory, and Dungeon, each swarming with demon hordes.
10 Active Weapons & 10 Passive Abilities: Build your arsenal on the fly as you adapt to randomized loadouts.
8 Missions & 11 Upgrades: Progress through challenging missions, earn permanent upgrades, and unlock new survival tactics.
Collectibles & Lore: Discover secrets that reveal the origins of the rift and the story behind the invasion.
Retro Pixel Art: Neon-infused visuals with hand-crafted pixel art and gameplay by the Felicity team.
80s Chiptune Soundtrack: Pulsating tracker music by Drozerix, driving the action with nostalgic energy.

Why Play Laser Survivor?
Fast-paced roguelike survival set in a sci-fi cyberpunk apocalypse.
Play as five unique heroes, each with distinct base abilities and upgrade paths.
Endless replayability with randomized runs and evolving builds.
Perfect for fans of pixel art shooters, bullet-hell roguelikes, and retro-inspired chiptune soundtracks.

Laser Survivor is more than survival. It’s humanity’s last stand in a cyberpunk post-apocalypse. Will you master the chaos, close the rift, and save the world... or be consumed by the demons?

title: Drakkar Strike
description: Sail the seas on your drakkar, launch spears like a furious slingshot, and crush enemy vikings before they sink you!

title: Archer Defense
description: Arcade tower defense game where you play as an archer defending a castle. Shoot enemies, earn gold for upgrades, and survive endless waves. Compete with friends on Playgama leaderboards, unlock achievements, and save your progress in the cloud. Simple to learn, challenging to master!

title: Demolition Car - Rope and Hook
description:
😊Want to relax while destroying buildings with rope and grappling hooks? Do you like casual hits like "Rope and Demolish" with realistic destruction physics? Then this game is for you!

⭐ Main features ⭐
- Simple and intuitive controls will allow you to easily master the game
- Realistic and fun physics of object destruction
- You can play from your smartphone and PC. Anywhere and anytime
- A store where you can upgrade your car or buy a new one
- Leaderboard. Take first place and show who is the best destroyer here

💕If you liked the game, please support us! To do this, just leave a good review and describe what pleased you! ★★★★★;-)

✉️If you find any bugs, please write to us and we will try to fix them quickly! Our goal is to make fun and high-quality games!

👆Hurry up and click “Play” and plunge into the exciting atmosphere of the free online game “Demolition Car - Rope and Hook!”

title: Club Guard
description:
Club Guard is a simulation game where you take on the role of a nightclub security guard. Your task is to check visitors at the entrance, find prohibited items (weapons, alcohol and other contraband items) and decide who to allow to enter and who to deny entry. The game is characterized by unusual humor, absurd situations and freedom of action: you can search people, take away their belongings, use force or even beat them if you decide that they violate the rules.

Game Features:

Interactive gameplay : Check pockets, bags and clothes of visitors to find hidden items.
Absurd humor : Each visitor is unique, with unusual dialogues and behaviors.
Freedom of action : You can be strict, fair or even ruthless - it's all up to you.
Variety of situations : From fights to strange requests, every day at the club is unpredictable.
Simple graphics : Minimalistic style and intuitive controls make the game accessible to everyone.

title: Cannon Ball 3D : Big Boom Obby
description:
A satisfying physics puzzle shooter packed with 100 handcrafted stages. Take control of a powerful cannon, line up the perfect shot, and launch heavy cannonballs into towers, stacks, and tricky block formations. Your goal is simple: knock every block off the golden base plate before your shots run out.

Each stage challenges you to think carefully about angle, force, timing, and momentum. Some levels can be cleared with brute force, while others require smart ricochets, chain reactions, and precise hits on weak points. As the stages progress, the layouts become more complex, with tougher structures, awkward angles, and fewer chances to make mistakes.

With easy-to-learn controls, satisfying destruction, and clever physics-based puzzles, every shot matters. Aim well, make the blocks tumble, and clear all 100 stages to prove you are the ultimate cannon master.

title: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin
description: Ninja: Bamboo Assassin is an action-packed arcade game where players take on the role of a skilled ninja on a stealth mission through treacherous bamboo forests. As the Bamboo Assassin, you must navigate through challenging levels filled with enemies, obstacles, and traps. Employ your stealth, agility, and precision to outmaneuver adversaries and eliminate targets silently. The game emphasizes fast-paced combat, strategic planning, and quick reflexes, offering an immersive experience that tests both your skills and timing. With its sleek design and captivating gameplay, Ninja: Bamboo Assassin delivers a thrilling adventure for fans of ninja-themed games.

title: Froggy Hop
description: Froggy Hop is a fun and addictive arcade platformer where you launch your frog into the sky! Bounce off lily pads, spring pads, turtles, whales, dodge tricky traps, and collect coins and gems as you go. Upgrade your frog’s abilities to jump higher, bounce farther, and unlock cool new skins. How far can you hop?

title: Racing: Destruction and Chase
description:
Dive into a world where every crash is a masterpiece!  

- Realistic Destruction: Flying doors, hoods, wheels, and sparks under your feet.  
- Freedom of Action: Race, evade the police, or explore the open world at your own pace.  
- Unlimited Tuning: Customize paint jobs, wheel sizes, suspension height, and create your unique style.  
- Destruction Tools: Use presses, hammers, ramps to test vehicle durability.  

Key Features:  
- Dynamic police chases with realistic physics.  
- AI-driven bots that populate the game world.  
- Instant car repair for non-stop action.  

Each collision tells a new story. Every ride is your choice!

title: Escape from the Portal
description: Explore gloomy catacombs, avoid traps, fight monsters, uncover secrets of the past, and use magical artifacts to open the portal and escape the underworld. A dark atmosphere and an otherworld filled with secrets and dangers.

title: Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!
description:
A fun action-packed sword game where all you need is to chop and slice enemies into pieces!

Sharpen your blade, sword master! It's time to embark on a real ninja warrior adventure! Play the exciting "Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!", defeat hordes of sword masters and become the greatest samurai of all time!

FEATURES OF THE GAME

- Unique mechanics of slicing enemies
- Variety of enemies and levels
- Epic gaming experience
- Action-packed missions
- Hordes of ninja assassins

If you like cool ninja games or knife throwing games like Hit Master 3D, Clumsy Ninja, Draw Saber, Sword Hunter, Stealth Master, Sword Play and other samurai games, you will definitely enjoy playing "Sword Play: Chop enemies to pieces!". What are you waiting for? Prove that you are the greatest sword master of all time!

title: Car Crash Test: Abandoned City
description:
Immerse yourself in an adrenaline-pumping world of destruction and speed!
Bimka is an abandoned city with destruction online is a game where you control cars that break down with stunning realism. Doors, hoods, and wheels can all fly off with a powerful impact! Explore a vast open world filled with ramps, presses, and other tools for epic destruction.

Create unique cars by changing the color of the body, details, and adjusting the size and alignment of the wheels. Meet other cars speeding along the roads and compete with them in spectacular crashes. Enjoy crazy jumps, collisions, and complete freedom of action!
Realistic car destruction
Customization: color, wheels, and style
Vast open world
Unique crash test sites
Destroy, build, and race - create your own chaos on the road!

title: Badlands Hero
description:
Embark on an epic journey in the game "Badlands Hero", where danger lurks around every corner and adventure awaits at every step.

As you play, you will:
- Complete levels
- Earn experience points to unlock new characters
- Collect gold to upgrade your characters and weapons
- Unlock new types of weapons
- Defeat bosses

title: Badlands Hero
description:
Embark on an epic journey in the game "Badlands Hero", where danger lurks around every corner and adventure awaits at every step.

As you play, you will:
- Complete levels
- Earn experience points to unlock new characters
- Collect gold to upgrade your characters and weapons
- Unlock new types of weapons
- Defeat bosses

title: Super Frog Adventure
description: "Super Frog Adventure" is a great platformer that takes you into the world of classic Super Mario style games. The game features 8 incredible and challenging levels, each offering unique obstacles and challenges. Control the super frog, overcome obstacles, fight enemies and collect coins on your way to the finish line. Dynamic gameplay and vivid graphics will make your journey exciting and memorable. This game is designed for both beginners and experienced players, thanks to different difficulty levels and interesting gameplay mechanics. If you love classic platformers and are ready for a new adventure, "Super Frog Adventure" is waiting for you! Discover the amazing world of Super Frog and dive into an exciting platforming adventure!

title: Family Squid Challenge
description: Hey Player, bring your friend along and team up in this Squid adventure! There are black and red masked men everywhere, so you must be very careful. Run from them and collect the keys to complete the level. Be cautious — both of you need to survive!

title: Golf Invaders
description: Welcome to Golf Invaders, the ultimate arcade golf shooter! Your golf course has been invaded by punks, bums, and other troublemakers. Your goal? Aim, shoot, and eliminate all invaders using precision golf shots!

title: Noob saves the village
description: The village has been attacked by merciless monsters! Become a real hero and defeat dangerous enemies with your fighting skills!

title: Escape From Squid Island
description: Dive into this thrilling 3D shooter, "Escape from Squid Island," where you must flee a dangerous island filled with enemies. Enjoy intense battles, varied environments, and an engaging plot on your device. Prepare for an exhilarating experience as you fight for your freedom!

title: Gravity Shift Sky Racers GT
description: Gravity Shift: Sky Racers GT redefines the limits of speed and gravity. Take control of next-generation GT machines that defy physics — racing not just on the track, but through the skies. Seamlessly transition between ground drifting and aerial maneuvers as you battle for dominance across futuristic cities, floating highways, and high-altitude circuits.

title: Warlock King - Castle Defense
description: Defend your castle from hordes of different enemies. Just destroy them one by one or cast spells to kill them in huge quantities.

title: Roots and Wheels
description:
This exciting simulator presents you with an ambitious task: get behind the wheel of a powerful truck and transport as many crates as possible through dangerous and unpredictable locations to your destination.


Success depends on your skill—your ability to feel the vehicle and react to road conditions—and your wits—your ability to find the best solutions in difficult situations, whether it's mud, steep climbs, or destroyed bridges. Every box delivered brings you closer to your reward.


By earning money for completed trips, you get the opportunity to upgrade your truck – from the engine to the suspension to the wheels – and better equip it for the challenges of the terrain.


You can also buy new vehicle models, expanding your options and gaining access to new types of missions and cargo. Show what a real driver can do!

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

title: Tornado: Fury of the elements
description:
In this game you take on the role of a tornado lord, who must wreak havoc and destruction in the city. Your task is to create powerful whirlwinds, destroy buildings and infrastructure, and avoid collisions with defenses and other obstacles.

You will be able to improve your tornado control skills and destructive power to wreak havoc more effectively.

“Tornado: Fury of the Element” is an exciting game that will make you feel like a real master of the elements. It is suitable for all fans of arcade games and simulators.

title: Big Wild Bucks: Voxel Buck Hunter
description: A fast first-person voxel hunting game. Raise your rifle, line up the shot, and take down trophy bucks across changing treks — from pine valleys to ember woods, murky hollows, and frozen basins. Shoot a doe and you’re busted, so aim true. Upgrade rifles and ammo, collect rare coats, fill your trophy room, and chase higher scores with combos, critter bonuses, and bird rounds. Scope in, hold steady, and bring home the bucks.

title: School Escape Obby
description:
Dive into the thrilling world of School Escape Obby — a vibrant online game in roblox style with stunning graphics and diverse locations!
Tackle unique challenges in each zone, from school corridors to mysterious dungeons. Customize your character with hundreds of stylish skins and compete with friends in multiplayer mode. Every obstacle tests your agility and wit: jump, dodge, and solve puzzles to escape the school! Perfect for all skill levels, the game combines fast-paced platforming with creative level design. Regular updates, eye-catching visuals, and competitive leaderboards make this game a top choice for fans of obstacle courses. Join millions of players worldwide and prove your skills!

title: Obby Fishing: Catch the Megalodon
description:
Feel like a real angler! Different fish species require a special approach. Keep a close eye on the float, feel the tension of the line during the bite, and show your skill to reel in a rare trophy! From tiny crucian carps to giant legendary creatures - catch them all!

🛒 Upgrade Your Gear
Start with a simple bamboo rod and earn coins to become a true pro!

🌀 Open Portals to Other Worlds!
This isn't just fishing in a pond! By collecting enough rare fish or completing achievements, you can activate a magic portal and travel to a brand new dimension for fishing!

📈 Achievement & Collection System
Collect a unique catalog of fish from each world, complete daily quests, and earn rewards. Become a legend by catching the rarest fish of all - the MEGALODON!

title: Epic Battle Simulator
description:
Epic Battle Simulator throws you into a thrilling warzone where strategy meets non-stop action!
Train and upgrade your army, push your limits to reach record-breaking levels, and crush enemy forces before they breach your base.
Unleash powerful units, plan your attacks wisely, and prove your dominance on the battlefield.
Will your defenses hold the line, or will the enemy break through?

Join the fight and become the ultimate commander!

title: Epic Battle Simulator
description:
Epic Battle Simulator throws you into a thrilling warzone where strategy meets non-stop action!
Train and upgrade your army, push your limits to reach record-breaking levels, and crush enemy forces before they breach your base.
Unleash powerful units, plan your attacks wisely, and prove your dominance on the battlefield.
Will your defenses hold the line, or will the enemy break through?

Join the fight and become the ultimate commander!

title: The Pirate Sea. The Smuggler's Way
description:
In the game you have to take on the role of a smuggler.

Search for treasures, complete various tasks, destroy enemy ships, capture islands, upgrade your ship, beware of sea monsters and become the most famous smuggler.

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens and defeated all the monsters! But just when you thought it was over, the monsters returned!

The evil Huggy has kidnapped all the kittens yet again! But this time, Nubik has armed himself with a whole new arsenal of weapons! In this game, you'll get your hands on an AK-47 assault rifle, an M16 rifle, a grenade launcher, a machine gun, and two incredibly powerful shotguns!

Help Nubik find the kittens to claim a reward of one million coins! Search for and open loot chests, upgrade your character, and blow up TNT blocks! What's more, Nubik's friend keeps getting caught by the monsters and thrown behind bars—help Nubik break him out of prison!

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens and defeated all the monsters! But just when you thought it was over, the monsters returned!

The evil Huggy has kidnapped all the kittens yet again! But this time, Nubik has armed himself with a whole new arsenal of weapons! In this game, you'll get your hands on an AK-47 assault rifle, an M16 rifle, a grenade launcher, a machine gun, and two incredibly powerful shotguns!

Help Nubik find the kittens to claim a reward of one million coins! Search for and open loot chests, upgrade your character, and blow up TNT blocks! What's more, Nubik's friend keeps getting caught by the monsters and thrown behind bars—help Nubik break him out of prison!

title: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat
description: Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat is a fun meme game where you need to break bricks, collect power-ups for more fun breaking bricks, and watch Chipy Chipy Chipa Cat and El Primo Bara Bere dancing. Go through interesting and exciting levels in the fun game about Chippy Chippy Chippy Chappa Chappa Cat and El Primo. Pass levels of different difficulty and set a personal record. Play the Brick Breaker Chipi Chipi Chapa Chapa Cat game at now and have fun.

title: Escape from School 3D
description:
🏃‍♂️ Welcome to Escape from School 3D – the ultimate blox-style school escape game full of chaos, action, and fun! Trapped in a crazy high school, you must fight your way through evil teachers, bullies, principals, and headmasters to break free.

💥 Armed with anything you can find—baseball bats, bricks, slingshots, and more—it's up to you to survive the madness and make your daring escape!

🎮 Game Features:

• Action-packed school escape gameplay with hilarious chaos
• Dodge and fight angry teachers, bullies, and bosses
• Use funny and destructive weapons: bricks, bats, and more!
• Cartoony, blox-style graphics and smooth controls
• Explore multiple school zones: classrooms, hallways, gyms, and rooftops!
• Fast-paced and addictive gameplay with survival elements
• Easy to pick up, hard to put down – perfect for all ages!

title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description:
🌸 Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy 🧊 and fly through levels full of danger: fire 🔥, ice ❄️, lasers ⚡, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control 👆, but surviving takes focus and reflexes.

💰 Collect coins, open chests 🎁, find eggs 🥚, and hatch new Fluffies in the incubator! Every hero is a unique fluffy cube with personality. Build your collection — from common to rare and hilarious! 😍

🚁 A friendly drone awaits you in the main menu — it guards your incubator and reacts to your actions. Customize it 🎨 to make it truly yours!

🎵 Fun music, colorful 3D visuals, and tons of fluffy joy await! Happy Fluffy Cubes is perfect for kids and anyone who loves cheerful and casual games! 🐾✨

title: Gunner Pursuit
description: Dive into the thrilling universe of Gunner Pursuit, where fast-paced action and weaponry collide. Experience intense pursuits and shoot from your fast-moving vehicle while navigating enemies. Enhance your gear for survival and triumph in every challenging stage. Enjoy this free game on your phone or computer for continuous excitement.

title: Tap tap Swing
description: A simple casual game Touch to fly, hold to hover, and release to fall. In this game, your agility will be tested. Pass through obstacles and avoid crashing. Avoid all obstacles and don't fall to stay alive. Enjoy the beautiful music and complete the levels that challenge your adrenaline.

title: Cosmic Dash
description: Cosmic Dash is an endless space runner where you pilot your way across the solar system, dodging space junk, collecting tokens, and smashing asteroids. The core loop is simple—travel as far as you can while managing jumps, shrinks, and speed boosts—but what makes it stand out is its layered mechanics: shrinking lets you slip through debris, boosts let you destroy asteroids, and big tokens chain into massive rewards. The mix of fast reflex gameplay, mission objectives, and planetary backdrops gives it a fresh twist on the classic runner genre.

title: Devil Die
description:
Devil Die looks like a simple, cute 2D platformer until the floor suddenly disappears, spikes pop out of nowhere, and the “safe” door turns into a trap.

You play as a tiny pixel hero trying to reach the exit door in each stage. The controls are super easy, but the levels are full of hidden tricks: falling platforms, surprise buzzsaws, moving walls, reversed controls, fake safe zones, and more. The game starts simple and then slowly turns into a rage-game where every step can be a trap.

title: Stick Box - Ragdoll Slowmo
description:

title: Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots
description:
Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots! Escape the tsunami, upgrade your base, rescue, and steal Brainrots. Can you catch all the legendary Brainrots?

Are you ready for the wildest race of your life? This exciting game offers an incredible mix of action and collecting! Your main goal is to escape the giant tsunami that's relentlessly pursuing you.

How to play? 🎮
Control your character, accelerate, and collect funny creatures along the way—Brainrots. The more you catch, the more you earn! But be careful: hesitate, and the wave will completely overwhelm you.

Development and leveling up 💪
Earn coins and invest them in upgrades! Level up your Brainrots to make them more profitable. Expand your base by unlocking new slots.

Legendary Goal ✨
Rumors of legendary creatures circulate among the many Brainrots... Will you be the lucky one to solve this mystery? Only the fastest and luckiest will reach the final!

Join the chase, dodge the waves, complete your collection, and become the world champion of "Escape Tsunami and save Brainrots"! 🏆

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: You must survive a tsunami, rescue brainrots, and upgrade your base.

Q: Is there a storyline?

A: There isn't a formal story, but the objective is clear: escape the tsunami, save brainrots, and improve your base.

Q: What is the game's hook or unique feature?

A: The game features obbies and rare brainrots.

Q: Are there any particularly engaging elements?

A: The game includes rare and funny brainrots.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work?

A: You earn coins from brainrots and invest them to increase your running speed. You can also level up your brainrots to make them more profitable and expand your base by unlocking new slots.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and how are they spent?

A: There are two currencies: money and diamonds. They can be spent on speed boosts, packs, and the battle pass.

Q: Are there in-game purchases?

A: Yes, you can purchase diamonds and a battle pass.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards to keep players coming back?

A: Yes, logging in every day grants you diamonds, money, or a brainrot.

Q: Is it better to play with sound?

A: The music complements the experience well, but it isn't required to progress through the game.

title: Cup Quest
description:
Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey: A Feline Hero’s Adventure Begins!

Join a brave cat on an epic quest in Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey, a fresh twist on the classic balls-and-cups game. This isn't just about tossing balls into cups—it's a full-blown adventure packed with clever puzzles, physics-based challenges, and one courageous kitty determined to save the day.

Your Cat, the Hero

Precision Meets Puzzle
Each level is a test of aim and timing. Launch the ball just right, bounce it off the environment, and land it perfectly in the cup. It’s not just about power—success requires strategy, finesse, and a little creative thinking.
 What Awaits You
- Over 200 unique levels, ranging from simple to seriously tricky
- Skill-based gameplay that mixes timing, puzzle-solving, and action
- Hero upgrades: unlock new feline champions and grow stronger as you progress
- Satisfying animations and smooth physics that make every throw feel great

Become a Cup Champion
Explore a magical world where every level brings new challenges. Battle your way through enemy swarms, master the art of the perfect shot, and rise as the legendary hero of the cup realm.

Cup Quest – Hero’s Journey isn’t just a puzzle game—it’s a heartwarming, skill-testing adventure that’ll keep you coming back for more. Grab your paws, line up your shot, and get ready to become a legend.

description:
Immerse yourself in a dynamic voxel-style RPG shooter with a cyberpunk atmosphere. A dark futuristic city overrun by a tech corporation awaits you, along with endless battles with robots and monsters, character development, and constant action in the spirit of a shooter RPG.

Run through the streets of the metropolis, uncover a conspiracy, upgrade your weapons and equipment, mine resources, and defeat bosses. The game combines action-packed shooting, survival elements, character development, and a rich storyline about the struggle for human freedom.

Key Features:

⚙️ Deep weapon and equipment customization

🧭 Exploration of the city, dungeons, and locations

"[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?
A: It is an RPG where you fight through hordes of enemies to complete levels, unlock new skills, areas, and weapons.

Q: Is there a storyline?
A: There isn't a traditional narrative, but the objective is clear: unlock new territories and defeat bosses.

Q: What makes this game unique? Why would players be interested?
A: There are very few games like this, especially with a stylish cyberpunk archer theme. It features built-in mini-games, great graphics, varied missions, and deep character customization and progression.

Q: What are the most engaging elements of the game?
A: The internal mini-games, a wide variety of weapons, clear objectives, and simple, intuitive gameplay mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: Yes, but the bosses are relatively easy. They act as guardians stationed at the entrances to new cities.

Q: How does the progression system work? How can you level up faster?
A: You level up by defeating enemies. You can also choose bonuses and find upgrades in crates.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Money is used to unlock new territories, upgrade your character, and purchase new clothing.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game?
A: You can spend money on clothing and unlocking new firearms.

Q: Is there customization? Can you change your hero's appearance, use a map editor, or tune vehicles?
A: Yes, you can purchase various outfits and weapons for your character.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to keep players coming back?
A: Yes, logging in every day provides bonuses such as gear or currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or is it possible to play without it?
A: The music is a great addition to the atmosphere, but it is not required to progress through the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What kind of achievements are there and how are they earned?
A: You can earn achievements for daily logins."

title: Doodle Halloween Momo Cat : Academy
description:
I, English:

Magic Cat Academy is a fun and adorable adventure game where you play as Momo the magic cat, a brave little student with big powers! One spooky night, silly ghosts sneak into her school and steal the magic book. Now it’s up to Momo to save the day!

To help Momo, players draw simple shapes on the screen to cast magic spells and pop the ghosts away. Each level takes you to a new part of the school, like the classroom, cafeteria, and even the rooftop. The ghosts get quicker and trickier, but with fast hands and sharp eyes, you can beat them all!

With cute characters, colorful animations, and easy touch controls, Magic Cat Academy is a safe, exciting, and kid-friendly game that’s perfect for players of all ages.

PURR-ify Ghost and Ghouls with your Arcane Magic. Swipe your magic wand to cast magic and save the Halloween.

II, Russian:

Magic Cat Academy — это весёлая и очаровательная приключенческая игра, в которой вы играете за Момо, волшебную кошечку, отважную маленькую ученицу с огромными способностями! Однажды жуткой ночью глупые призраки пробираются в её школу и крадут волшебную книгу. Теперь Момо предстоит спасти положение!

Чтобы помочь Момо, игроки рисуют на экране простые фигуры, чтобы колдовать и прогонять призраков. Каждый уровень переносит вас в новую часть школы, например, в класс, столовую и даже на крышу. Призраки становятся всё быстрее и хитрее, но с быстрыми руками и острым зрением вы сможете победить их всех!

С милыми персонажами, красочной анимацией и простым сенсорным управлением Magic Cat Academy — безопасная, увлекательная и дружелюбная для детей игра, идеально подходящая для игроков всех возрастов.

Помогите очаровательной волшебной кошечке Момо изгнать злых духов, проводя по символам над головами призраков. И поторопитесь — призрак, укравший книгу заклинаний «Тайная магия», убегает! Школа и вся тайная магия зависят от ваших действий.

Замурлыкайте призраков и упырей своей тайной магией. Взмахните волшебной палочкой, чтобы наложить магию и спасти Хэллоуин.

title: Far Orion: New worlds
description:
The year is 2121. Technology has advanced far beyond the bounds of our wildest fantasies, but great progress demands great sacrifice... 
Explore other worlds in the search for treasure and limitless power! 
Command a team of brave heroes and lead your world to victory!  
Game features: 
- several dozen unique heroes and battle cards 
- dozens of missions on every world 
- no irritating ads 
- PvP arena 
- tower mode 
- clans and clan wars
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an action strategy game where you complete levels (missions) and fight enemies.

Q: Does the game have a storyline?
A: Yes, there is a story. It's a sci-fi setting in the year 2121 with advanced technology, but something went wrong, and the heroes want to save the world.

Q: What is the game's unique selling point? What can hook players?
A: There are many different heroes with an upgrade system, a large number of missions, a PvP arena, a leaderboard, and clan wars. You can also upgrade attack cards.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: A huge variety of heroes, many different and interesting abilities for these heroes, an engaging story, clear objectives, and simple in-game mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: There are bosses throughout the storyline, and they differ in design, attack types, and HP amount.

Q: How exactly does progression work? What should you do to level up faster?
A: To level up faster, you need to play well to earn enough in-game currency. The game is easy to play.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main story? For example, 'match-three' puzzles within the strategy game.
A: No.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on upgrading heroes, upgrading cards, and buying hero cards to unlock them.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and what does it affect? Does spending money speed up game progress?
A: Yes, microtransactions will speed up game progress, as you can buy in-game currency with real money and spend that currency on upgrades and cards.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize a hero's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc.?
A: You can only upgrade the heroes' levels and abilities, which also changes their appearance.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you get on them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: There are various leaderboards depending on the different game modes, as well as a clan leaderboard. You need to play and gain levels.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages the player to return?
A: Yes, logging into the game every day provides various bonuses: cards, chests, and in-game currency.

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties?
A: The music is good and complements the game, but it is not essential for completing the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Achievements are awarded for daily logins, reaching a certain level in a specific mode, and completing certain objectives, such as collecting 6 heroes in total. Rewards include chests, in-game currency, and cards.

title: Hook Arena 3D
description:
Hook Arena is an action-packed game where you battle the opponents on opposite sides of a river using unique hook weapons. Your objective is to hook enemies to eliminate them one by one, pull in beneficial rune bottles, or escape by hooking yourself to a physical support like a pole.

Before the match, you can choose your team's color, upgrade your character, and change their skin and weapon. In the treasure menu, you can hack and open chests with both a chest and a key. Who knows what secrets they hold, but all items will be placed in your inventory. Fight in matches, earn trophies, and climb the leaderboard rankings. Good luck in the battle!

title: Mine Obby 3D: Minigame World
description:
Dive into the exciting world of minigames! 🎮✨

🏆 Compete and win
For every victory, you earn golden apples and coins that can be spent on new rewards and upgrades. Prove that you deserve to be at the top!

👕 Unlock new skins
Choose the looks you like and make your character truly unique. Play the way you want!

🎲 Try different modes
A variety of minigames awaits you, where agility, attention, luck, and quick thinking will help you succeed. Every match brings new impressions and exciting challenges!

🌟 Can you overcome every challenge, outplay your rivals, and become a true champion?

title: Trial Xtreme
description: Trial Xtreme is a thrilling motorcycle racing game that puts your balance, precision, and endurance to the test. Ride through challenging obstacle-filled tracks packed with ramps, pipes, rocks, and tricky barriers where every move can lead to victory or a crash. This is not just a race to the finish — it is a skill-based challenge where speed and control matter equally. Complete tracks, improve your time, and collect stars to unlock new levels.

title: Elska - dog vs zombies! Multiplayer co-op
description:
The world has gone wild—but one dog hasn’t.

Elska is a fast-paced, top-down cartoon shooter where you play as a brave, loyal dog named Elska, the only survivor of a mysterious lab explosion that turned all animals into bloodthirsty zombies. With nothing left but instinct, grit, and an experimental power pulsing through her veins, Elska takes the fight to the infected in a desperate mission to save the world.

After the accident that unleashed Promethium Kyanite—a powerful energy source gone wrong—the animals Elska once called friends have mutated into savage creatures. Rats, cats, wolves, raccoons, and foxes... now roam the ruins of the lab and beyond, attacking anything in sight. But Elska isn’t running away. She’s loading up.

Armed with unique weapons, unlockable abilities, and canine determination, you’ll face round-based zombie waves across 2 DIFFERENT maps, each more intense than the last.

In game there are different classes to chose from. Each class has a different bundle of abilities. You can customize your dog and try different accessories with different effects.

title: Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test
description: Welcome to Obby: Dumb or Genius IQ Test! 🧠✨ – the ultimate game where intelligence is key! Test your brainpower by completing fun mini-games 🕹️, taking on exciting challenges 🏆, and engaging in PvP duels 🤺 to earn IQ points and level up. Collect IQ scattered across the map, win mini-games for extra boosts, or spin the wheel of fortune for random IQ rewards. The more IQ you gain, the higher your status in the game, with trophies 🏆 that can be exchanged for cool pets 🐾. Prove you''''''''''''''''re the smartest player and rise to the top of the leaderboard. Ready to show off your genius? Play now and take your IQ to the next level!

description: You must pass the squid trials and reach the red line to discover all the secrets! Be careful when the red light is on or when the doll stops talking, you must never move!

title: Obby, but you're on a motorcycle
description:
Have you ever wondered what would happen if you tried to race a track… on a motorcycle? Get ready for total chaos, crazy stunts, and nonstop fun as you speed, crash, and fly your way to the finish line!

- A ton of awesome worlds! Conquer one crazy track after another to unlock brand-new maps filled with ramps, loops, and tricky surprises.
- Crazy challenges on every level! From slippery roads and slanted ramps to crazy stunts and unexpected turns—no two tracks are alike.
- Motorcycle madness! Accelerate to the limit, race through obstacles, and perform fun gravity-defying maneuvers. The faster you go, the more fun it gets!

Jump on, hit the gas, and get ready for total chaos in “Obby, but you're on a motorcycle”. It’s fast, fun, and absolutely ridiculous—in the best possible way!

title: Onigiri - Demons Wrath
description:
Lead your clan through a tactical samurai tower defense campaign. Build and upgrade barracks, send Hatamoto, Yumi archers, cavalry, and other warriors into battle, and use powerful spells to turn the tide when enemy waves break through your defenses.
Between battles, choose your path across the campaign map, earn Honor, unlock new provisions, strengthen your wall, and prepare for tougher encounters. Each run pushes your army deeper into hostile territory, with stronger enemies, boss fights, and permanent upgrades waiting along the way.

title: Graveyard Wars - Two player
description: Are you ready for a competitive game between the Mummy and the Pumpkin King? Yes, someone has to win! Team up with a friend and choose either the Mummy or the Pumpkin King.Collect as many flying pumpkins as you can! You can earn coins by eating candy and win the game by collecting all the pumpkins. Catch the balloons and bring them to the treasure chest. The fastest collector wins! Different hats await you as you win. So, gather your friends, race, and collect all the pumpkins!

title: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter
description: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter is an action-packed arcade game that immerses players in intense space combat. Become a skilled pilot and protect planets from alien threats. Enjoy thrilling battles for free online, with no need for registration or downloads. Join the cosmic adventure and unleash your skills!

title: Happy Swing
description: Embark on a captivating adventure in Happy Swing, a free online game where timing is your best ally. In this thrilling journey, your mission is to find a lost soul by swinging and jumping with impeccable precision. Every move you make must be calculated, as a single mistake can send you spiraling back. Will you conquer the rhythm and complete your quest? Dive into the gameplay on both your phone and computer for an exhilarating experience!

title: Project: Survival
description:
PROJECT: SURVIVAL

Welcome to Project: Survival — a fast-paced zombie survival shooter where every shot, every second, and every decision counts.

Drop into Ghost Map City, where chaos echoes through empty streets, or brave the twisted halls of Zombie Hospital, where every corner hides something waiting to strike. Scavenge what’s left of the world, complete deadly missions, and climb the ranks as you fight through relentless waves of the undead.

From crawlers that lurk beneath wreckage to spitters that melt through your cover, every encounter pushes your instincts and aim to the limit. Survive long enough, and you’ll earn rewards to expand your loadout, unlock brutal new weapons, and forge the arsenal that keeps you alive when the horde closes in.

Your progress is your power — and your only lifeline. Collect ammo and medkits from fallen enemies to stay in the fight. Each mission brings a new test of endurance and precision, taking you one step closer to becoming the ultimate survivor.

Die? Maybe.
Give up? Never.
Use rewarded revives to get back up, skip impossible missions, or unlock exclusive weapons to turn the tide. There’s always another chance — if you’re bold enough to take it.

Two maps. Endless zombies. No excuses.
This is your fight, your survival.

Survive the outbreak. Complete deadly missions. Build the ultimate arsenal.
Welcome to Project: Survival.

title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
description: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle is a vibrant multiplayer party shooter that blends competition, speed, and pure joy. The core philosophy centers on "fast-paced chaotic fun," combining adorable mini-characters with intense firefights. Players face off in colorful miniature arenas, using the terrain and randomized weapon drops to outsmart opponents. What makes it stand out is its minimalist controls and high-energy gameplay, delivering an adrenaline-pumping shooting experience in bite-sized sessions, whether playing solo or against friends.

title: Monsters' Wheels Special
description:
Monsters' Wheels Special is a 2D race game created by Smokoko. In this online game you race with your own monster truck in different stages like the Industrial, Forest, Arctic, Desert and City stage. Ugrade your monster truck so you can stay ahead of the competition and equip it with rockets and other weapons to really crush it.
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what are the objectives?
A: It is a racing platformer where you must navigate obstacles and cross the finish line first, mastering the vehicle's physics to succeed.

Q: What is the game's unique hook and what makes it engaging?
A: The game features an upgrade system, a cool soundtrack, monster trucks, and diverse environments like forests, cities, winter landscapes, industrial zones, and deserts. It also offers multiple modes, including traditional races and time trials.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: The highlight of the game is the collection of awesome monster trucks and several beautifully designed locations.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What is the fastest way to level up?
A: Players need to win levels to accumulate gold, which is spent on vehicle upgrades. You can improve your car's durability, nitro capacity, tires, and engine performance.

Q: Is the total number of levels known?
A: There are 45 levels in the game.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: There is gold, which can be used to buy new cars or upgrade existing ones.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar retention mechanics?
A: Yes, the game features daily rewards to encourage regular play.

Q: Is it better to play with sound on, or are there difficulties playing without it?
A: While not strictly necessary for gameplay, the music and sound effects greatly enhance the overall atmosphere.

title: TANK ARENA MULTIPLAYER
description:
🔥 TANK ARENA MULTIPLAYER 🔥

Battle it out in this action-packed multiplayer tank arena! Fight against players from around the world or challenge AI bots in intense combat.

⭐ FEATURES:
- Real-time Online Multiplayer (up to 4 players)
- Smart AI Bots with 3 difficulty levels
- Power-ups: Speed Boost, Shield, Rapid Fire
- Multiple Arena Maps
- Smooth Controls for Desktop & Mobile
- Level Progression System

🏆 Become the ultimate tank commander! Destroy your enemies, collect power-ups, and domin

title: Snowball Dash
description: Control a lively red ball as it bounces its way down a snowy mountain! Avoid trees, rocks, and tricky obstacles to stay in the game as long as possible. The deeper you go, the faster it gets — and the tougher the ride! Grab glowing crystals along the path to boost your score and test your reflexes. How long can you survive the snowy descent?

title: Archery Master - Castle Battle
description: Defend your castle in Archery Master - Castle Battle! Battle orcs, monsters, and the undead in this epic archery game. Upgrade archers, use special arrows, and conquer kingdoms in action-packed tower defense warfare!

title: Planes Dodge & Go
description: Join the thrilling action of Planes Dodge & Go, where you navigate intense dogfights, dodging projectiles and opponents. Experience the adrenaline of flying as a fighter pilot in The Great War. Play for free on your phone or computer and see how long you can survive!

title: Snake of Balls
description: Chase a tricky snake in this thrilling online game! It speeds up and moves unpredictably. Every mistake you make feeds it. Can you keep up and outsmart the chaos? Play now and test your reflexes!

title: Road Madness
description: If you like race cars and guns, you will love this game! You can upgrade and unlock more destructive cars, the further you get. Enjoy epic effects and power ups while hunting the new bosses and get achievements for it!

title: Winged Wheels 2
description:
Ready to challenge your brain and reflexes like never before?

In this fast-paced action game, you'll control a car and a spaceship simultaneously. While dodging enemies and obstacles with one vehicle, you’ll be collecting coins and power-ups with the other – all in real time!

Multitask like a pro: Master the art of controlling two vehicles at once

Unlock new cars and spaceships with unique visuals

Upgrade your abilities after each run for better performance

Face random events and power-ups that shake up the gameplay

Climb the global leaderboard and prove your skills

This game is designed to test your concentration, dexterity, and multitasking to the absolute limit. Whether you're dodging missiles or grabbing that last coin, every second counts.

Can you handle the chaos?

title: Zombie Wave Arena
description: Zombie Wave Arena is a fast top-down arcade survival shooter. Blast endless zombie hordes, earn coins, and upgrade six guns from pistol to legendary Ray Gun. Face nine unique zombie mutations, ten escalating bosses, and five rotating arenas. Grab pickups, hurl grenades, and survive  on desktop or one thumb mobile controls.

title: Cowboys Duel
description: Enter the rugged world of the Wild West in *Cowboys Duel*, where sharp aim and quick reflexes are crucial. Compete in solo missions or face off against friends in thrilling duels. Customize your character, enjoy various game modes, and hone your skills to become the top cowboy.

title: Cube shooter
description:
Cube shooter - 3D battle shooter game! 
Loot weapons, eliminate enemies. 
Be the last player standing in fast-paced PvP matches!

title: Attack super hole
description: Play as a hole on the ground and consume as many soldiers as you can before the time runs out to battle the increasingly more dangerous monsters!

title: Stalker 2033: The Path of the Survivor
description: Stalker 2033: The Path of the Survivor – A 3D action shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Battle the undead, explore vast locations, uncover dark secrets, and fight to survive in a mysterious, deadly new reality.

title: Foot Bomb
description:
Football. Why stop at football?
Why not use a ticking bomb instead of a ball?
Foot bomb is a bomb kicking soccer game. Your goal is simple, kick the bomb and race to the goal post before it explodes.

title: Ragdoll Football
description:
Ragdoll Football is wild arcade soccer with ZERO gravity! Your goofy yet lovable ragdoll player floats, tumbles and flies across the arena to smash the ball into the opponent's goal.

Every match lasts just 60 seconds and bursts with silly physics, flashy special strikes and surprise modifiers — giant ball, bouncy ball, huge goals, currents and more. No boring rounds, ever!

Win cups in Tournament mode, climb the ranked ladder in 1v1 Duels, unlock dozens of characters, balls and arenas, complete daily quests and storm the leaderboards. Easy controls, instant fun and endless replayable chaos — drop in for a minute and stay for hours.

title: Road Crosser
description: Road Crosser is a high-quality 3D HTML5 game built with Three.js, featuring endless city-crossing game play like Crossy Road — but with a modern twist. Players must navigate through busy roads, forests, and city lanes while dodging vehicles and obstacles. With realistic lighting, animated environments, touch and keyboard support, and clean responsive design, this game delivers an immersive experience across desktop and mobile browsers.

title: Get Off My Farm!
description:
Protect your farm from relentless waves of mutant pests in this action-packed defense shooter!
Your quiet farmland is swarmed by strange and dangerous creatures, and only your guns and quick reflexes can keep them away from your crops. Blast through incoming enemies and pick up temporary power-ups along the way — rapid-fire shots, explosive ammo, health refills, or extra energy for your electric fence.

Survive enough waves and the stage ends, giving you a choice of random upgrades: unlock new weapons, call in a crop duster airstrike, slow down enemy hordes, attract power-ups with a magnet, and more. As you advance, new heroes with unique styles and abilities become available.

Every run feels fresh thanks to randomized upgrades and ever-growing chaos. Can you hold the line and prove yourself as the ultimate defender of the farm?

title: Obby Pizza Delivery
description: Become a delivery boy in the maze and deliver pizzas to the locals. Rent a scooter to move faster. Pick a bigger bag so you can take more orders at a time and deliver even more pizzas. Complete orders, increase your reputation and open new zones with residents!

title: Tank Craft 2
description: Tank Craft 2 (also known as TankCraft 2: Hell Bosses War) is an exciting 2D action tank battle game with a unique crafting twist. Players build and customize their own tanks by assembling thousands of parts combinations, then engage in fast-paced side-scrolling combat to repel an infernal invasion from hellish bosses emerging from a raging volcano. The core idea revolves around experimentation: craft powerful, personalized war machines through upgrades and part tweaks, then battle waves of corrupted enemy tanks and towering demonic bosses in dynamic arenas filled with lava, rocks, and explosive action. Its standout features include endless build creativity, satisfying progression through levels, cartoonish yet intense visuals with cute tank characters, and the thrill of engineering your way to victory against apocalyptic threats.

title: Fake Ninjas
description: There are fake ninjas in town who have caused dishonour to your master. You have to find them all and redeem yourself to the master

title: Sorcerers Refuge
description:
You wake up in a strange living room. There are no doors. Only whispers behind the wall and darkness in the eyes. Welcome to the Sorcerer’s Hideout, a dark adventure with elements of magic, riddles, and quests.
In this confusing and dangerous place, you will find:
What Awaits You
Mysterious corridors, hidden rooms, and sudden traps
The magic of ice, fire, transformation, and true vision
Mysterious creatures, demons, and a strange Buffoon with his own motives
Intense dialogues, unexpected outcomes, and choices that affect the story
Battles, puzzles, and ancient Contracts made with powerful forces
You are trapped by a Sorcerer who has subjugated four demons. Will you be able to escape, or will you become another soul in his collection?

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's a horror game where you need to solve a mystery and fight for your life.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: Yes, it's very intricate, interesting, and complex.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players?
A: The storyline, atmosphere, spells, and interesting mechanics.

Q: Are there bosses in the game and how are they different?
A: There are bosses with increased difficulty and behavior that depends on the player's actions.

Q: Are there any mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.
A: Yes, there are. Collecting special seals.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: Collecting spells related to the storyline.

Economy & Customization

Q: What engaging content elements are there (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: Complex mechanics and traps, a well-developed storyline.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: It is necessary to play with sound.

Q: Is there a system of achievements (achievements)? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Yes, they are obtained as quests and tasks are completed.

title: Quick Draw Cowboys
description:
Quick Draw Cowboys is a fast reaction western duel game where every shot depends on timing, focus, and reading the cue before your opponent does. Play solo through escalating cowboy duels, unlock new guns and characters, or jump into online PvP matchmaking for real-time showdowns against other players.

The game mixes simple one-touch controls with tense, skill-based duels, power-up shots, upgrades, rewards, and multiplayer cowboy battles.

title: We Are In A Simulation Simulator
description:
SIMON SAYS , COMPLY OR DIE!

A brain wrecking, monkey see , monkey do game.
Your only chance of survival is to follow the crowd. Any unwanted action will be punished.

title: Tap Hunters
description:
Clicker game with colorful and bright graphic.  
Tap to hunt monsters, build your team of heroes and upgrade them. Collect and power up with collection of weapons.  
Travel to new worlds to earn rewards, and grow stronger as you play. With each run you will able to reach higher levels.

title: Gun Clone
description: Gun Clone is a thrilling arcade runner where players can upgrade and duplicate powerful weapons. This free online game promises fast-paced action, featuring both genders. Navigate through various levels, defeat foes, and customize your arsenal for a captivating gaming experience perfect for short or long play sessions.

title: Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D
description: Dive into the exciting realm of Tank Fury: Boss Battle 2D, where strategy combines with intense action. Control various powerful tanks, enhance your weapons and defenses, and prepare to confront formidable bosses that challenge your skills in this engaging online game. Play on both mobile and computer!

title: Planet 404. Episode 1
description:
In this exciting puzzle platformer players embark on an amazing journey with Alice, a brave and curious explorer who finds herself stranded on a mysterious planet filled with secrets. Surrounded by enigmatic landscapes, this world is filled with puzzles that must be solved to uncover its mysteries.

 Each solution and obstacle overcome not only propels the player forward, but also reveals new chapters of Alice's adventure. The game's graphics are designed in a vibrant and colorful style, and the musical accompaniment creates an atmosphere of magic and mystery, immersing the player in an exciting world full of wonders and surprises.

title: Dead Lands Driver Open World
description:
The world has fallen. Civilization has collapsed. Only empty roads, abandoned military bases, and endless hordes of zombies remain.

Now you are one of the survivors. It no longer matters who you were or where you came from — you must survive in a brutal post-apocalyptic world.

Explore a vast open world filled with deserted cities, military facilities, dark forests, and dangerous places better left unexplored. Choose your vehicle, find weapons, gather resources, and fight to stay alive.

The world will never be the same again.
Now you are part of the zombie apocalypse.

title: Hit & Knock Down
description:
Hit & Knock Down is a casual arcade-style shooting/throwing game where you aim to hit targets using various balls. When you successfully hit a target, it will either be knocked down or explode.
The goal is to clear each stage by obtaining the required score (or meeting stage objectives) and then move on to the next challenge.

title: Yenemy
description:
Yenemy is a game that combines survival, farming, base-building, crafting, and large-scale clan battles. 

Players gather resources, build and defend castles, fight monsters and enemy clans, and work together to destroy the opposing clan’s Temple. 

Outside battles, players develop their own Farm Island by growing crops, producing goods, trading with ports, hiring workers, and expanding production chains. 

Progress in battles directly supports farm development, creating a strong connection between combat and long term progression.

title: Luchaball
description: Knock the various masks off the Luchaballs and equip them with green masks! Collect pickups along the way and see how far you can progress in this endless physics game!

title: Retro Sniper
description:
Retro Sniper is a fast-paced 2D sniper shooter with retro arcade aesthetics. Take on precision elimination missions across 42 levels spanning urban streets, tropical jungles, frozen tundras, deep ocean, outer space, and underwater enemy bases.

What makes it unique:

Diverse environments – Fight on moving trains, infiltrate neon cyber cities, storm maximum-security prisons, and dive into underwater combat against sharks and giant squids
Protect civilians – Mermaids, hostages, and innocent bystanders must be spared or face heavy penalties
Escalating chaos – Start with a sniper rifle, unlock machine guns, grenades, and tactical nukes as enemies bring helicopters, jets, tanks, and UFOs

title: Madness Online
description: Madness Online is a brutal 2D top-down multiplayer survival shooter set in a procedurally generated infinite world. Players must navigate a hostile, apocalyptic environment by fighting off relentless waves of zombies and enemy entities. The game blends intense, fast-paced gunplay with deep survival mechanics, allowing players to gather resources, craft essential gear, and construct fortified bases. Featuring dynamic combat with dodge mechanics and an expansive inventory system, players can team up with friends to build and survive together, or face the unforgiving world solo.

title: ENDLESS Z SURVIVOR
description:
Fight through endless waves of hungry zombies, unleash your arsenal of weapons, survive!
Each time you perish, you only get stronger. Kill zombies, get gold, buy new weapons, kill more zombies!!

title: Bomber Quest
description: Join the excitement of Bomber Quest! Engage in a strategic 3D puzzle game where you navigate challenging levels, defeat monsters with bombs, and face risks with explosive power. Can you rise to the challenges? Enjoy this free game on your phone or computer!

title: Underground Heroes
description:
Rescue, Deploy, Conquer!
Dive into an action-packed rescue strategy game where every pull of the hook changes the course of the battle!

In Hook Heroes, you control a powerful hook to rescue the underground heroes trapped beneath the battlefield. Time your swings, aim carefully, and pull up warriors, archers, mages, and more! Each rescued hero joins your side and fights to destroy enemy forces and destroy their towers.

🎯 Game Features

Build your army of underground heroes

Real-time battles with enemy waves and towers

Upgrade your heroes and dominate the battlefield

Fast-paced, addictive gameplay with strategic depth

Can you rescue enough heroes to crush the enemy tower? The fate of the battlefield is in your hands!

🪝 Play now and become the true Hook Master!

title: Duck Hunter
description: In this game, your task is to shoot ducks. To pass each round of 10 ducks, you must shoot at least 6. Then you will go to the next round!

title: Obby Upgrade Your Jump
description:
Ready to jump insanely high? 😄
In Obby Upgrade Your Jump it’s super fun and simple: tap → earn Jump Points → jump higher!

🔥 More points = bigger jumps.
🐾 Unlock pets to boost your progress: they make taps stronger and give 2 or 3 points per tap depending on the pet.
🏆 Level up, beat your records, and show everyone how high you can fly!

title: Weapons Merge Hero
description:
Weapons Merge Hero is a fast-paced 2D merge action game where precision and strategy matter.
Merge weapons of the same level to create stronger knives, power up your hero, and destroy strange planet-like enemies.

During gameplay, the hero fights using knives only.
Throw knives into round, planet-shaped enemies and keep hitting them until they explode. Each successful hit brings you closer to victory, but timing and upgrades are key.

Merge identical weapons to increase knife damage, speed, and power. As enemies get tougher, only the strongest merged weapons will survive.

Simple controls, satisfying explosions, and endless action make Weapons Merge Hero easy to play and hard to put down.

title: Gravity Speed Run
description: Gravity Speed Run is a fast-paced platformer where you control a mini character, switching gravity to navigate through obstacle-filled levels. Tap to run on the top or bottom of the track, avoiding deadly spikes and traps—one hit, and you restart. Each level gets harder with more obstacles and increased speed. Earn coins by completing levels and unlock new skins for your robot avatar. Test your reflexes and conquer the challenge!

title: Slappy Bird
description:
Instead of controlling the bird, you control the green pipes. Time your smashes perfectly to crush birds as they fly through the gap and collect coins for every successful hit.

But don't let too many escape—missing three birds ends the run. Spend your coins on permanent upgrades to increase coin rewards, reduce smash cooldown, and improve the chance of rare golden birds worth bonus coins. Test your reflexes, beat your high score, and see how long you can keep the skies clear!

Key Features:
Smash birds to earn coins
Endless high-score challenge
Permanent upgrades
Rare golden birds with bonus rewards
Simple controls, fast-paced action

title: Hop To Rescue
description: Hop To Rescue is an addictive platformer adventure by NapTech Games where every jump counts! Guide your hero across tricky platforms, dodge enemies, and collect all the bags to unlock the exit door. Each level brings new challenges that test your timing, reflexes, and rescue skills. Play anywhere, anytime, and enjoy smooth platform gameplay designed for endless fun.

title: Steve parkour in mine
description:
Jump, run, and don’t fall! Help Steve navigate dangerous levels filled with traps, chasms, and true cubic madness.

The levels keep getting harder, and your reaction speed and jumping precision are your only hope.

This game is perfect for both beginners and those who consider themselves masters of parkour in virtual worlds.

Are you ready to show what Steve is capable of in the world of parkour?

title: Head Jump
description: Speed Run Maze Maps is a thrilling runner game with fast action and vibrant mazes. The hero runs automatically and must dodge traps. In this game, one must jump, slide, and climb to avoid hidden obstacles. Moreover, the player should respond quickly to each twist and turn. In addition, the maze layout is tricky and full of surprises.

title: RECOIL
description:
🔫 Recoil

A point-and-shoot platformer where every shot pushes you closer to victory… or straight into death.

Recoil is a point-and-shoot game built around a simple idea: your weapon is also your movement. Each shot launches you through dangerous, handcrafted levels filled with traps, precision jumps, and brutal timing challenges.

Expect unique, fun level designs, instant restarts, and endless deaths as you fight against momentum, physics, and your own reflexes. Frustrating? Absolutely. Satisfying? Even more.

Master recoil, embrace failure, and try again.

title: Halloween Stickman
description: Halloween Stickman is an exciting adventure game where you can exact revenge on your tricky friend by rewinding time. Set in a spooky atmosphere, experience a captivating story with your choices influencing the outcome. Play for free on any device, and immerse yourself in this thrilling 2D horror journey.

title: Mine Jump
description: Join the exciting world of Mine Jump, an engaging online experience that merges quick thinking with rapid actions. Explore a captivating realm where each jump reveals hidden treasures. Enhance your character and uncover the mysteries of an alien planet, all while enjoying the thrill on any device!

title: Micro GT Racing
description:
Micro GT Racing brings high-speed action to a smaller scale with massive thrills. Take control of compact GT cars built for precision, agility, and pure adrenaline. Race through challenging circuits packed with sharp corners, tight chicanes, and fierce competition — every millisecond counts.
