Customize your micro racers, master realistic handling, and push your driving skills to the limit as you climb from rookie to champion. With stunning visuals, dynamic lighting, and intense arcade-style gameplay, Micro GT Racing delivers a bite-sized racing experience with full-sized excitement.

title: Obby: RPG Slasher Blade Loot
description:
A dynamic action RPG where dangerous levels, enemies, and constant character progression await you. Fight enemies in close combat, use powerful abilities, and clear challenging obby stages filled with trials.

Collect a variety of weapons and armor, compare stats, upgrade your gear, and strengthen your hero. Each item affects attack, defense, and health, while upgrades make your character even stronger. Choose the best equipment and shape your own playstyle.

Progress through levels, unlock new areas, grow more powerful, and defeat increasingly dangerous enemies. The game combines easy-to-learn mechanics with deep RPG progression that fans of loot, upgrades, and action will enjoy.

title: Tiny Delivery
description:
Tiny Delivery is an game, created by combining the ideas of food delivery and hill climbing.
Customize your car and wheels in the store, and complete each level with your favorite vehicle.
Before starting the game, you can activate the truck rack to keep the food from falling out, making it easier to finish the level.

title: Tiny Archer
description: Nock, Draw, Loose! There is unlimited number of targets in front of you, and it is up to you to find out how many can you hit. Do not give up, try again and your skills will improve with every game.

title: Spore Guard
description: Defend a living spore core against waves of animated microbes. The core fires automatically while you tap priority targets, collect biomass, unlock mutations, and survive escalating acid, shield, tank, fast, slime, and boss enemies.

title: Parking Boom
description:
Parking Boom is a fun and addictive physics-based game where your goal is to launch your car straight into the parking spot!
Adjust the power and angle, smash through other vehicles along the way, and try to land as accurately as possible.

Each level offers unique obstacles and creative challenges that make your ride exciting and unpredictable.
Sharpen your parking skills, beat level after level, and aim for perfection in this fast-paced and explosive adventure.

With a variety of cars, dynamic stages, and tons of destruction, Parking Boom turns every parking attempt into a chaotic thrill ride!
If you're looking for something fresh, loud, and action-packed, Parking Boom will drive you into a world where crashing is half the fun!

title: Zombie Merge
description:
A top-down survival duel. You’re pinned at the center of the arena while a horde of zombies pours in from the edges. Your rival survivor is doing the same on their side of the match — you’re racing to outscore them before the 90-second clock runs out.

The twist is the merge mechanic: killing a zombie doesn’t always remove it from the field. Below max tier, it fuses into another zombie of the same type, upgrading it into something bigger, slower, tankier, and worth more points. Only the top-tier Colossus (Lv 5) dies for good. The better you play, the more dangerous the horde becomes — but also the more points you can farm.

title: Skebob Gun
description:
Welcome to a frantic open-world shooter where you decide who to be: a hero, a villain, or just have fun! Fight with friends, run, jump, shoot, and explore huge maps full of secrets, weapons, and surprises.

Game Features:

- Online multiplayer: play against other players in real time
- Wide selection of weapons: from blasters to rocket launchers
- Open world: explore maps, drive cars, and cause chaos
- Various modes: duels, survival, fun minigames
- Lots of skins and customization: stand out from the crowd
- Physics and tricks: jump, flip, and make the most of the environment

title: Halloween Fruit Slice
description: Get ready for a thrilling slicing experience in Halloween Fruit Slice a spooky twist on the classic arcade game. With a Halloween-themed environment filled with eerie backgrounds, ghostly effects, and creepy music, this game combines fast-paced action with brain-teasing precision. Slice your way through a flurry of haunted fruits while avoiding the deadly traps that threaten your progress.

title: Mad Day Special
description:
Mad Day Special throws you straight into an all-out alien invasion of Earth, where only speed, firepower, and sheer madness stand between you and total destruction. Race across hills, smash through walls, and blast alien enemies as you fight to rescue your beloved pet octopus, Fluffy. Part racing game, part shooter, this is an action racing experience that won’t let you down.

This is a streamlined web version of the popular Mad Day game. With quick loading, simple controls, and addictive progression, it’s built for both short sessions and long, high-score-chasing runs.

With its blend of racing and shooting, Mad Day Special delivers chaotic fun and that irresistible “one more run” feeling. Drive hard, shoot fast, and don’t let the aliens take Fluffy.

title: Brainrot Hunters: Shooter 3D
description:
Dive into an intense battle for your farm in BRAINROTH HUNTERS: 3D SHOOTER!
Your mission: defend the farm from the invasion of cunning Italian Brainrots and wily rival hunters. Hold the line, shoot back waves of meme-inducing monsters, and don't let the enemies break through!
Key features:
🐗 A variety of Brainrots—each with their own habits and tactics
🔥 Stunning 3D graphics, full of chaos and adrenaline
👂 Smart enemies—they react to shots and footsteps, forcing you to keep your head down!
Become a hunting legend, save the farm, and show who's boss! 🏹🔥

title: Impossible Parkour 3D
description:
Are you ready for the impossible challenges and levels in this Impossible Parkour game?
Every level has its unique experience and at every level you will experience new things with 25 levels of the game. You can play it all the day but never finish the game. Let's see if you can?

title: Bonkhalla
description:
Choose one of 6 heroes and battle endless waves of monsters across three unique biomes: Forest, Desert, and Graveyard.

Collect experience, level up, and combine 12 weapon types with upgrade tomes to unlock powerful evolutions: the Sword transforms into a Holy Blade, the Fireball into Inferno, and Lightning into the Thunder God!

Over 30 items, 30 quests, 10 challenges with unique rules (one-on-one with bosses, no healing, glass cannon) and a shop with permanent upgrades — every run will feel unique.

Survive 10 minutes, defeat the final boss, and try to endure the Final Storm!

title: Good Knight Story
description:
What happened last night!? Join our unlikely hero as he awakens in a dungeon with a sore head and no memory of how he got there.


Solve puzzles, battle monsters and survive bad jokes as you piece together events from the night before.


FEATURES:


* Rich and entertaining story

* Over 100+ levels of puzzle solving action

* Dynamic character upgrade system

* Daily gifts to help with your quest

* Epic Boss battles

* Special Boosts to unlock

* Upgradeable weapons

* Custom themed soundtrack

* Over 1000+ handsome tavern owners

title: Sling Chicken
description:
You start in a barn and climb upward by attaching to wooden rungs (pegs). From each rung you pull back and release the chicken like a slingshot to fling it to the next peg higher up.

The track is endless and gets harder as you climb:

Spinning saws guard some rungs
Wood boards block half the lane (with a gap you must fly through)
Other obstacles appear at higher heights: slanted beams, diamonds, moving pills, stone blocks, spinning wheels
Golden eggs float along flight paths as bonus pickups. Your main score is height in meters — how high you’ve climbed. A simulated rival chicken climbs alongside you, gaining meters over time.

Each match lasts 90 seconds. Win by ending with more meters than your rival. If you die mid-match, your score freezes at your peak height and the match ends shortly after; you still win if you’re ahead.

Outside matches you can earn coins and rank points (RP), unlock cosmetics, and play Quick Match or the Coop Climb ladder (5 rivals in a row).

title: Mega Car Stunts
description:
A high-intensity driving game where every track becomes a test of skill, speed, and control. Perform daring jumps, fly off massive ramps, survive dangerous obstacles, and push your car to the limit in extreme stunt challenges. It is not just about racing fast — every course demands precision, timing, and the ability to stay in control under pressure.

Earn money by completing events, unlock new vehicles, and expand your collection with even more powerful cars. With varied modes, challenging tracks, and physics-based crashes, each run offers a new adrenaline-filled experience.

title: Toxic Arena: Biological Threat
description:
Toxic Arena: Biological Threat is a thrilling action-roguelike "survivors" game where your only goal is to survive in the heart of a global biological catastrophe. You are a fighter trapped on an arena with endless hordes of mutants. Test your nerves and your reaction time!

What awaits you:

Insane Drive: Fight against ever-growing waves of enemies. Every minute on the arena is a new challenge and a test of your tactics.
Deep Mutation System: Choose unique upgrades with each level! Increase damage, fire rate, or unlock abilities like ricochet and armor penetration.
Survivor's Arsenal: Collect weapons of various rarities — from 'Common' to 'Legendary'. The cooler your gun, the less chance the monsters have.
Diverse Locations: Fight your way through gloomy forests, abandoned military bases, and secret laboratories.
Become a legend of the "Toxic Arena: Biological Threat" and top the global leaderboards. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Only Jump RPG
description:
Only Jump RPG is a fast-paced action runner with RPG progression: one road, one jump, thousands of decisions. Jump left/right, strike, use skills, and dodge traps and enemy attacks. Unlock heroes, collect items, and power up your skills.

Key Features:

- Minimal buttons — maximum action: a jump = attack + movement.

- RPG progression: upgrade unique hero perks.

- Dangerous patterns: spikes, chasms, ghosts, and tight timing.

- Quick runs: short sessions with a growing skill ceiling and depth.

- Hero collection: unlock characters with distinct abilities.

title: Skibidi Toilet: Attack Hole
description:
Skibidi Toilet: Attack Hole is a free-to-play and highly addictive hole game full of crazy fun and satisfying action! 🎮🔥
Dive into chaotic levels packed with surprises and nonstop destruction. Play anytime to relax, have fun, and release stress 😤💥

You start small and weak… but don’t worry 😈
Your hole has a special power — it can swallow EVERYTHING on the map! Toilets, enemies, objects, and anything that moves. Be fast and catch them before they escape 👻💨

The more you move and eat, the bigger and stronger your hole becomes 🕳️⚡
Grow in size, speed, and power to consume stronger enemies and unlock powerful units that will help you defeat epic bosses 👾🔥

Easy to play, hard to put down, and extremely satisfying!
Are you ready to control the ultimate Skibidi Attack Hole? 🚽🌀🔥

title: Racing: Online!
description:
Experience real online racing right in your browser.
  Compete against players from around the world and climb to the top of the leaderboards.

  🏎️ What's Inside:
  • Drift mechanics for skill-based driving
  • Unique cars to collect
  • Limited-time events with exclusive vehicles
  • Daily quests to keep you progressing
  • Create a lobby, chat, and race with friends — or challenge someone on the same device in local co-op

  Race. Win. Dominate.

title: Spider-Bubu
description: Spider-Bubu swings from wall to wall across the city. Halloween has arrived, and you need to collect all the Halloween candies along with Spider-Bubu. Don’t forget to grab the giant pumpkin too! You must be very careful in the city — sharp spinning blades and pointed spikes are everywhere. Collect all the pumpkins and safely reach the portal that appears in the city.

title: Radial 3D
description: Join the thrilling adventure of Radial 3D, where you explore space while controlling a black hole. Your goal is to absorb celestial bodies, avoid dangers, and ascend through the cosmos. This free game challenges your skills on both mobile and PC. How far will you go?

title: Ultimate Brainrot Battle
description:
Chaotic fights, insane upgrades, pure Italian Brainrot.

Enter the madness of Ultimate Brainrot Battle, where Italian brainrot characters throw hands in explosive, fast-paced combat.

Play as Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Brr Brr Patapim, or Cappuccino Assassino, each bringing their own chaotic playstyle and uniqe abilities.

Fight. Upgrade. Repeat. Become the strongest brainrot ever!

title: Resize Stickman
description:
Resize Stickman: Master Your Size, Conquer the Run!

Dive into "Resize Stickman," a thrilling and visually polished 3D runner where your only power is to change your size! The core idea is simple yet deeply engaging: your stickman automatically runs forward, and you must strategically resize him — grow to smash through towering barriers or shrink to slip under low obstacles.

This game stands out in the crowded runner genre by blending instant pick-up-and-play simplicity with hybrid-casual depth. It's not just about reflexes; it's about smart, split-second decisions. With a sleek, reactive interface, satisfying animations, and a wealth of content including a vast collection of collectible skins with a progressive gacha-style shop and multi-tiered achievements, "Resize Stickman" offers a premium-quality experience. Fully localized for a global audience, it delivers a captivating and rewarding challenge that will keep you coming back for more.

title: Drift Master 3D
description:
Short Description: Get ready to burn rubber! Drift Master is an addictive arcade drifting game where timing is everything. Tap to slide around tricky corners, avoid obstacles, and survive as long as you can.

Long Description: Do you have what it takes to tame the asphalt? Drift Master puts you behind the wheel of explosive cars in an endless arcade drifting experience! The rules are simple: hold to drift right, release to drift left. But mastering the tight turns and narrowing roads will test your reflexes to the limit.

Collect coins, dodge dangerous obstacles, and chain together massive combos to unlock a garage full of legendary vehicles—from the classic street racer "Blaze" to the furious "Phoenix." How far can you drift before you crash?

Key Features:

🔥 One-Tap Controls: Extremely easy to learn, impossibly hard to master.
🏎️ Unlockable Cars: Earn coins to unlock 4 unique cars with distinct styles.
⚡ Combo System: Link your drifts to multiply your score and hit the top of the leaderboards.
🏁 Endless Thrills: Procedurally generated corners mean no two runs are ever the same.

title: Stickman Archer Kick
description:
Stickman Archer Kick is an engaging and highly addictive action shooting game where precision meets captivating Ragdoll physics. Take up your bow and arrows and embark on a critical mission: utilize expert archery skills to kick and save the lives of numerous Stickmen caught in dangerous traps.

Master the art of shooting and apply strategic thinking to complete challenging Puzzle stages. Success relies on your ability to judge angles and trajectory accurately, making this a top-tier Shooter experience. Collect Stars across all Levels to unlock new character skins and enhance your gameplay.

Optimized as a Mobile Ready title, this game offers immediate action and seamless controls on any device. Download Stickman Archer Kick now and become the ultimate hero in this frantic Stickman rescue adventure.

title: Crazy Sheep
description: Crazy Sheep is a fun puzzle-platformer where you help a clumsy sheep overcome obstacles by building a bridge with different items. Available for free online, it features engaging physics challenges. Playable on any device, it's perfect for those who love light-hearted, casual games.

title: Dark City. Multiplayer
description:
Dark City. Multiplayer is an online open-world horror game where players are divided into two factions: police and bandits, fighting for control over an abandoned city consumed by darkness.

The world is alive and shared among all players — every step could lead to a confrontation with an enemy... or something far worse.

The police try to restore order, protect survivors, and reclaim captured territories.

The bandits aim to establish their rule by taking over zones, setting ambushes, and hiding in the shadows.

Capture areas, hold control, fend off enemy attacks… and survive the horror slowly awakening in the depths of the city.

title: Ball: Path Through Obstacles
description: Roll through an obstacle course playing as a ball. Avoid traps and collect coins to unlock new skins

title: Mushroom Runners
description: Run endlessly in Mushroom Runners! Dodge obstacles, crush enemies, and collect mushrooms to grow HUGE! Ride the Happy Flying Cloud in this fun, fast-paced endless runner with a unique platforming twist.

title: Furry Kung Fu
description:
Furry Kung Fu is a fun fighting game with cute cartoon graphics. You play as Catsei or his student Kung Fu Cat. You need to hit the opponent with a lot of punches, while dodging all kinds of objects flying at you, such as balls, comets, fire and pots. It's so much fun!

Engage in an epic Kung Fu battle with your opponent. Get coins, unlock player skins and new weapons!

Bright and memorable characters will keep you entertained, and simple game controls allow you to focus on battling countless hordes of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other animals. Can you collect weapons in battle and unlock all available maps? Two playable characters to choose from.

title: Furry Kung Fu
description:
Furry Kung Fu is a fun fighting game with cute cartoon graphics. You play as Catsei or his student Kung Fu Cat. You need to hit the opponent with a lot of punches, while dodging all kinds of objects flying at you, such as balls, comets, fire and pots. It's so much fun!

Engage in an epic Kung Fu battle with your opponent. Get coins, unlock player skins and new weapons!

Bright and memorable characters will keep you entertained, and simple game controls allow you to focus on battling countless hordes of pigeons, rats, aliens, crocodiles, and other animals. Can you collect weapons in battle and unlock all available maps? Two playable characters to choose from.

title: Mini Car Racing Master 3D
description:
🏁 Mini Car Racing Master 3D

Feel the thrill of speed in Mini Car Racing Master 3D — an endless highway racing adventure packed with excitement, smooth controls, and powerful cars! Race through city streets, dodge heavy traffic, and become the ultimate racing champion.

⚡ Game Overview:

Jump behind the wheel of your favorite ride — from classic sports cars to high-speed formula racers. Push your limits as you race endlessly across highways, city roads, and challenging weather conditions. Use nitro boosts to blast past opponents and show your racing mastery!

The more you race, the more you earn. Collect coins, upgrade your vehicles, and unlock new, faster cars to keep the adrenaline pumping!

🚗 Features:

🛣️ Endless Highway Racing: Race non-stop through highways and city streets.

🚘 Unlock Cool Cars: Choose from 4WDs, sports cars, and formula racers.

💨 Nitro Boost Action: Hit the nitro and feel the rush of extreme speed!

🌦️ Dynamic Environments: Drive through sunny, rainy, and snowy roads.

🪙 Upgrade & Customize: Earn coins to improve your car’s performance.

🎮 Smooth Controls: Easy to play, hard to master — perfect for all racers!

🌆 Vivid 3D Graphics: Realistic visuals bring every race to life.

🏎️ Why You’ll Love It:

Fast-paced, addictive racing gameplay

Realistic car physics and sound effects

Endless fun for racing and arcade game lovers

🔥 Start your engine and hit the road!
Download Mini Car Racing Master 3D now and become the true master of the highway!

title: Ball Attack
description: Blast through endless waves of bouncing balls, dodge incoming obstacles, and upgrade your powerful cannon to survive longer in this intense, fast-paced arcade shooter filled with nonstop action and explosive fun!

title: Smash & Merge Balls
description:
Short Description: A skill-based arcade game with colorful physics.

Full Description: In this game, you control a character that starts a fusion chain reaction! 
Strike the colorful balls to get them moving. 
The key rule: when two balls of the same color collide, they merge, and you earn points. 
Create massive chains of mergers to maximize your high score!


(lore)
(from the Showman):
Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls! Welcome to the greatest show in the cosmos — the Arena of Fusion!

Here is your instrument of chaos — the mighty merger mallet! Don't be shy, give it a swing! 
Your mission is brilliantly simple: step onto the arena floor and prepare for a rainbow deluge! 
Smash those colorful spheres, make them crash, and when two of the same color meet — 
BOOM! — they fuse into a glorious explosion of points!

title: Geek Escape: Run for Survival
description: Geek Escape: Run for Survival is an exciting arcade game where players control a nerdy hero racing against bullies. Available for free online on various platforms, it combines action and strategy. Players dodge obstacles and use trash cans as weapons in this thrilling adventure filled with excitement.

title: BeastForge Rival
description:
BeastForge- Epic PvP Tower Defense Battles!

Dive into the ultimate real-time PvP strategy showdown! Command your army of 20 uniquely balanced units in intense Clash Royale-style tower wars. Outsmart global opponents in lightning-fast multiplayer duels or battle god-tier AI bots that train themselves through 1000+ simulated matches for unbeatable tactics. No waiting—seamless matchmaking and instant AI fillers keep the action non-stop!

Key Features:

Real-Time PvP Multiplayer: Challenge players worldwide, climb global leaderboards, and dominate ranked arenas!
Revolutionary AI Training System: Watch your AI opponents evolve in real-time—self-play 1000 matches to master counters, perfect your strategy against pro-level bots anytime.
20 Balanced Units: Rock-paper-scissors meta with archers, tanks, spells, and more—deploy, upgrade, and synergize for victory.
Stunning Graphics & Sound: Crisp visuals, explosive effects, immersive audio—feels premium on desktop & mobile.
Quick Matches: 3-5 minute battles perfect for "one more game" addiction.
Daily Challenges & Rewards: Earn upgrades, unlock skins, and compete in tournaments.
Whether you're a strategy master or casual battler, AI Clash Royale.io delivers endless replayability. Build your deck, destroy enemy towers, and claim royale glory! Download now and unleash your inner commander—can you conquer the arena?

Drag and Drop or Touch and Place

title: Brainrot Merge & Fight
description: Brainrot Merge & Fight is a chaotic strategy brawler where you fuse quirky heroes into stronger versions and send them into battle. Every merge boosts your squad’s power, letting you build crazy combinations to take on tougher enemies. With each fight, your evolving team grows funnier, wilder, and more unstoppable—can you conquer every challenge?

title: Clicker Knights Vs Dragons
description: Clicker Knights vs Dragons is a pixel-art idle clicker RPG where players tap for "Hero Tap DMG"  while auto-attacking foes like skeletons in progressive stages across fantasy biomes, as seen in this desert Stage 4-1 with 8.81 Total DPS. Its core revolves around addictive hero team-building and upgrades for exponential scaling against monsters and dragons, uniquely blending simple taps with spellcasting, offline progression, and epic boss raids for boundless medieval fantasy adventures.

title: Draw Action Freestyle Fight
description: Unleash your creativity and power in Draw Action Freestyle Fight, a super fun draw-to-fight action game! Draw lines and shapes with your finger to command powerful punches, kicks, and combos against tough opponents in intense battles. Complete freedom to draw any attack you want, hilarious ragdoll physics when enemies get slapped or punched into the water, satisfying one-tap drawing mechanics, and addictive battles across different arenas!

title: Mad Day 2 Special
description:
Mad Day 2 Special throws you back into explosive action as ex-Marine Bob takes on a full-scale alien invasion. Ride, shoot, jump, and smash your way through hostile worlds as you battle evil aliens and fight to rescue Bob’s kidnapped pet octopus. Packed with speed, firepower, and attitude, this is an action runner that never slows down.

This is a streamlined web version of the popular Mad Day 2 game. With fast loading, simple controls, and nonstop progression, it’s perfect for quick play sessions and long score-chasing runs alike.

Customize Bob’s truck with powerful weapons, armor, and boosters, then unleash chaos on waves of enemies and epic boss fights. Collect coins to upgrade your gear, unlock stylish outfits, and improve your chances of going further each run.

title: Inner City Drive
description:
Weave through neon traffic at 390 km/h, one mistake and it's over!

Inner City Drive drops you into a rain-soaked neon city at night, behind the wheel of a car built for one thing: surviving the storm at impossible speed. Dense oncoming and same-direction traffic floods every lane — thread the gaps, launch off ramps over gridlock, and blast through tunnels while lightning cracks across wet, reflective streets.
The hook is the near-miss combo: shave past traffic as close as you dare and your combo climbs, stacking speed and score multipliers the longer you hold your nerve. Play it safe and the combo bleeds away, every run is a gamble between going faster and staying alive.
Every day brings a brand-new procedurally-generated drive, the same route for every player worldwide, reset at UTC midnight, so you're racing the whole planet on a level playing field on the daily global leaderboard. Grind XP and coins to unlock all 14 cars, each with its own speed and grip feel, knock out daily missions, and build your day streak. Instantly playable on desktop or mobile.

title: Prásino
description:
Prásino is a small survival game set in a world drowned in trash. 
Your only lifeline is the trees - without them, there’s no air to breathe.

Plant magic seeds to grow trees, restore barren zones, and carve a path forward. 
But stay alert,  trash-born enemies lurk everywhere, ready to stop you.

title: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight!
description: Red & Blue: Online. Build! Destroy! Fight! — is a fast-paced voxel multiplayer shooter with fully destructible, physics-driven maps — buildings collapse and debris change the battlefield. Build bases and fortifications, carve tactical paths, and turn the environment into a weapon. Core modes: Sandbox (creative freedom), Capture the Flag (team tactics), and Team Deathmatch (intense PvP). Quick matchmaking, custom rooms, localized UI and optimization for web/mobile platforms. Join the fights — build, destroy, win!

title: Stunsteval Siderollers
description: STUNSTEVAL SIDEROLLERS is an arcade race with a side view. Try to outrun a helicopter, a biplane or a fighter jet. Drive in the rain or on a dark highway.

title: My Clearn Robot
description: Dive into the action with My Clean Robot, an engaging side-scrolling game where you control a brave robot fighting off nasty viruses in an apartment. Experience unique challenges and upgrades across various levels while enjoying fluid gameplay on your devices.

title: Astro Shooter
description: Astro Shooter is the high-octane arcade shooter where danger comes from every angle! Command your advanced starfighter against endless waves of enemies attacking from all directions. Collect power-ups mid-run for temporary, powerful builds, and take down massive 3D boss ships. Spend your hard-earned coins in the permanent garage to unlock new ships and max out your core stats, ensuring you get further in every run. Your run ends, but your power doesn't!

title: STAIR BALL
description:
Climb an endless staircase full of danger in Stairs Ball, a fast and minimal arcade game.
You control a small ball running up colorful steps. The path looks simple, but each stair is covered with deadly spikes and tricky gaps. One wrong move and your run is over.

Collect shiny rubies on your way to unlock new balls and styles. Chain “perfect” moves to build huge combos and smash your high score. The higher you climb, the faster and harder it gets it’s all about timing, reflexes, and focus.

title: Dicey Chickens
description: A dice-vs-monsters castle defense game. Your chicken heroes stand at the bottom of the battlefield and roll six-sided dice automatically — whatever face lands fires that attack upward at monsters marching down from the top. Each hero’s die is built from two attack types (and sometimes shield, heal, or speed faces), so every roll matters. Kill enemies to gain XP, level up, and pick spells that upgrade die faces or add effects like bleed, poison, freeze, and knockback. Survive five waves per stage — recruiting up to three heroes along the way — with the final wave being a boss fight. Win by clearing all waves; lose if your castle HP hits zero. Between runs you earn coins, crystals, and weapon shards to permanently upgrade heroes, rank up spells, and push through 100 stages across ten worlds in the Chicken Coop Run campaign.

title: Zombie Raid
description:
Zombie Raid is a fast-paced survival action game where you must fight off hordes of zombies, complete dangerous missions, and upgrade your gear. The city has been overrun by monsters, and only you can clear the streets and stop the growing threat.

Unlock new characters, buy and upgrade weapons, earn resources, and find the best playstyle for each challenge. You will have access to a wide range of equipment, from bats and crossbows to lightsabers and blasters.

Each new mission becomes harder, and the enemies become more dangerous. Survive, upgrade your loadout, and prove that you can stop the zombie onslaught.

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?

A: The game is about survival, where you need to fend off waves of zombies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?

A: There is no specific storyline, but the goal is clear - fend off zombies, complete dangerous missions, and upgrade your gear.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?

A: Good graphics, various missions, and a wide range of melee and ranged weapons.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?

A: The game has two currencies: gold and crystals.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?

A: To level up faster, players need to complete missions, upgrade weapons, enhance their character, increase their level, and watch ads to earn more gold.

Q: What are some engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?

A: The game offers a wide selection of weapons and various types of zombies with different characteristics.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in gameplay without sound?

A: While the music complements the game well, it is not necessary for gameplay.

title: Police Drift Escape
description:
Police Drift Escape is a fast, simple, and addictive top-down drift survival game.

You are the getaway driver. Police cars are coming from every direction. Drift, dodge, collect cash, and make the police crash into each other before they catch you.

There is no road. No traffic. No complicated rules. Just pure arcade chasing on a clean open surface.

Drift to Survive

Your car keeps moving. Use smooth control to turn, slide, and escape at the last second. The police cars are faster, but they cannot turn as sharply as you. Use that advantage to make them miss.

A perfect drift can save you.
A wrong move can end the chase.

Make Police Crash

You do not need weapons. Your best weapon is your driving skill.

Bait police cars into following you, turn at the right moment, and watch them crash into each other. Every police crash gives you more score and makes the escape more satisfying.

Grab the Cash

Cash bundles appear during the chase. Collect them for extra rewards, but be careful. Some cash is placed in risky spots, and chasing it too greedily can get you caught.

Normal cash gives quick rewards.
Golden cash gives bigger rewards.
But survival always comes first.

title: Hi-Fi Snake: Groove-Driven Arcade Challenge
description:
Dive headfirst into a vibrant, isometric world where classic arcade action meets a pulsating disco atmosphere. In Hi-Fi Snake, you control a tireless robot with a single goal: power the party forward!

Inspired by the timeless game Snake, you must guide your bot to collect sequences of glittering pellets. As you do, your trail grows, demanding precision navigation. But don't dawdle—a molten-hot problem is right behind you! A tide of raging lava is steadily consuming the dance floor, giving you only seconds to act.

Once your quota is full, you must race to the exit door to unlock the next room and escape the fiery fate. Every chamber presents a new, expertly crafted challenge filled with moving obstacles, environmental hazards, and robotic enemies determined to make you crash. It’s a fast-paced game of skill, timing, and strategic movement under intense pressure. Get your groove on and escape the heat!

title: Prisoners Run
description: A brutal prison where guards show no mercy. You play as a powerful inmate who can smash doors, outsmart guards, and free fellow prisoners while fighting your way to escape.

title: Blade Hit
description: Throw knives at logs to break them, collect coins, and unlock new knives. Collect up to 96 weapons (swords, staffs, knives, tridents, shurikens, and more), set records, and become a knife master in Blade Hit!

title: Miner Jam
description: Miner Jam is a fun puzzle game where you strategically use colored axes to break boxes and advance through levels. Play online for free and enjoy vibrant gameplay. Unlock rewards and enhance your skills as you challenge yourself across iOS, Android, or desktop platforms.

title: Wednesday’s Battle: Monster Symphony
description: An endless action game that fuels the urge to try again after every defeat, keeping you hooked for ‘just one more round.’ Built around the popular Wednesday theme, it features various enemy types, gradual difficulty escalation, and smooth, satisfying animations that make each battle feel rewarding.

title: Mage Adventure: Mighty Raid
description: The game is simple but addictive: just aim and throw projectiles at enemies to clear wave after wave. As you progress, you'll unlock a variety of projectiles—each with its own unique twist.

title: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG
description: MiniMight: Fantasy RPG is a casual fantasy role-playing game where you lead a small team of brave adventurers through dangerous monster-filled floors. Hire warriors, archers, mages and other fighters, upgrade their equipment, learn new skills and defeat powerful bosses. Build your party, collect loot, improve your heroes and go deeper into the adventure.

title: DEAD FREQUENCY
description: Defend the Signal Tower! A fast-paced tower defense game set in a vibrant red wasteland. Protect your crystal-powered signal tower from waves of enemies using upgradeable stats like damage, speed, bounce, and diamond yield. Level up your defenses, manage resources, and survive as long as you can!

title: Catoom! - Bomb Barrel
description:
Imagine a game where, instead of the usual movement on your feet (or paws), you roll... a barrel! But simply rolling isn't enough — to gain truly incredible speed, you need to throw bombs and use their explosions for momentum. Every correct move is a combination of timing and tactics.

You'll experience:

Unusual movement mechanics — roll on a barrel and learn to control the chaos of explosions.

Lots of enemies — for classic use of explosions.

Destructible environments — explode tiles and carve your way through.

This isn't just an arcade game; it's a test of reaction, ingenuity, and the ability to find solutions, where physics itself becomes your ally.

title: Clash of Cars: Arena
description:
Welcome to the arena where the weak don’t survive!

Take the wheel of a legendary, heavily armed Hot Rod and challenge dozens of ruthless opponents.

Here, there are no rules — only speed, firepower, and your reflexes decide who becomes the champion. Blast enemies with precise shots, collect stars, and unlock powerful upgrades for your battle beast.

Swap weapons, reinforce your armor, hit top speed, and leave nothing but smoke and wreckage behind!

Every arena is a new challenge, where only those willing to take risks can claim victory.

Ready to prove you’re the king of the road? Then hit the gas and race toward glory!

title: Winter Battle
description: The perfect winter season has arrived. Join the battle between Santa Claus and the Grinch under the snow. Collect all the gift boxes falling from the sky, but remember, some gift boxes are very dangerous. As you collect gift boxes, your size increases; naturally, if you collect the wrong box, your size will shrink. Collect the highest score before time runs out to win the game.

title: Drone Dash - Time Challenges!
description:
**How to Play**

Welcome to **Drone Dash - Time Challenges** – a fast-paced arcade puzzler where quick thinking and precision bouncing are the keys to victory! You’ll control a zippy little drone that *dashes* between walls and platforms like a high-tech pinball. But this isn’t your typical platformer – no jumping, no gravity drops. Your drone glides and ricochets from surface to surface, smoothly darting through tight spaces full of traps and twists.

Your mission? **Collect as many bullets as you can before time runs out!** The more you grab, the more stars you’ll earn (up to 3 per level). Once you collect the minimum required, a glowing crystal spawns back at your starting point – reach it to complete the level. But watch out! Hit a trap or run out of time, and it's back to the start.

Levels are short, intense, and packed with surprises. New traps and tricky tiles will keep you on your toes as you dash your way to perfection. Fast reflexes and smart movement make all the difference!

**Controls:**
🖱️ On PC: Just click to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!
📱 On Mobile: Just tap to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!

Ready to test your reflexes and grab those stars? Dive into the dash and beat the clock!

title: Gun and Roll
description: Roll your roller object, improve it to other shapes, press cards and improve your gun! Use it gun for shoot objects. Pick the correct doors to improve yourself in level, pass the levels!

title: Boys - Battle for the District
description:
Boys - Battle for the District is an addictive idle clicker game where you tap to battle and conquer urban turf against rival gangs. Grow your power through relentless tapping as you defeat foes and expand your district empire.

Core Gameplay

Tap the screen furiously to smash opponents in fast-paced idle battles - no complex controls needed. Watch enemies crumble with each click.

Key Features

1) Idle Tapping: Simple one-tap combat to defeat gangs and claim districts.

2) Upgrades & Prestige: Boost damage and restart stronger each run.

3)Endless Growth: Climb leaderboards through incremental power spikes.

title: skyfall siege
description: In this fast paced aerial battleground, I wanted to create a pure, adrenaline-driven experience where every second counts. You’ll face relentless waves of enemies descending from the skies, and survival depends on your reflexes, precision, and smart movement.

title: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts to escape the impossible.

Unlock wild getaway cars
Grab power-ups mid-chase
Smash through obstacles & roadblocks
Stylized low-poly world with top-down tilt
Endless cops. Infinite chaos.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: Mr. Drifter: Car Chase Simulator
description:
Run fast, crash hard, and cheat death — in style.

Race through a chaotic low-poly city as you dodge police, traffic, and total destruction. Use game-changing power-ups like Slow-Mo, Freeze, and EMP Blasts to escape the impossible.

Unlock wild getaway cars
Grab power-ups mid-chase
Smash through obstacles & roadblocks
Stylized low-poly world with top-down tilt
Endless cops. Infinite chaos.

One rule: don’t stop. How long can you stay free?

title: King of pirate
description:
Try yourself as a brave pirate, able to repel the attack of enemy zombies! 🧟
Show dexterity and attentiveness!

title: Go! Up! Samurai
description: Go! Up! Samurai offers an action-packed HTML5 gaming experience. Dive into a vibrant samurai realm, where quick reflexes and smart tactics are essential. Players must skillfully maneuver through various challenges and foes, emphasizing accuracy and ability.

title: Space Cleaner
description:
Space Cleaner is a casual space arcade game where you clear dangerous asteroid fields around your spacecraft. Use your mouse to destroy nearby asteroids, earn money, and survive as long as your fuel lasts.

When your fuel runs out, upgrade your ship’s abilities and return to space to continue cleaning the asteroid field. Destroy every asteroid to complete the stage and unlock the next challenge.

With simple controls, satisfying destruction mechanics, and progressive upgrades, Space Cleaner delivers relaxing but addictive gameplay for fans of arcade and idle-style space games.

title: Raised Knight
description:
Get ready for the adventure in "Raised Knight," the endless runner where your skills will be put to the test!
Run through a world full of obstacles while trying to cover as much distance as possible. Every move counts, so make sure you master the controls!

title: Raised Knight
description:
Get ready for the adventure in "Raised Knight," the endless runner where your skills will be put to the test!
Run through a world full of obstacles while trying to cover as much distance as possible. Every move counts, so make sure you master the controls!

title: TANKNAROK
description: Step into the explosive world of TANKNAROK, the definitive top-down multiplayer arena shooter built for intense, quick-fire web combat. Forget long downloads and complex setups—this is pure, competitive chaos delivered straight to your browser. If you love fast-paced action, dynamic destruction, and competitive gameplay, TANKNAROK is your next addiction.

title: Boba Blast
description:
Fast, head-to-head pearl-duel game. You and a rival each face a spinning mega-ball of colorful boba pearls. Shoot matching pearls to pop them in satisfying chain reactions, chip away at the cluster, and be the first to clear your ball.

Matches feel like a competitive arcade duel: aim carefully, manage limited shots, and race the clock while your opponent does the same. Wrong-color hits ricochet instead of popping, so every throw matters.

title: 99 Nights In The Forest - Battle Squads
description:
99 Nights In The Forest - Battle Squads - Defeat monsters and rescue lost children!

What's in the game:
30 levels with various monsters from the forest!
The ability to assemble a squad of different characters with unique abilities!
Level up your characters and improve their skills!

title: Crazy Bob
description:
Ready for a crazy adventure across floating islands?

Take control of Crazy Bob, battle dangerous enemies, cause explosive chaos, and fight for survival in a world full of challenges.

Explore floating islands, overcome traps and obstacles, complete quests, and unlock new portals to unexplored lands.

title: Twisty Planet
description: Twisty Planet is a minimalist arcade-style game in which your goal is to survive as long as possible on a rotating planet, dodging obstacles while collecting items to boost your score.

title: Ghost Guard
description: Shoot all ghosts before they reach you! Use arrow keys on PC, or tap on screen quadrants on mobile. Be careful, as some ghost will change directions!

title: Noobik Arena - 99 nights
description: Noobik Arena - 99 nights is a fast 3D survival arena where the hero fights waves of monsters, collects coins and experience, unlocks upgrades, and improves weapons. Between waves, you can build defenses: place turrets, fences, and barracks, select buildings with a click, and upgrade their stats. Survive as long as possible by combining weapons, grenades, dashes, perks, and defensive structures against increasingly dangerous enemies.

title: Time Travel: Tower Rush - TD
description:
TRAVEL THROUGH TIME & DESTROY ENEMY BASES!  Step into a thrilling time-hopping journey in this dynamic idle tower defense game! Build and evolve your ultimate tower armed with deadly weapons, powerful abilities, and epic upgrades. Battle your way through the ages — from ancient kingdoms to futuristic warzones and magical lands. Can you stand against the relentless waves of demons, skeletons, and mythical beasts?
 BUILD & UPGRADE YOUR FORTRESS
 Expand your stronghold floor by floor into a towering war machine
 Equip it with lasers, traps, and a variety of unique firearms
 Strengthen your power with upgrades and special synergy effects
 Personalize your tower with exclusive styles and boosts

title: Hook King Runner
description: Hook King Runner is a physics-based runner where you tap, swing, and time your jumps to master wild obstacle courses. Use ropes and hooks with precision to dodge traps, collect coins, and outmaneuver enemies. With ragdoll physics and varied levels, your agility and timing are the keys to conquering every thrilling challenge that awaits.

title: Power ball soccer
description: Top down soccer game with special moves, 2 game modes, 16 characters, 32 levels. Unlock new characters. the next opponents are stronger than the previous ones.

title: Zombie Terminator
description: Zombie Terminator is an intense zombie shooting survival game set in a post-apocalyptic city overrun by the undead. You play as one of the last survivors, armed with powerful weapons to fight endless waves of zombies. Combining action shooting, survival gameplay, and strategic movement, the game delivers thrilling combat and nonstop excitement. Defeat enemies, collect rewards, upgrade your weapons, and survive against increasingly dangerous zombie hordes. With immersive environments, challenging missions, and fast-paced gameplay, every battle feels epic and rewarding!

title: Doodle RPG Survivor
description:
Scribble your way through waves of classroom doodles in this notebook-themed survivor RPG. Spells auto-cast. You just dodge and pick upgrades.
16 stages from elementary to university. 64 unique bosses. Spells with crazy combos. Many gear pieces to loot, upgrade, and stack.

title: Moto Obby
description: Join the exciting world of Moto Obby, where your motorbike skills face intense challenges. Overcome tricky hazards like swinging hammers and sharp spikes in a quest for victory. Test your reflexes across various levels in this thrilling online game, available on phones and computers.

title: Ninja Survival Simulator
description: Become a nimble ninja and embark on a dangerous adventure through many levels filled with traps, enemies, and puzzles. Explore colorful 3D locations, avoid deadly mechanisms, and fight zombies and powerful bosses using speed, reflexes, and strategy. Each level requires focus and skill. Upgrade your character, unlock new weapons, and collect stylish skins to grow stronger and overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

title: Stick Roll Arena
description:
Challenge your skills in Stick Roll Arena !



Roll the dice to summon your stickman army and push the enemy team off the platform.

Use strategy and timing to defeat your opponents in exciting 1v1 battles.



Features:

- Unique colorful stickmans

- Satisfying push mechanics and physics

- Simple one-touch controls

- Addictive gameplay with increasing difficulty

- Beatiful vibrant graphics



Can you become the ultimate arena champion? Roll the dice and find out !

title: Cut In Half
description: Cut In Half is a casual mobile slicing action game where the core concept revolves around precisely cutting objects, obstacles, and elements in half using a knife or sword to clear paths and advance. In its vibrant low-poly 3D cartoon world of grassy campsites and nature scenery, players simply tap to start each stage, collect coins for upgrades, and boost attack power (shown at 100% Lv. 1 in the screenshot) while navigating cute characters like the smiling yellow emoji ball. What makes it unique is the satisfying physics-based cutting mechanic combined with effortless one-tap controls, an intuitive upgrade system, and rewarding progression that turns simple slices into addictive, visually charming challenges.

title: Epicrolla
description: Epicrolla is a one-tap isometric roller. Your ball climbs a diamond grid hopping corner to corner — every tap flips its heading left or right, and it bounces off the edges. Survive the gaps, lava, boxes and spinning portals long enough to hit each stage's tile goal. Snatch item boxes for Invincibility, Coin Magnet, Slow-Mo, Dodge and Push power-ups, bank coins, and spend them on permanent upgrades, ball skins and a repeatable Second Chance. Easy to pick up, hard to master.

title: Merge Fruit Monster Defense: Tower Defense
description:
A bizarre infection has brought huge changes to the world. Ferocious little monsters are getting ready to attack. But Tao is never scared, because all kinds of magical fruit warriors are holding the line firmly! Your goal is to protect Tao and stop monsters from eating her!
Game Features
Creative mixed gameplay of backpack merging, roguelike and tower defense, featuring funny fruit characters and weird zombie monsters.
Simple backpack merging mechanics. You can easily experience character development, inventory sorting, silver coin management and tactical troop arrangement.
Fruit crossbreeding. After upgrading fruits to Tier 4 via merging, cross them with other creatures to gain stronger combat power and funny unique looks.
Hybrid monster styles. Most in-game monsters are designed with diverse crossbred visual styles.
Exclusive endless challenge mode. Start with plenty of silver coins to finish quick backpack merging. Countless monsters keep spawning nonstop for you to take on extreme battles.

title: Archer Madness: Crystal Defense
description:
Archer Madness: Crystal Defense is an exciting casual tower defense game packed with endless waves of monsters, powerful archers, and addictive strategic gameplay!

The Crystal Core is under attack, and only you can protect it from the invading monster army. Start as a rookie archer and gradually unlock powerful abilities, upgrade your weapons, and build the ultimate defense lineup. Place Arrow Towers wisely, combine different tower skills, and create unique strategies to stop increasingly dangerous enemies.

Explore colorful worlds filled with forests, castles, and mysterious battlefields while enjoying smooth controls and satisfying combat. Collect resources, strengthen your archers, upgrade your towers, and discover powerful combinations to survive every wave.

Game Features:

• Fast-paced tower defense battles with endless monster waves
• Multiple Arrow Towers with unique skills and attack styles
• Train your archer and unlock powerful abilities
• Build different defensive formations and strategies
• Upgrade weapons, towers, and talents to defeat stronger enemies
• Bright cartoon graphics with beautiful maps and animations
• Easy to learn but challenging to master

Be brave and defend the Crystal Core! If it falls, the entire continent will become the monsters' kingdom!

title: Magic Aim
description: Magic Aim is a real-time arcade artillery game starring a chibi magician. Read the shifting wind, charge your wand, and fire arcing elemental blasts that split in mid-air to clear waves of monsters across hilly terrain. Dash for a better angle, raise an energy shield to block incoming fire, grab item drops that supercharge your next shots, then warp to a fresh layout. Unlike classic turn-based artillery games, every shot is live and fast — mastery is reading arcs and wind on the fly. Four elements (Fire, Water, Thunder, Earth) each fly differently, so swapping changes how you read the same shot. Pixel-art, juicy, and easy to pick up for a quick run.

title: Clash of Skulls
description:
Clash of Skulls is a tower defense game where you try to prevent enemies from destroying your base by deploying various types of units. Face a dangerous horde of evil creatures that intend to invade your lands. Combine and level up your units to have the upper hand and increase your damage output. Once you've taken care of the defense part, you can start planning your attacks to take over your enemy's territory. Hire skeleton warriors with blades, spears, scythes, explosives, battering rams, and much more... Go ahead and try it. Clash of Skulls rules!

This side-scrolling strategy game features a lane-based tug-of-war mechanic where players deploy diverse skeleton units to destroy the opponent's fortified tower. The gameplay loop centers on managing a regenerating mana resource to summon units from a card-based hand, including melee warriors, archers, and heavy-hitting bosses like the hog rider. Each unit automatically marches right toward the enemy base, engaging in combat upon contact. Victory is achieved by depleting the enemy tower's health bar displayed at the top of the screen. The visual style is a clean 2D cartoon aesthetic with flat vector graphics against a bright, tranquil backdrop of rolling green hills and blue skies. The color palette is dominated by vibrant greens, yellows, and blues, contrasting with the dark, gritty character designs of the skeletal army. A wooden HUD at the bottom tracks current mana and unit cooldowns, while the top UI displays player names and health bars. The tone is casual yet competitive, offering accessible pick-up-and-play mechanics suitable for a wide audience. Progression is indicated by an upgrade system accessible from the main menu, likely allowing players to strengthen their unit cards using earned currency to tackle more difficult bots or players.

title: Mole Kingdom Defense
description:
Mole Kingdom Defense is a charming tower defense adventure filled with brave little moles and endless battles!

Build your ultimate mole army, recruit powerful heroes, and defend your kingdom against waves of dangerous enemies. Each mole warrior has unique abilities—from fearless fighters and sharp archers to powerful mages with devastating magic.

Upgrade your heroes, unlock stronger weapons, and create the perfect strategy to defeat bosses and conquer challenging stages. With colorful graphics, adorable characters, and addictive idle progression, Mole Kingdom Defense offers endless fun for players of all ages.

Game Features:

• Cute and funny mole heroes
• Strategic tower defense gameplay
• Multiple hero classes and upgrades
• Fight epic bosses and enemy waves
• Idle rewards and easy progression
• Beautiful cartoon graphics and animations

Defend your kingdom and lead the Mole Army to victory!

title: Space Break
description:
Space Break is a casual pixel space shooter with great graphics and lots of locations!
Get into the fight against aliens in this pixel-art shooter game!
Upgrade your ship, explore different galaxies and defeat bosses!

Fight the alien invaders! Space Break is a great casual game to kill time.

What's in the game?
- Randomly generated waves of aliens for a new experience in each level.
- Endless gameplay, levels will never end
- Unique spaceship skins
- Boss battles
- Control with 1 finger or mouse
- All levels are randomly generated

Be careful - the game can be addictive!

title: Runic Curse
description:
Runic Curse is an action-adventure game where you step into the boots of Adrian, a shipwreck survivor stranded on a mysterious island. 
As you explore ancient ruins and cursed lands, uncover the secrets behind the Rune Curse and search for your lost crew. 
Face danger, solve mysteries, and embrace your fate in a world shrouded in shadows. 
Features Dynamic combat system with endurance management and rolls that give invulnerability frames. 
RPG elements: Level system with selective improvement of characteristics, equipment, and abilities for previously inaccessible areas. 
Many options for combining cold weapons and magic runes.
10 vast locations with various enemies and bosses. 
Crafting consumable runes and improving runes for weapons. 
More than 55 types of spells. 
New Game + in unlimited quantities. Boss Rush mode. Customization of the button layout.

title: EdgeFire
description:
EdgeFire is a fast-paced online shooter that throws you into thrilling battles against real players from around the world. Whether you're flying solo or teaming up with friends, every match is a chance to prove your dominance on the battlefield.

Sharpen your aim and unleash lightning-fast reflexes, earn rewards, and become the top player in each round. Outsmart your opponents with clever tactics and strategic plays that turn the tide of battle in your favor.

Dive into action-packed gameplay with a variety of stunning skins that enhance your experience and appeal to both seasoned shooter veterans and newcomers alike. Each battle is a fresh challenge, packed with intensity and adrenaline.

Step into the arena, test your skills, and rise to glory. Are you ready to dominate the fight?

title: Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil
description:
Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil is a First-Person shooter Survival Horror game inspired by Silent Hill and the Resident Evil series.

In the mist-shrouded ruins of a once-thriving American city, a war veteran returns home from the battlefield only to discover his greatest fight has just begun.

His daughter, Emily, has vanished. The last trace: a desperate call from a place that should no longer exist — a town swallowed by unnatural fog. As Daniel steps into the eerie streets, he quickly realizes something is horribly wrong. The city itself has become a living nightmare where humanity’s deepest sins have taken physical form and manifest as grotesque, twisted monsters that stalk the fog-choked alleys and decaying buildings.

Silent Fogs: Echoes of Evil is a love letter to classic survival horror, rebuilt for modern first-person immersion. Are you ready to face the monsters your sins created?

title: Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana
description:
Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana is a fast-paced hack-and-slash action game set in a breathtaking post-apocalyptic world buried beneath endless sands and the ruins of a fallen civilization. You step into the role of Black Ninja, the last surviving shinobi of the legendary Order of Light, awakened from cryogenic sleep long after the Great Fall—a catastrophic event orchestrated by ruthless factions seeking absolute power.

Armed with a razor-sharp katana and driven by vengeance, Black Ninja embarks on a dangerous journey to protect the innocent, uncover the truth behind humanity’s collapse, and confront powerful enemies standing in his way. Experience fluid sword combat, responsive movement, and satisfying hack-and-slash gameplay as you cut through hordes of foes and challenge formidable bosses.

Progress your hero by unlocking new abilities and becoming an unstoppable force in a world desperate for salvation. From abandoned cities swallowed by sand to haunting remnants of lost technology, every environment is crafted to immerse players in a striking vision of the future.

Featuring smooth combat, rewarding character progression, memorable boss battles, a straightforward story, and impressive visuals optimized for low-end PCs, Ashen Ninja: Rust and Katana delivers an action-packed ninja adventure that is easy to pick up and hard to put down.

title: The Patriots Revolution
description:
The Patriots Revolution is a free-to-play first-person shooter that combines fast-paced action with an attractive low-poly visual style. The game places players in the role of Ashley, a brave young woman living a peaceful life with her husband and child in a small American town. That peace is suddenly shattered when explosions erupt across the city, emergency alarms begin to sound, and military forces take control of the streets.

As chaos spreads, television broadcasts reveal shocking news: a powerful faction has carried out a coup, overthrown the government, and imprisoned the President of the United States. With her country thrown into turmoil and freedom under threat, Ashley decides to fight back. Armed with courage and determination, she joins the resistance movement and embarks on a dangerous mission to help restore order and defend the values she believes in.

Players will battle enemy forces across a variety of locations, complete challenging objectives, and experience intense firefights that require quick reflexes and smart tactics. The game offers accessible controls that make it easy for newcomers to jump in, while still providing enough action and excitement to keep experienced FPS fans engaged.

title: Unicorn Family Simulator
description: Unicorn Family Simulator is yet another great simulator where you’ll be controlling a unicorn. You can run around, explore the world and finish objectives. However, be sure to watch for enemies, mainly wolves and foxes. These can ambush and kill you. Try to defend yourself or run away. Aside from that you also need to watch your energy bar and eat regularly. You can also start your own family. The game offers beautiful 3D graphics and many different skins, so come on, let’s play!

title: Assault on the Demonic Realm
description: Assault on the Demonic Realm is a lightning-fast, adrenaline-fueled FPS that propels you into the heart of a demonic world. Navigate treacherous landscapes, from ancient fortresses to nightmarish temples, as you battle hordes of demonic minions and confront behemoths of monsters.

title: The Last Santa Warrior: Winter’s End
description:
The Last Santa Warrior: Winter’s End is a dark fantasy action adventure where legend collides with holiday myth in a brutal fight for survival. In a kingdom crushed by tyranny and creeping corruption, Thorne—an ancient Santa Claus warrior torn from retirement—takes up his legendary axe for one final stand. Clad in crimson plate armor and driven by fate, he battles an evil King whose curse threatens to lock the world in eternal winter.

Set in the mythic Realm of the Ancients, the journey plunges players into haunting locations like the Dungeon of Skeletons, where wraiths roam and death echoes through bone-lined corridors. Expect visceral hack-and-slash combat, challenging enemies, and epic boss encounters wrapped in a grim, atmospheric narrative. With its unique twist on Santa Claus lore, gritty tone, and heroic last-stand storyline, The Last Santa Warrior: Winter’s End delivers a memorable action RPG experience forged in darkness, steel, and snow.

title: Planet Hero
description:
Planet Hero is an action-packed interstellar adventure where you command nine cosmic superheroes in a race to save four threatened worlds—Earth, Mars, Titan, and Hyperion. As a ruthless alien robot army sweeps across the galaxy draining planetary resources, you must wield each hero’s unique power to defend the cosmos from total annihilation.

From Sheriff’s blistering Rapid Fire and Max’s explosive Grenade Storm to Robert’s stunning Knock-Out lightning shots, every hero brings a signature playstyle that turns the tide of battle. Ignite enemies with Knight’s blazing Fire Bullets, melt defenses with Toxic’s corrosive Vulnerable rounds, or scorch entire squads through Pyroblast’s devastating Molotov attack. Unleash cosmic force with E.T.’s Lightning Hit, overwhelm invaders with Rambo’s Over-Charged fury, or rain destruction with Soldier’s triple-rocket Rampage.

With fast-paced combat, strategic hero swapping, and high-stakes planetary defense, Planet Hero: Defenders of the Cosmos delivers an electrifying sci-fi experience. Stand firm, harness your heroes’ power, and restore peace to the universe—its fate depends on you.

title: Project Exo Assault
description:
Project Exo Assault is a fast-paced sci-fi FPS multiplayer shooter designed for instant action and nonstop excitement. With just a few clicks, players jump straight into intense combat against skilled opponents or smart AI bots. The game features beautiful, atmospheric 3D environments that enhance every firefight, offering a fresh and competitive arena for all types of players. Choose from different futuristic weapons and explore multiple game modes that keep the challenge dynamic and engaging.

Inspired by legendary shooters like Halo, Titanfall, and Call of Duty, Project Exo Assault delivers fluid movement, smooth gunplay, and exhilarating battles that reward both strategy and skill. Whether you’re a casual gamer or an experienced shooter fan, this easy-to-play but hard-to-master multiplayer experience guarantees action from the first second. Prepare for fast reaction gameplay, teamwork tactics, and pure sci-fi adrenaline. Join the assault and dominate the battlefield!

title: Rogue Sergeant: The Final Operation
description:
Rogue Sergeant: The Final Operation is an indie free story-driven first-person shooter game with beautiful graphics for Windows PC and web browsers.

Step into the boots of a battle-hardened soldier who refuses to follow orders blindly. Rogue Sergeant is a gritty, story-driven military first-person shooter that blends high-octane combat with tactical decision-making. Caught between loyalty to his army and the truth behind a shadow war, you’ll fight across war-torn villages, forests, and covert enemy strongholds. Every mission forces you to choose: follow standard protocols or take your own path, shaping the course of the campaign.

title: Marine Showdown: Standoff in Afghanistan
description:
Step into the boots of elite soldiers fighting across the war-torn landscapes of Afghanistan in Marine Showdown, a high-intensity, multiplayer-first FPS that blends fast-paced action with tactical realism. Engage in fierce combat across the battlefield, where every decision could mean victory or defeat.

Experience the grit and chaos of modern asymmetric warfare, where ambushes can turn the tide of battle in an instant.

title: Alone In The Evil Mansion
description:
Step into the shadowy corridors of Evil Mansion, a ِdark mansion steeped in unspeakable horrors. Inspired by the chilling atmosphere of classic Resident Evil and Alone in the dark, Alone In The Evil Mansion is a love letter to 90s survival horror—blending tank controls, Atmospheric backgrounds, and nerve-wracking tension. Armed with only a handful of bullets and your knife, you must unravel the dark secrets behind the mansion’s ghastly inhabitants. Solve eerie mystery, manage scarce resources, and fight—or flee—from grotesque monstrosities lurking in every corner. Every door creaks with dread, every hallway whispers forgotten terrors.

Key Features:

- Classic Fixed-Camera Angles – Experience the tense, cinematic horror of retro survival games with carefully framed shots that amplify the fear of the unknown. - Limited Resources & Survival Gameplay – Every bullet counts. Scavenge for ammo, herbs, and key items while battling nightmarish creatures that push you to the edge. - PS1-Era Aesthetic – Low-poly Character models, grainy textures, and eerie lighting recreate the unsettling charm of vintage horror games. Dare to step into Alone In The Evil Mansion—where survival is never guaranteed, and every corner hides a new terror.

title: Missile control: Infiltration Strike
description: Missile control: Infiltration Strike is a high-octane arcade action game that puts you in command of a powerful missile on a mission deep behind enemy lines. Blaze through hostile territory at breakneck speeds, dodge deadly defenses, and trigger explosive chain reactions as you race toward the enemy base. With stunning atmospheric visuals and intuitive controls, this fast-paced experience blends precision, chaos, and pure adrenaline. Whether you're looking for quick-fire fun or a white-knuckle challenge, Missile control: Infiltration Strike delivers explosive gameplay that keeps you coming back for more. Lock, load, and strike!

title: Baby Sniper In Vietnam
description: Baby Sniper In Vietnam is an action shooter game set during the time of the Vietnam War. Set in the backdrop of the Vietnam War, the game follows the journey of Minh, a baby who joins the Vietnamese Army and trains to become a sniper, determined to avenge. As players step into the shoes of Minh, they will experience a simple storyline filled with intense action gameplay. The game offers a unique perspective on the war, as players witness it through the eyes of a baby protagonist who is not only fighting for his country but also for her personal vendetta.

title: Lion Soldier's Vengeance
description: Lion Soldier's Vengeance is an action-packed, free third-person shooter set in a stunning, immersive world. Step into the paws of a fearless lion warrior on a mission to eliminate enemy forces in a wild, fictional universe. In this thrilling game, you'll face off against a variety of hostile humanoid animals across diverse combat arenas. Track down your foes, unleash powerful attacks, and dominate the battlefield. With intense gameplay and beautifully crafted environments, Lion Soldier's Vengeance delivers non-stop excitement for fans of animal combat games.

title: Soldier of Ruins
description: Soldier of Ruins is a gripping first-person horror shooter that plunges players into a nightmarish temple shrouded in mystery. As a skilled military operative, you’ll navigate eerie ruins, uncover dark secrets, and face relentless threats lurking in the shadows. The game masterfully blends atmospheric exploration with intense combat, keeping players on edge with its chilling environments and heart-pounding encounters. Designed for those who crave immersive storytelling without unnecessary complexity, Soldier of Ruins delivers a streamlined yet suspenseful experience. Will you survive the horrors within and unravel the temple’s apocalyptic secrets? Prepare for the unknown.

title: Axe of the Ancients: Dwarven Fury
description:
Axe of the Ancients: Dwarven Fury is an epic action hack-and-slash adventure, blending stunning visuals with classic gameplay inspired by Warcraft and Golden Axe.  

Step into the boots of Thorne, a battle-hardened dwarf who, at 75, thought his warrior days were over—until fate called him back to arms. Corruption has overtaken his homeland, and only his legendary axe can restore balance. His journey begins in the dreaded Dungeon of Skeletons, a cursed crypt where the undead roam restlessly. With every swing, Thorne carves a path through darkness, uncovering secrets of the Ancients and forging his legacy.  

Are you ready to embrace the fury and reclaim what was lost?

title: Revenge and Justice
description:
Revenge and Justice is a gripping tale of vengeance, survival, and redemption in a world ravaged by destruction. Step into the role of Salvador, a skilled archer, as he embarks on a perilous journey through ruined cities reclaimed by nature, desolate wastelands, and hostile territories teeming with danger.  

In 2050, a devastating global war unleashed catastrophic weapons, triggering violent earthquakes that shattered civilization. The world was thrown into chaos, reducing humanity to scattered settlements, where survival became the only goal. Years passed, and a fragile peace settled over the remnants of society—until terror struck once again.  

A chilling warning reached Salvador’s village: “Leave, or we will take this land by force.” When the villagers refused, a brutal attack left most of them dead. Against all odds, Salvador survived. Now, fueled by loss and a burning desire for justice, he sets out on a mission to confront those who shattered his world. Will vengeance consume him, or will justice prevail?

title: Arena Baby Tournament
description:
Arena Baby Tournament is a fast-paced old-school shooter game inspired by classic games like "Unreal Tournament" and " Quake 3 Arena".

Step back into the golden age of gaming with "Arena Baby Tournament," an old-school arena third-person shooter that captures the essence of classic gameplay with a modern twist. In a dark and atmospheric world, players will engage in fast-paced combat across arenas. With an emphasis on skill-based Movement and chaotic Gunplay, "Arena Baby Tournament" invites you to unleash your inner champion and dominate the battlefield.

title: Legendary Archer
description: Legendary Archer is a thrilling archery adventure that puts your precision and focus to the ultimate test. Set against the hauntingly beautiful backdrop of ancient castle ruins, it’s just you, your bow, and a ticking clock. With 50 levels spread across 5 stunning and increasingly challenging locations, this game keeps you on your toes as the stakes get higher with each round. Designed to push your skills to the limit, Legendary Archer combines immersive gameplay with breathtaking scenery, delivering an unforgettable experience for players of all levels. Master your aim, conquer the challenges, and become the ultimate archer!

title: Two Hands of Satan
description:
Two Hands of Satan is a thrilling multiplayer first-person shooter that plunges players into intense, chaotic battles. This free-to-play game is designed to captivate with fast-paced, competitive gameplay, setting it apart in the shooter genre. Immerse yourself in electrifying 3v3 deathmatches, battling in vibrant arenas filled with intense action and atmospheric design. The game’s easy-to-learn controls and accessible interface make it perfect for both seasoned players and newcomers looking for adrenaline-pumping fun.

Whether you’re teaming up with friends or joining players worldwide, Two Hands of Satan brings unmatched excitement with its fast rounds and strategic playstyle. With simple, intuitive mechanics, this game is optimized for anyone craving an accessible, high-energy shooter experience without the cost.

title: The Surreptitious Operation
description:
The Surreptitious Operation is an intense action-adventure game that puts players in the shoes of Jack, a young and dedicated homeland security agent. Known for his patriotism and sharp instincts, Jack has quickly risen through the ranks, despite only having five years of experience. His trusted friend George, an investigative journalist, uncovers a trail of disturbing evidence linked to a powerful corporation. Alarmed, George turns to Jack for help.

When Jack reports the findings to his superiors, he’s met with an unexpected order to drop the case. Torn between loyalty and his duty to protect his country, Jack chooses to defy the orders and secretly embarks on a dangerous solo mission to uncover the corporation’s secrets. Players must guide Jack as he infiltrates the corporation’s offices, risking everything to safeguard his country from potential threats.

title: Volunteer to the Darkness
description: Volunteer to the Darkness is a gripping tale of survival and sacrifice, following Jose, a young man from South America, as he embarks on a perilous journey to the United States in search of a better life with his love, Lucia. Upon arriving in Los Angeles, Jose is met with harsh realities and endless obstacles, but the promise of U.S. citizenship drives him forward. His opportunity comes through an offer to join the military, but the path is deadly. Forced into a brutal competition known as "The Crucible," Jose's determination is further tested when he learns that Lucia has been kidnapped. With her life on the line, Jose must navigate the harrowing challenges ahead. Victory means freedom, failure means death.

title: Seeking Justice In The Galaxy
description:
Seeking Justice In The Galaxy is an epic game tale set in the aftermath of a cataclysmic world war in 2070, which left Earth ravaged and uninhabitable. Survivors ventured into space, forming a peaceful union on habitable planets. However, after nearly a century of tranquility, a coalition of three planets called the "Atlantic League," shattered the peace. They trained formidable military forces and unleashed chaos, enslaving planets and looting resources.

One planet, Resistentia, refused to surrender and fought back fiercely, managing to repel the invaders. Determined to prevent future attacks, Resistentia's leaders planned a daring commando operation. They dispatched their best soldier, Darius, on a covert mission to neutralize strategic targets across the three hostile planets. Darius, aboard a stealth ship, embarks on a high-stakes journey to restore peace and justice in the galaxy.

title: Robot wars : Rise of Resistance
description:
In the year 2100, Fifteen years after the devastating Third World War, the once great cities of Earth lay in ruins. Most of the population had been annihilated, and a few thousand numbers of survivors struggled to live. A group of wealthy elites, who had sheltered in their expensive bunkers during the war, emerged and established a colonial government, exploiting the remnants of humanity. They recruited a legion of ruthless mercenary soldiers, enforcing their rule with brutal repression.

A small group of people, want to fight back against the colonialists and restore freedom to the world. They formed a resistance movement and began to gather support from the oppressed people. Among the rebels, a group of engineers and scientists had embarked on a daring project: the creation of a combat robot capable of turning the tide of the conflict. Day and night, they worked tirelessly, pooling their knowledge and resources. The Resistance Coalition embarked on a series of missions to weaken the colonial government's grip on power. Their first objective was to liberate the city of New Hope, a once vibrant metropolis now under the occupation of the enemy's forces.

title: Tiger Family Simulator
description:
Tiger Family Simulator is a captivating game where you complete quests and level up to start and nurture your tiger family. Hunt and explore together in a vast, snowy forest, enhancing your family's traits to stay the strongest. With intuitive joystick controls, guiding your tiger is simple and realistic.

Choose unique breeds for each family member, each with distinct characteristics, adding depth to your gameplay. Engage in a wide variety of quests and upgrade your tiger's energy, health, and attack power to survive against predators.
