Encounter diverse creatures and formidable bosses on your journey through a meticulously detailed open world. Enjoy daily gifts for consistent play and immerse yourself in a stunning environment. Experience the thrill of the wild in the Tiger Family Simulator!

title: Wolf Family Simulator
description:
Wolf Family Simulator is an action game where you live the life of a wolf in a captivating autumn forest. Embark on thrilling hunts, explore diverse locations, and build a formidable wolf pack.

Create a Wolf Family

Start by finding a mate at level 10 to assist in battles and protect against forest dangers. Reach level 20 to introduce a cub and tackle challenges together.

Enhance Survival Skills

Develop vital survival skills to protect your family. Boost health, energy, and damage stats for you and your wolf pack.

Unlock Diverse Wolf Breeds

Begin as a basic wolf and unlock breeds like the gray wolf, Indian wolf, jackal, coyote, and white wolf as you progress.

Face Forest Bosses

Watch out for powerful leaders like bears, tigers, and other wolves as you explore.

Open World Adventure

Explore a beautiful forest, gather coins, and improve survival traits.

Complete Quests and Earn Rewards

Finish exciting quests to gain experience and coins. Log in daily for special gifts!

title: Groomy Island
description: Groomy Island is a new horror-survival game that immerses you in a chilling 3D experience. Your primary objective is to survive while collecting 10 "Grimace Shake" shakes scattered across the eerie, expansive island. Follow the initial trail of light to your first shake and delve into the island's dark, deserted corners. The small map will be your guide as you navigate the treacherous terrain, ensuring you avoid succumbing to the island's horrors before completing your mission. Explore, survive, and conquer your fears in this gripping new adventure.

title: The Lonesome Shooter
description:
In the desolate plains of Wyoming, there lived an aged cowboy named Jack. His weathered face bore the marks of a life spent in hard work, and his heart held unwavering love for his only son, Ethan, who had left the ranch to serve in the US Army.
One day, a somber knock on his door shattered his tranquility. A military officer delivered the heart-wrenching news: Ethan had been killed in action. The old cowboy's world crumbled around him, his grief threatening to consume him. Days turned into nights as Jack mourned the loss of his beloved son. But a sense of unease lingered in his mind. Rumors had reached his ears that Ethan's death may not have been as straightforward as the official report claimed.
Jack embarked on a solitary investigation. With the help of a former buddy, he delved into the murky depths of the conflict, seeking answers that had been deliberately concealed. Their search led them to a remote outpost where Ethan had been stationed. As they pieced together fragments of information from reluctant soldiers, a chilling truth emerged. Ethan had not died in battle but had fallen victim to a satanic ritual, a sacrifice at the hands of his own comrades.
Jack vowed to expose the truth and bring justice to his son's memory. He then goes to his son's mission field with the motive of revenge.

title: The Scythian Warrior
description:
In the golden age, life was always spring. The soil was fertile and there was plenty of food. People were good and happy and old age came late. They were constantly in pleasant and free air and knew neither war nor poverty. Then came the Silver Age. Hunger and cold prevailed. People became selfish and divided. After the Silver Age, the Bronze Age came. People learned to make weapons and started to fight with each other.

The last age, the Iron Age, was the age of crime and infamy, and it was a time when mankind was completely destroyed due to greed and hatred. In the vast steppes of Scythia, a solitary warrior named Aryasp embarked on a perilous quest. Sent by his tribe's chief, he ventured into the depths of an ancient dungeon, To defeat the king who had killed many warriors.

title: The Malevolent Mansion of Evil
description: In the game The Malevolent Mansion of Evil, players become brave police officers investigating a chilling crime within a foreboding gothic mansion. As darkness descends, they navigate shadowy corridors, uncover sinister secrets, and confront spine-tingling horrors. The beautifully rendered gothic environment immerses players in an eerie world with intricate architecture, flickering candlelight, and foreboding ambiance. Ghostly apparitions, malevolent spirits, hidden traps, and macabre puzzles await discovery. Armed with only a gun, players must unravel the mansion’s dark past while contending with dread. Can you survive the horrors within? 🕯️🔍

title: A Snipers Vengeance
description:
This game, set in the backdrop of the Vietnam War, follows the journey of Linh, a young girl who joins the Vietnamese Army and trains to become a sniper, determined to avenge.

As players step into the shoes of Linh, they will experience a simple storyline filled with intense action gameplay. The game offers a unique perspective on the war, as players witness it through the eyes of a female protagonist who is not only fighting for her country but also for her personal vendetta.

title: Bullet and Cry in Space
description:
Experience the ultimate thrill with our action horror first-person shooter game set in a dark spaceship. Immerse yourself in an adventure as you navigate through the eerie corridors of a dark spacecraft. With realistic graphics and intense sound effects, you'll feel like you're truly trapped in this terrifying world. As you make your way through the ship, you'll encounter gruesome creatures lurking in the shadows, you must fight for humanity and uncover the mysteries of the abandoned vessel. Be prepared for intense battles and scares as you uncover the dark secrets hidden within the spaceship.

With a combination of action, horror, and first-person shooter elements, this game is perfect for horror enthusiasts.

title: Darkness in spaceship
description: The story takes place in the future when the Earth has become uninhabitable and other planets are not suitable for life, so humanity lives only in large spaceships. The hero lives in a spaceship called Light and is a special agent. One day their ship is attacked by enemies. Enemies first bring monsters into the ship and then send robot soldiers. The hero must destroy the enemies and save his people.

title: The Resistance Fighters
description:
The story of the game is about a young man who defends his country against enemies' invasion.

Isa is a young man who was born in America. His parents are Palestinian Christians who immigrated to America. One day Isa sees on TV that the Israelis have attacked Palestine again. But something catches his attention. The pictures are of their ancestral village. Isa's grandfather and some of their relatives still live there. Isa, who is impatient, decides to go to Palestine. He buys a plane ticket at the first opportunity and goes to Jordan and enters Palestine through there.

title: Assault on the Evil Star
description:
In the twenty-second century, advanced technology has made life possible on planets across the galaxy. There are many constructions on different planets and many people live on other planets. All humans live under the nationwide empire of a king named Dara.
The protection of the people is done by a special army called immortals, who have been genetically modified into superhumans and have much higher power than ordinary people. Their wounds will heal on their own. The emperor has a queen named Esther, who has created many organizations on different planets using her political position.

One day, a special force of immortals is called to Queen Esther. He has done the most difficult missions so far. The queen orders him to go to one of her facilities on a planet where experiments are going out of control. He must rescue and bring the project manager from there.

title: Skibidi Online
description:
Skibidi Online is a fast-paced 3D multiplayer shooter game where you can defend against attacking Skibidi Toilets in PvP or CO-OP mode. Choose from a variety of melee and ranged weapons to take down your opponents, and use your skills and teamwork to survive.

The game features 10 different maps, each with its own unique challenges. You'll need to use all of your cunning and agility to stay alive in the face of overwhelming odds. The game is easy to learn but difficult to master. Whether you're a seasoned FPS player or a complete beginner, Skibidi Online is sure to provide hours of fun.

If you're looking for a challenging and exciting multiplayer shooter game, then Skibidi Online is the game for you. Download it today and start the battle!

title: Kurofune Samurai
description:
Kurofune Samurai is a free third-person action samurai game set in 19th-century Japan. The story is about a samurai who is called to help by the people of an oppressed village. His goal is to take the rights of the people from the oppressive ruler and fight with the ruler's guards and ninjas .

The people of Shizukana had a good life. The lord who ruled over them acted justly. One day a delegation from the American government asked for a trade agreement with the lord of the region, but he refused. The Americans equipped the lord's brother Akumo and incited his brother against him. With the help of American military weapons, he won and ruled Shizukana. Akumo was a stubborn and violent man, and his oppression of the people of Shizukana gradually increased. He had enslaved the people and anyone who could not provide the required product was severely and cruelly punished. Exhausted, the people decide to ask an old samurai for help. After hearing about the oppression, the samurai agreed to help and set out to investigate and rescue the villagers.

title: A Visit to Hell
description:
A Visit to Hell is a first-person platformer game with beautiful low-poly graphics. The game features a challenging level design that will test your platforming skills to the limit. You play as a wounded NATO soldier who is in a state between life and death. Your soul enters the afterlife, where you must navigate a series of dangerous obstacles to reach the exit. Along the way, you will see the fate of others who have died, and you will learn about the true meaning of hell.

The game's low-poly graphics are stunning, and they perfectly capture the eerie atmosphere of the afterlife. The level design is also well-crafted, and it offers a good balance of challenge and excitement. The gameplay is simple to learn but difficult to master, and it will keep you entertained for hours on end.

title: Evil Space Base : FPS
description:
Evil Space Base : FPS is an action game that is set in a sci-fi space base. You play as a space patrol who finds a mysterious base on a remote planet and goes to inspect it. But soon you discover that this base has a big secret and terrible events have happened in it. The game features intense action horror gameplay, a beautiful and atmospheric sci-fi environment, an entertaining and simple story, and good graphics.
Play Evil Space Base : FPS today and experience the thrill of exploring a dark and dangerous space base!

title: The Courage of an American Grandfather
description:
The Courage of an American Grandfather is a captivating free-to-play fighting game that combines the allure of modern graphics with the nostalgic essence reminiscent of timeless classics such as Streets of Rage and Final Fight.

Meet John, an elderly martial arts master who proudly runs a gymnasium in a quaint town. His aspirations revolve around witnessing his grandson's rise to greatness as a phenomenal athlete, ultimately bringing glory to the United States in the global championship. However, an unforeseen turn of events occurs when a rival martial arts club attempts to obliterate everything John holds dear. It is now up to this seasoned warrior to face the odds and emerge victorious. Join forces with the aging hero as he embarks on an exhilarating battle against formidable adversaries. Together, let us assist this remarkable elderly gentleman in achieving triumph.

title: A Rifleman From Ireland
description: A Rifleman From Ireland is a thrilling 3D action game that puts you in the shoes of an Irish soldier defending his homeland from invading enemies. Immerse yourself in intense and exhilarating third-person shooter gameplay as you navigate a stunning environment. The game offers an entertaining and straightforward storyline, complemented by captivating graphics that bring the world to life. Experience the excitement of being a Rifleman From Ireland as you embark on this epic adventure.

title: Soldier of Homeland: Sahara
description: Soldier of Homeland: Sahara is an action-shooting game with great 3D graphics. A country in North Africa is suffering from drought and lack of water. People are facing difficulties in their lives. But other countries offer help and in the beginning, the water problems get a little better. Unfortunately, various diseases spread in the country, and the situation is very critical. People have realized that these diseases are due to experiments on them, but the authorities do nothing. A patriotic soldier decides to attack the enemy base alone and destroy their laboratory. Save your country and your people in this game.

title: In Search of Wisdom and Salvation
description: Following a devastating global war in 2050, the majority of Earth's population perished, leaving only a small group of survivors. One such tribe sought to create a brighter future by learning from humanity's past mistakes. Recently, a mystic individual discovered a valuable book that could serve as a guide for the tribe. Unfortunately, the occupiers took control of the area where the man was last seen. To retrieve the book and locate the man, the tribe dispatches a robot to the area. The robot's mission is to find the man and bring back the book to aid in the tribe's efforts towards a better future.

title: Wounded Summer Baby
description: Wounded Summer Baby Edition is an action-packed shooter game set in the wild west, boasting stunning graphics. The protagonist of the story is an infant named Tecumseh, who hails from a Native American tribe. Tragedy strikes when Tecumseh's tribe is brutally attacked, resulting in the loss of his fellow tribesmen and the abduction of his sister. Determined to seek justice and rescue his sister, Tecumseh sets out on a treacherous quest, navigating through perilous terrain and facing formidable foes along the way. Players will join Tecumseh in his courageous journey to avenge his tribe and save his sister in this thrilling and emotionally charged game.

title: Alone In The Evil Space Base
description: Alone In The Evil Space Base is a third-person action horror game that takes place in a dark space base. The game’s story revolves around a space patrol that discovers a mysterious base on a remote planet and decides to investigate it. However, the base has a big secret, and terrible events have occurred there. The game features intense action horror gameplay, a beautiful and atmospheric sci-fi environment, and an entertaining and straightforward story. The game is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat with its thrilling gameplay and eerie atmosphere.

title: Soldier Of The Homeland
description: In Eastern Europe, a terrorist group has launched an attack on a country, prompting its citizens and military to engage in combat. Meanwhile, the United States military has arrived in the country, claiming to assist in the fight against terrorism. However, suspicions arise that the true motive behind their presence is to exploit the country's mineral resources. In the midst of this turmoil, a ranger named Niko finds himself torn between defending his nation against both the terrorists and the US occupation. Driven by a desire for liberation, Niko decides to take up arms and fight for his country's freedom.

title: Swordsman of Persia
description: Swordsman of Persia: Ancient Story transports players back to ancient Persia through a captivating and immersive third-person action platformer experience. As the protagonist, Bahram, players will embark on a journey filled with adventure and excitement as they strive to avenge the massacre of their town, Khavarshahr, and rescue the captive citizens, including the beloved king's daughter. The invasion of Bahram's hometown by ruthless invaders has resulted in widespread destruction and loss of life. Driven by the need to seek revenge and free his people, Bahram sets out on a quest that will test his skills and determination. With beautiful graphics and a thrilling storyline, Swords of Persia: Ancient Story is a must-play for anyone who loves action games set in historical environments.

title: My Land: King Defender
description: As a king, you have been bestowed with the responsibility of protecting your kingdom from monster attacks. In order to do so, you must strive to expand your kingdom by purchasing new lands, gathering resources, and selling them to earn gold. With this gold, you can upgrade your tools, build towers for defense, and find hidden chests to gain valuable resources. By utilizing these resources and tools, you can create a great and beautiful kingdom, solidifying your role as a true king who is dedicated to the preservation of his land. Remember, your ultimate goal is to save your kingdom, and it is up to you to make it happen. Take charge and build a kingdom that will be remembered for generations to come.

title: Black Apocalypse
description:
The year 2050 marked the beginning of a global conflict that utilized weapons of mass destruction, leading to widespread destruction and loss of life on a massive scale. Many people died from the direct effects of the war, while others succumbed to disease and starvation.
Despite this catastrophic event, humanity eventually managed to rebuild and the population started to grow once again. New communities were established in areas of the world that had not been affected by the war.
In this game, you will play as a hero from a village that has recently been attacked by wolves. Your objective is to protect your fellow villagers and navigate this perilous world in order to survive. Good luck on your journey.

title: Black Soldier of Rome
description: Black soldier of Rome is a fighter game where you will be playing as an African warrior serving within the Roman army. He’s an older soldier who has been promoted to the post of commander. His mission is to attack enemy tribes that find themselves to the north of Rome. However, on his way there, his whole unit has been slain and he stands alone. The mission has to be completed though, so be sure to help him out. Start your dangerous quests full of enemies. You will need to fight for your life throughout the whole game. Be sure to try this one out!

title: Mini Samurai Kurofune
description: Mini Samurai Kurofune is a story of a samurai who is called up by people from an exploited village. One day, a delegation from America has arrived that wanted to strike a business deal with them. The ruler has rejected this partnership. The Americans then joined forces with the rulers brother Akumo and started a war. Akumo is now the new ruler, but his cruelty is terrifying the village and the locals sent for help to a samurai - you. You’ve accepted and now start your quest to free the innocent folk.

title: Gears of Babies
description: Gears of Babies is a well made third-person shooter game where you play as Nick, a courageous baby who is trying to protect the right of babies in America! The babies are tired of waiting for a clean diaper or basic foodstuffs like milk, while the government is funding foreign wars. Your hero is therefore trying to do whatever he can to get the necessary diapers. Traverse enemy territory and kill all of your enemies that stand in your way. Pick up a gun and start shooting!

title: Dinogen Online
description: Dinogen Online is an online 2D multiplayer action shooter with a lot of weapons, game modes and maps. Unlock new weapons, dinosaurs, gear, items and much more by getting XP in the game! You can play either as human or as dinosaur in game modes such as Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag or Destruction. You can play one of the many survival modes and try to withstand never-ending waves of enemies, such as militiamen, dinosaurs, helicopters and many others. Create your own maps and missions with the in-game editor. The editor is a great tool that will allow you to change already available maps and missions or create wholly new ones. All of the scenarios you make will be available right away in the game and you will be able to play them yourself or with friends online.

title: Security Breach
description: Security Breach is a horror FNAF game where you will be trying to survive. Right at the beginning, you will be able to pick from 2 stories and multiple settings. After that, the true danger starts. You are locked in a room and need to find out how to get out. Once you manage to do that, another problem comes up - there are enemies outside who are trying to get rid of you. Be sure to move cautiously and hide whenever possible.

title: The Patriots : Fight and Freedom
description: The Patriots: Fight and Freedom is about a young woman named Ashley who is living with her husband and child in a small town in the US. One day, she hears explosions and emergency sirens. There are military vehicles in the city and the news are that a coup against the American government has been organized with the perpetrators capturing the president. Ashley grabs her weapon and joins the resistance to save her country. Help her out and see her succeed!

title: The Letter: Seeker Of Truths
description: The Letter: Seeker Of Truths is a story game where you will find out at the beginning that an American journalist has been attacked. Her office has been targeted in a terrorist attack. Her objective will be to find out who wanted to kill her and who is part of this dangerous organization. Be sure to use the help of your friends who will accompany you through the game. Aside from that, there will be 3D graphics to enjoy and fun gameplay. Good luck with uncovering the truth.

title: Super Red
description: Super Red is a fairly difficult shooter game where you will have to use your time cautiously. You can slow down time by standing still and make it flow normally again by moving. Use this skill against your enemies. To move your character, you can use the WASD keys. While moving time will flow normally, when standing still the time will slow down. The goal of the game is to kill as many enemies as possible. They will spawn in the arena continuously. You need to always be on your toes and think about your next move.

title: Squad Hero Tower
description: Squad Hero Tower is a mixed action and puzzle game where you will have to put your hero into a tower and fight against enemies who are dressed similarly to Squad Game. The objective of your hero will be to kill all enemies around. To do so, he has to have a higher number than the enemy. For each kill, the number of your hero will increase and you can move to other parts of the tower. Like this, you can destroy all of your opponents and win the level. The game offers a total of 40 levels, so don’t worry about getting bored soon. For the money you earn, you will be able to purchase new skins.

title: Shy Eye Labyrinth: Prototype
description: You have been locked in the labyrinth with a quest. Find four keys to open a way out. Each key is hidden in a unique level. Can you discover labyrinth’s secrets, overcome it’s puzzles and find the keys? This is just a prototype, not a fully developed game. You can send us feedback in comments. Discord

title: Wounded Winter: A Lakota Story
description:
About
Wounded Winter: A Lakota Story is a free action / shooter western game with a beautiful low poly graphic.
Story
The hero of the story is called Akecheta, who is a Lakota(Native American). The Akecheta tribe is attacked and its people are killed while he is hunting. The attackers also took Akecheta's wife with them. Akecheta embarks on a perilous journey to bring his wife back and avenge the murderers of his tribe.

title: Deadswitch 3
description:
Deadswitch 3 is a fast-paced action game where you find yourself in an arena full of enemies and your goal is to eliminate them all. You will have many modes, maps and weapons at your disposal. Since this is a multiplayer game, be sure to call a friend and play the game together!

Ranked
- you play with real players or against bots
- you can upgrade your character or its special skills
- as you play through the game, you will be getting new equipment and your rank will be getting higher and higher

Operations
- complete missions alone or with your friends
- each operation gives you different rewards

Survival
- survive for as long as possible and kill all of your enemies coming in waves
- become the best ranked player around.

title: Mini Survival
description: Mini Survival is a great mini game where you'll be trying to survive for as long as possible. You start barehanded, with your first objective being to collect a few stones, some wood and other resources that can be used to create your first tools. You can therefore create an axe, a fishing rod or something to attack with, a sword for instance. You can also start a fire that you'll be grateful for during the night. If you like gardening, you can start your own farm by planting seeds. You can also hunt animals. As you can see, the possibilities are endless, and you’ll be entertained for hours.

title: Save the Penguin
description: Save the Penguin is a nice little adventure game with a rather short story. Your objective is to save your friend who’s been imprisoned by evil penguins. If you want to save him, you first need to defeat the penguins. Your friend will be free only after you break his chains. In your surroundings, there will be fish that will help you gain some HP by eating them. There are also snowballs that you can use against your enemies. Move around and explore the world. Get through all of the objectives and defeat your opponents. Good luck!

title: Samurai Warrior
description: Samurai Warrior is an action online game where you’ll be fighting against a lot of enemies. Right at the beginning of the game, you pick a character that you’ll be playing as. You can pick between a man and a woman. While playing, you won’t be able to change your gender, so be sure to choose correctly. You can then start fighting against your enemies. There's a total of 5 levels where you’ll meet many opponents. They will all try to kill you, so be sure to watch your HP bar. Let’s try the game out!

title: Prison Break
description: Prison Break is an action online game where you’ll be in control of an inmate. As the name of the game suggest, your goal will be to break out of prison. There’s a total of 15 levels waiting for you with numerous objectives, where you'll have to unlock a lock, put in the right code or get rid of guards. You always need to get to a place that has been marked on the mini map. Don’t forget that you can use your fists or a baseball bat to attack. The game offers simple gameplay with mediocre graphics, so come on!

title: Deer Simulator: Animal Family 3D
description:
Deer Simulator: Animal Family 3D is yet another great online game where you will be playing as a deer. There's a ton of adventures that you can start and find many different enemies and friends. You can build up your own house, start a family and buy accessories that will help you get through all of the obstacles the game throws at your feet. The game is offering a ton of options when it comes to character customization and improvement of your surroundings. If you start playing the game regularly, you will get a ton of great gifts, but you can start exploring the world without this in mind.
It's a great game with pleasant 3D graphics, so be sure to try it out, you won’t regret it.

title: Infinity Royale
description: Infinity Royale is an action online game where you will be playing as a soldier. Your objective will be to neutralize all of the enemies on the island. You will get transported there by a plane from which you will have to jump down. Firstly, you need to activate your parachute, else you crash into the ground and die. After that you can take a car and get closer to your enemies. You can neutralize them using the car, but the best course of action will be to use your weapon. For each of the levels, you get rewarded. You can later buy new guns in the store. Will you manage to get through all of the 10 missions on your first try?

title: Iron Superhero
description: Iron Superhero is an action online game where you will be playing as a superhero. Your main objective will be to save hostages and get rid of all of your enemies. Right at the start, you will move to a designated location where the game will provide you with a mission. After that, enemies will show up on the map and you will be tasked with destroying them. Your hero has a few skills of his own, he can shoot lasers, fly or jump really high. If you combine these skills, your enemies won't have a chance against you. The game offers you 20 levels in total, so it will take some time for you to finish the whole game. So come on, try the game out!

title: Five Nights at Old Toy Factory 2020
description: Five Nights at Old Toy Factory 2020 is a horror game where you will be working as a night guard in an old toy factory. One night, strange events will start taking place, since some of the toys will come to life and will try to kill you. Explore the factory and try to survive all 5 nights. Your only weapon is a glass bottle. Aside from that you can find notes in the individual rooms that will explain to you what has happened in this specific factory. Good luck.

title: C-Virus Game: Outbreak
description: C-Virus Game: Outbreak is an online horror game where 90% of the population were infected with a new virus and were transformed into bloodthirsty monsters. Also, you find yourself alone in an abandoned building and are trying to get out. The main doors are locked, so you need to find three keys that can be anywhere in the building. Since there's a lot of enemies around, you need to first find a weapon with some ammo so that you can defend yourself. After that, start looking for the keys. Will you be able to get through all of the levels on your first try?

title: FireStorm
description: FireStorm is an action game from the future where the whole city is controlled by a single gang terrorizing the citizens living there. Your only option of saving the city is to eliminate the gang. You will have a few fighters at your disposal who will gladly help you out. Your objective will be to complete missions in each of the levels and thus earn money. The money can be used to buy upgrades for your fighter. During the fighting, you can also use vehicles, such as tanks that can help you eliminate your enemies much faster. If you want to pass a level, you must not die, so don't forget to pick up first-aid kids as you progress through the game. So come on, let’s play!

title: Hunters and Props
description: Hunters and Props is a fun action online game where you’ll be fighting against other players on the server. You will be divided into two teams - hunters and requisites. As a hunter, you will be running around, trying to find those camouflaging as props. You have a little gadget at you that will determine whether there’s a prop hiding somewhere around you - it can either be red or green. While playing as prop, you must be very careful. Try to hide in a secret spot and hope that the enemy won’t be able to find you. Be sure to call up your friends so that you can play together or against each other. It’s going to be fun! We recommend you try the game out!

title: Dino Hunting
description: Dino Hunting is a game where your objective will be to hunt down all of the dinosaurs in your proximity. All you have to do is aim well and then shoot. Most of the dinosaurs won't be killed after the first show, so you need to shoot them multiple times. There's also another problem - the dinosaurs will try to catch your smell whenever you shoot. If they manage to do so, they will charge you. After that you will only have a few seconds to kill them. If you fail to do so, you die and will thus have to repeat the level. The game is divided into two locations with each offering a ton of levels that will keep you occupied.

title: Zombie Outbreak Arena
description: Zombie Outbreak Arena is an online action game where you will be fighting against hordes of undead. For each kill, you will be rewarded with XP that can then be used up to rank up. The game is offering you 5 different maps with a functioning day/night cycle. That’s important because you get awarded with more XP points during the night. When it comes to weapons, these will be scattered randomly around you. Ammo will be limited, so you need to switch weapons frequently. You can also use your surroundings to eliminate your enemies. You can shoot a car tank so that it explodes and kills everyone around.

title: Police Helicopter
description: Police Helicopter is a 3D online game where you will be flying a helicopter. Your objective is to find a vehicle that’s being driven by a criminal that you need to eliminate. This vehicle is being pursued by police vehicles though, so you need to watch out not to hit them. If you destroy them, you will have to start again. There are also skyscrapers in the city that you need to avoid, else you might crash into them. The game is offering you 20 levels in total that you will be continuously unlocking with new helicopters awaiting you. There’s a lot to look forward to!

title: The Island Survival
description: The Island Survival is an action online game where you’ll be fighting for your life. You find yourselves alone in a small hut in the middle of nowhere. If you want to survive, you’ll have to find food and secure all of the resources you need to survive. You’re lucky, since there’s a ton of wild-life running around. It’s not always easy to hunt them down, but if you want to eat, you’ll have to try. You can also gather resources that you find on the ground. You can make tools out of them and build defenses and other structures. During the day, the surroundings are safe, but during night time, you better run hide in your hut, else feral animals might hunt you down. Enjoy this great game, where you’ll be playing on a deserted island!

title: Lion Hunter
description: Lion Hunter is an action 3D game where you’ll be playing as a lion hunter. There are a few levels awaiting you where you’ll have a single goal on your mind, to kill dangerous animals and thus protect the jungle. Some lions only take one bullet to kill, other will need at least two. After the first shot, the lions will run towards you, so be ready. There are numerous levels where you won’t be in immediate danger, but you’ll still have to protect other animals like zebras. You need to fire as quickly as you can. Each level also has a time limit, so take care.

title: Wild Wolves
description: Wild Wolves is a 3D game, where you’ll be controlling a wild wolf. You will be trying to complete each level, with each level being a bit different. At the beginning, the game will be rather simple – follow the alpha. After that, you will need to hunt for prey or defend the pack from enemies. Read the instructions outlining the objective so that you always know what to do. There’s a time limit present for each level, so if you fail to finish it in that timeframe, you will have to repeat it. The game has average 3D graphics and the controls could be better, but it’s still a shame that the game only offers you 9 levels. Will you manage to complete all 9 of them at your first try?

title: Boat Rescue
description: Boat Rescue is a 3D game, where you’ll be trying to saving people stranded on and in buildings after a flood hit the city. Ride your boat and embark on that dangerous mission. Controlling the boat among all of the floating debris won’t be an easy task and you also need to get as close to a person as possible, so that he manages to float to your location. When you pick him up, try to get to a bigger boat as fast as possible, so professionals can take care of the survivors you bring them. You’ll have to work within a time limit, so be careful not to get stranded. It could very well happen that you’ll have to repeat the level if that happens. So come try the game out!

title: Crazy Bull Attack
description: In today’s game, you will be working as a hunter. The city has called you after several bulls escaped into the streets and are smashing whatever they can find. Your objective is to start removing them and thus save the people living there. At the beginning there won’t be that many of them, but soon it will get harder for you to survive. Use the cash you earn to buy new weapons that will help you in your fight against these dangerous animals. The game is offering OK graphics and simple controls, so come on, try it out!

title: Hungry Shark
description: Hungry Shark is a pretty rough game where you’ll be controlling a big shark. As the name suggests your objective will be to hunt down as many beach goers as you can. At the top of your screen is a kill count that you need to reach. You can eat both the people swimming and the people on boats. When they fall into the water you can attack them. Aside from that you can get a speed boosts for a while. You also need to take care to look at your time, since a longer period of not killing anyone could mean game over. Will you be able to get through all of the levels on your first try?

title: Hit Targets
description: Hit Targets is an online game where you’ll be using a sniper rifle. Your objective will be to hit all of the targets in a specific level. At the beginning this will be easy, since the objects will be very close to each other. Each level will rack up the difficulty a bit and with each level, the targets will be getting a bit smaller. The greater the distance between you and the target, the more you’ll scope will be moving. You also need to count with wind speed and direction. So in total, there’s 15 levels awaiting you. So come on, let’s play!

title: Incredible Monster
description: In this game, you will be controlling a big, mutated monster that is trying to save the city. You will of course be helping it with its task. At the beginning of the game, you choose your color. At start, only green is available, but you can buy other colors for coins later in the game. There is a total of 4 different bigger missions. In each missions there are a few levels awaiting you, where you’ll be trying to kill all of your enemies. These enemies are marked with a red dot on the map. All you need to do is find them, fight them and win. At the beginning, these opponents won’t give you much of a fight, but later, their numbers will be growing and they’ll get stronger and stronger. Don’t forget your special attack and the fact that you can even throw a car at them. There’s also a time limit, so don’t slow down too much. Can you save the whole city?

title: Penguins.io
description: Penguins.io is an addictive game where you control a small penguin fighting on an ice-berg. Your objective will be to push all of the other penguins off. If you become the last surviving penguin, you win. It’s sort of an icy battle royale. The one who survives last, wins. The iceberg will be getting smaller and smaller as individual pieces will begin to fall off. That’s why it’ll become increasingly difficult to defend against enemy attacks and to survive. You have no other chance than to attack first. All you need to do is point your penguin in the right direction and load up as much strength as you can. This way you can launch off more opponents at once.

title: Ninja Cube
description: Ninja Cube is an online game in pixelated graphics where you’ll be controlling a ninja warrior. You just need to aim a bit and shoot him right up into the air. His advantage is that he can switch directions mid-air and attack an otherwise well-hidden enemy. Try to collect all shurrikens so that you get awarded all of the available stars. The main goal of this game is to find the princess who has been taken prisoner. So come on, start playing!

title: Apocalypse World
description:
Zombie apocalypse is upon us and most of humanity is already dead. Most of those who aren’t dead have turned into bloodthirsty zombies. Few survivors, however, are immune to the disease. These people don’t have it easy, since they need to fight for their lives all day long. Your hero is one of those people and you’ll need to help him survive in this inhospitable land. To survive, try to look for empty buildings and water sources. Avoid zombies that can attack you at any moment. Try to move slowly in a car or a motorbike, since you can cover more ground this way and it won’t be as dangerous as going on foot. 
 
 The game includes: 
 * Driving bikes, cars and riding horses
 * Flying on a glider
 * Fighting the zombies
 * A big, open world.

title: Forest Hunter
description: In today’s game, you’ll be playing as a hunter who will be trying to catch a certain number of game. Right at the beginning you can choose what type of animal you want to hunt for. There are six options to choose and the harder to catch types include rabbits and ducks. You need to be careful around wolves, who will attack you right after you fire your gun. There are difficulty levels to choose that come with each animal, but if you start lowering them, the reward will be smaller. Try to earn as much money as you can to buy new guns at the store. There’s a lot of them available, some look great, even though they may be more expensive than others. The hunting season started already, so let’s go!

title: Crazy Machines
description: Crazy Machines is an action online game where you’ll be controlling a flying fighting machine. Your objective will be to destroy other machines that are trying to attack you. The game is divided into more levels, with each of them having stronger and stronger enemies. You can finish a few rounds with the original machine that you’re given, but you’ll soon find out that you need to upgrade it a bit if you want to have a chance against the stronger enemies that you’ll encounter. Become the best player on your block!

title: Airplane Tunnel
description: In this game, you will be controlling an airplane in a dangerous tunnel. It’s dangerous mainly because of all the obstacles that are blocking your way. The blue ones can be destroyed via your rockets, but beware, since you only have a limited amount of these. The red obstacles cannot be destroyed at all, so you always have to dodge them. Aside from that you need to collect golden coins that can later be used to buy a new airplane that has more rockets available. You may also get extra rockets from time to time, but don’t count on it.

title: Hunter 3D
description: Today, we present you an interesting 3D game where you’ll be playing as a hunter. The game is divided in 2 parts and in each of them, you will be competing with an opponent. You will be tasked with shooting more targets than your competitors. The closer to the middle you hit, the more points you’ll get. Your objective is to win, so be sure to be as accurate as possible.

title: Battle Tanks
description: Today we present you a modern online version of the legendary Battle City. Your goal will again be to protect your home base from enemy tanks. First levels will be fairly easy, but it’s gonna get hard real fast. It will get progressively harder, since the enemies will be protected by shields later on. Try to shoot the enemy car, since you can get some nice bonuses this way. 20 different levels are awaiting you.

title: Insects: Alien Shooter
description: Your team left you all alone and now you have to take care of everything… alone. The planet is crawling with enemies. You are hearing strange sounds. They are getting closer now. You must stay calm, pick up your weapon and shoot everything that moves. You’ll need luck to survive, but believe me when I say it’s going to be a fun ride.
